SCP-9948.raw_content:
"The ANC cannot win."

Item #: SCP-9948

Object Class: Neutralised

Special Containment Procedures: As of 08/02/89, SCP-9948 is believed neutralised. However, Foundation agents should continue to monitor outlying townships in the Republic of Ciskei for signs of SCP-9948, such as militant anti-government action, noncollaboration with Republican authorities, and especially agitation or terrorism targeted towards the South African Union.

The Foundation is to continue cooperating with the Ciskei Defence Forces in propagating material to discourage engaging with SCP-9948. If the phenomenon recurs, Foundation watchposts are to engage in intelligence-sharing with the NIS1 for the purpose of its suppression.

Description: SCP-9948 was a necrotic impingement on the local psychic field in and around the Republic of Ciskei, inducing mania, aggression, psychosis among the native populations, leading to the incitement of terrorism. It caused both auditory and visual hallucinations in the affected; subjects described a voice calling them to violence or revolt, and a female figure appearing at the edges of their vision. Though the majority of the afflicted were able to resist the anomalous effect, around 5% of those suffering were overcome by a compulsion to violence against local authorities, especially racialised violence targeting white individuals.

This resulted in a notable uptick in radical activity in and around the Republic. In particular, affected individuals often chose to link up with preexisting subversive elements in order to further their goals. Their operations allowed considerable penetration of terrorist cells into Union territory.

For this reason, on 03/03/82, the Foundation was approached by the Paranatural Wing of the CCB2. The Wing requested initially that the Foundation work with the CCB on containment operations, advocating for a proactive approach to maintaining normality. In return, the Wing guaranteed Foundation access to captured anomalies and subordination in containment matters. The SUSA3 Ethics Committee Representative agreed to provide intelligence to facilitate CCB raids, and process captured subjects thereafter, conditional on the CCB maintaining certain rules of engagement. The details of some of these raids are listed below:

Date Results Notes
18/06/82 CCB agents break up an MK4 gathering, delivering two subjects to Foundation custody. Interviews describe isiXhosa whispers at the dead of night imploring subjects to take up arms and “cull the cattle”. None.
24/10/82 CCB recover weapons smugglers on the Zimbabwean border, and deliver one to custody. Subject claims to glimpse a translucent apparition out of the corner of his eyes when he tries to sleep. Subject notes his smuggling operations predate the hallucinations. Compulsive effects may set in before visible manifestations?
08/11/83 Extended police action in Ciskei following mob violence and rioting sweeps up several afflicted. One subject recalls being promised that “the dead will avenge us” by a figure on the night before violence escalated. Subject expired of hemoptysis before more detail could be extracted. CCB reprimanded for carelessness with captures.
29/03/84 Afrikaner subversive intellectuals detected and captured by SWAPOL-Koevoet5. Subjects do not possess a good grasp of isiXhosa, but note repeated mentions of Queen Victoria clear in reported apparition’s speech. Phenomenon originates in nineteenth century; confirmed by necromantic consultancy. Manifestations now extend beyond Ciskei.
15/06/87 Trade unionists subject to night arrests following election of second Botha6 cabinet. Subject reports being called to “crush the shirker”. Further commentary difficult to extract; subject remains terse and recalcitrant despite attempts to guarantee her comfort. [REDACTED AS PER ETHICS COMMITTEE MEMORANDUM ON MORALE PRESERVATION]

Through information obtained from these witnesses, Foundation historians determined the impingement was the result of a persistent psionic echo due to the animus of Nongqawuse, a Xhosa priestess of some note, who led a millenarian movement in the mid-nineteenth century.

Diplomatic Records: On 26/08/88, the Global Occult Coalition delivered the following communication:

+ GOC memorandum
- Close

OFFICE OF THE LIAISON TO THE FOUNDATION, GLOBAL OCCULT COALITION

IT has come to the attention of the Coalition’s Council of 108 that the SCP FOUNDATION, international occult and thaumaturgic power of note, has been engaging in cooperation with the Apartheid government occupying South Africa, aiding their suppression of legitimate indigenous sovereignty movements for material gain.

IN accordance with Resolutions #324, 348, and 357 of the proceedings of the Council, we hereby call upon the SCP FOUNDATION to act as required by paraglobal law, and break off this collaboration with the occupying government; and to engage in reparations towards the black and coloured peoples of the South African regions.

IF the SCP FOUNDATION chooses to continue to flout paraglobal law, the Coalition encourages the Council to move to censure their actions and officially enact legal, economic, thaumaturgic and infernal sanctions upon SUSA.

Foundation SUSA Senior Supervisor Johannes Maastricht returned the following message:

+ SUSA reply
- Close

FROM: Johannes Maastricht

Concerning the matter of SUSA operations in the Union of South Africa, I note:

That the Foundation maintains strict political neutrality in all matters, between ideologies, between nations, between ethnic groups;

That the hypocrisies of the Coalition on this matter are manifold;

That fully one-third of the Council of 108 either openly approves of some class of racial and ethnic separation, or trades with the Union government sub rosa;

That the Council has introduced, and rejected, bills to sanction members for trading with the Union government no less than five times;

That it is my opinion, and unanimously that of the Foundation Ethics Committee, that apartheid constitutes a grave crime, that it stains the Union’s morals and dignity, and denies the nonwhite population of the Union their rights under paraglobal law, and that the Union government ought to introduce full franchise at all possible speed;

That the Foundation has consistently pushed the Union government towards greater racial franchise and against segregatory measures at every opportunity;

That the activities of Council members in promoting radical elements of the African National Congress and South West African People’s Organisation have inflamed tensions, promoted sectarian and ethnic violence, induced crackdowns by Union authorities on innocent civilians, and have made outright civil war more likely;

That such civil war would likely involve the open use of anomalous techniques, presenting a terrible threat both to the people of South Africa and the Veil of Normalcy;

That, therefore, the Coalition’s activities in sum further the suffering of South Africans, who die in the dark so they can live in their light.

The Coalition did not reply. Within a month, the Council introduced a bill to censure the Foundation, passing 91-17; a bill to sanction SUSA, passing 63-45; and a bill to sanction the Foundation at large, failing 26-82.

Neutralisation: On 16/10/88, the CCB once again approached the Foundation, this time declaring that the anomalous effects of SCP-9948 had multiplied beyond previous expectations, and the Union government was being overwhelmed by the afflicted. At this point, the Bureau was under considerable pressure after the revelation of their existence and operations to the public in 1987. They proposed major Foundation intervention: neutralisation of the impingement and use of the LETHE protocol to eliminate large swathes of the ANC’s power base.

SUSA refused, on the grounds this itself constituted an intrusion into normalcy. As a second offer, the CCB requested that the Foundation carry out only the neutralisation, in return for 20 litres of privately obtained Oil of Minium7. SUSA signed off, and the neutralisation proceeded.

On account of certain psionic breakthroughs made over the last five years, the neutralisation itself was trivial. An antiharmonic ritual was channeled through a cooperative subject, and the impingement of Nongqawuse was annihilated. The subject, Sabelo Zitha, was a minor officer in the Ciskei Republican police forces and a regular CCB source. He was debriefed thereafter by Personnel Specialist Marguerite Duval. The record of this debriefing is below:

DEBRIEF LOG 10/02/89

MARGUERITE: How are you feeling, Sabelo? All well?

SABELO: I feel as if all my skin is about to slide off. That machine was not meant to contain people; I am sure of it.

[Marguerite chuckles.]

MARGUERITE: We’ll make sure to inform you if we find out there are any side effects. But what we mean is, any more hallucinations? Do you see that woman?

SABELO: Ah, no, not for a second. I thank God for your arrival. I was going terribly mad listening to her rant.

MARGUERITE: So you feel positively about her removal?

SABELO: Miss Duval, how would you feel if there was a phantom screaming death in your ear, and then she stopped? I am ecstatic. I could barely talk to my wife with her rabble-rousing every moment. You do not have to run through all the obvious questions.

MARGUERITE: Hm. But is there not, say, a sense of loss? We often find such things in individuals who have been freed of compulsions.

SABELO: That sounds awful. To have a witch take root in my heart…

[Sabelo pauses, looking contemplative.]

SABELO: No. She is gone for good, I think.

MARGUERITE: And how did you experience the compulsive effects? Did they manifest as some kind of emotion? Guilt, anger, sadness?

SABELO: I do not know what this compulsion was like for others. For me it was just … words. Her curses, every second of the day. I do not know how she ever turned anyone to her service. I am too old for these things, I think.

MARGUERITE: In your view, there's not much sympathy for the afflicted? Would you characterise their behaviour as fundamentally rash?

[Sabelo hums.]

SABELO: It is always rash to break the law in a heated moment. These acts of passion only cast us into rougher waters, in the end. If the others had my consideration, this country should be so much better for it.

MARGUERITE: There's really no circumstance you'd advocate to break the laws of the land? I mean, in the Union, there are all sorts of reasons —

SABELO: Madame, we are not in the Union. We are in Ciskei. If these men had a problem with the Union, they should have taken it up in a lawful way, and outside of our sovereign nation.

[Marguerite sits up in her seat.]

MARGUERITE: The Foundation maintains a strict policy of political neutrality in all matters of state. But surely as people speaking to eachother, we can acknowledge that Ciskei is —

SABELO: Oh, you Europeans.

[Sabelo massages his temple with his left hand.]

SABELO: You never fail to come down here and pity the poor black, who does not even know he is on his knees. You look around at this homeland — at this bantustan — and you laugh that we try and make a life here.

MARGUERITE: Mr. Zitha, of course I’m not insulting you, it’s just what seems true from where I'm standing.

SABELO: Oh, what else? I know your type, Miss Duval. We get these students coming in, asking about the ANC, all the time.

SABELO: Do you think I like it? Do you think I enjoy that some voortrekker who can barely speak two words of English gets to vote to have my sons thrown out of their homes at gunpoint?

MARGUERITE: Sir, I —

SABELO: Do you know who she is?

MARGUERITE: I don’t think I understand your question, Sabelo. Please just take a second and calm down. I wasn’t questioning your political inclinations.

SABELO: That old ghost. I am sure your organisation recognises her. All those skulls and wires… they are familiar with the dead. But do you, specifically, know?

MARGUERITE: I don’t. It’s not protocol to disperse low-level details like these to people in my position.

SABELO: She is Nongqawuse. A prophetess, from when the Xhosa were free. She led the chieftains in a great spiritual rising.

SABELO: She told them to slay their cattle in great herds, and burn the crops. Then, she said, all the dead would rise in her name, and drive out the British like snow before the sun.

SABELO: I do not think I need to fill in what happened next.

MARGUERITE: …The ghosts didn’t come. And the people must have starved.

[Sabelo snorts and shakes his head.]

SABELO: They starved. They ate the grass, the leaves of the trees, each other. And there was no end to it. She even punished those who refused, who clung to their only safety from famine. She hunted their cattle down, and claimed only their fear held back the rising.

SABELO: And in the end, the Xhosa did not come storming into the veldt and scourge the settlers. Nongqawuse was not overthrown, or punished. There is no pretty finale to that tale. Just ten thousand lost, for no good to anyone.

SABELO: When you banished her, just now, for a second she stopped with her screams. There was something sad about her, I think. She said … "They still do not hear me. I do not ever think they ever did." If only she'd had that thought a century ago.

SABELO: Let her ghost be gone. Let all mention of her name be burned. Why would I want to remember her?

MARGUERITE: I see. That’s quite the story. I’m glad you felt comfortable telling me about that. Now, if —

SABELO: I am not done. You must see the analogy?

MARGUERITE: Presumably you’re talking about the ANC. We’re in a secured environment, and as we’ve discussed you’ll be amnesticised. You can be as open as you’d like.

SABELO: I am already being as open as I like. It is exactly this that I mean. You come here, to my home, and you ask me if I would like to take up arms?

MARGUERITE: Under absolutely no circumstances do we ever encourage civilian subjects to engage in political violence —

SABELO: Yes, you just come here, and sneer at me. And call me conservative, careful, traditional. And you think: collaborator, traitor, umlungu8.

SABELO: You know what I have? A house, children, a life. And what does the ANC promise? A generation grown under the machete and the rifle.

SABELO: The ANC cannot possibly win. All they can do is light the fire of a war that will burn long after I am dead. After even my children are dead.

SABELO: Why would I pick up a gun for such people? Better to live with what I have, and enjoy this peace. Even if the ANC get their way, we will not see a free AmaXhosa in my lifetime.

SCP-9949 visualisation

Item #: SCP-9949

Object Class: Safe

Special Containment Procedures: As access to/comprehension of SCP-9949 is impossible through non-anomalous means, containment of SCP-9949 is unnecessary. All staff members exposed to SCP-9949 are to be offered voluntary amnestic treatment.

Description: SCP-9949 is a memory, present within an as-of-yet unknown proportion of the human population.

The exact content of SCP-9949 is hard to confirm, as subjects verified to 'hold' it show contradictions in certain sections of their testimony:

  • 100% of subjects remember a space that is in nearly pitch darkness.
  • 100% of subjects remember a human face in uncomfortably close proximity (Hereafter referred to as SCP-9949-1).
  • 96% of subjects claim SCP-9949-1 is male.
  • Consensus places the age of SCP-9949-1 between 50-80 years old.
  • There is no consensus on the race of SCP-9949-1.
  • 80% of subjects remember a strong smell of alcohol.
  • 65% of subjects remember a strong smell of cigarettes.
  • 100% of subjects remember SCP-9949-1 murmuring the phrases "Look at you.", "You're so beautiful." and "You're going to be one of my favourites." repeatedly.

SCP-9949 is 'located' within Paulsen's region, a small section of the human hippocampus currently unrecognised by modern neuroscience. Given this location, and the fact that SCP-9949 is only recoverable to consciousness via the administration of a Class-Y Mnestic, it is theorised that SCP-9949 is formed within the third trimester of pregnancy.

Addendum 9949.1: [FURTHER INFORMATION CLASSIFIED LEVEL 4 SECRET]

INPUT LEVEL 4 CREDENTIALS
ACCESS GRANTED

Following an expansion of research efforts and implementation of improved noöspheric models, current predictions place that SCP-9949 is present within 100% of the human population.

Further research is pending overseer approval.

SPECIAL CONTAINMENT PROCEDURES:

SCP-9950 is Aizsaule1 class.

Due to the sheer ideatic density2 of SCP-9950, full separation of its various related memeplexes from baseline reality, and thus proper containment, is infeasible. Current research is centered on the manufacturing of a hypothetical narritive space without the existence of SCP-9950, regardless of the logical impossibility of doing so within an SCP-9950-infected plane.

DESCRIPTION:

SCP-9950 is a possibly-sentient theoretical and metaphysical parasite currently inhabiting all planes of conceptualization known to humanity.

SCP-9950’s anomalous properties have yet to be fully proven, however it has been provided an SCP designation due to the sheer improbability of its prevalence across planes which should not possess its ideatic characteristics, as well as recovered information from the Huǒjù zhi Zi occult organization3, which suggests to a point in history without the existence of SCP-9950.

The true physical parameters of SCP-9950 cannot be determined due to the subjective nature of most of its manifestations.

ADDENDUM-1:

The following is a comprehensive list of the planes of conceptualization SCP-9950 has affected, and the ideatic density of SCP-9950 within said planes.

INFOSPHERE
—

PLANE VISIBILITY:  INTANGIBLE

IDEATIC DENSITY: 100ρω

DEFINITION

The collective metaspace of all possible ideas

EFFECTS

Due to the nature of the Infosphere SCP-9950, while fully present in its entirety within it, has not been observed to have a structural impact on it as a whole.

PATASPHERE
—

PLANE VISIBILITY:  INTANGIBLE

IDEATIC DENSITY: 46ρω

DEFINITION

The collective metaspace of all possible narratives.

EFFECTS

As stated above, 100% of narratives known to the Foundation have been infected by SCP-9950 in some form. SCP-9950 most commonly manifests within the Patasphere as either an external or internal antagonistic force, regardless of genre. However various culturally significant narratives within younger genre demographics have been altered to include aspects of SCP-9950 The rate of these alterations have been shown to increase during periods of societal destabilization attributed to ecological crisis.

NOÖSPHERE
—

PLANE VISIBILITY:  INTANGIBLE

IDEATIC DENSITY: 34ρω

DEFINITION

The collective metaspace of the human unconscious.

EFFECTS

While no metastructual damage to the noösphere cashed by SCP-9950 has been observed, the number of thought energy condensing around the "hexagonal" and the "color" nodes have increased, by proxy increasing essophysical manifestation events correlating to aspects of SCP-9950

Recent noöspheric examination of unconscious anti-concepts have revealed a continuous merging of SCP-9950 with certain "Primal fears" experienced by the human population. Current estimates date the beginning of this merging to have begun around 300,000 years ago.

AKIVASPHERE
—

PLANE VISIBILITY:  SEMI-TANGIBLE

IDEATIC DENSITY: 31ρω

DEFINITION

The metaphysical membrane encompassing interactions between belief and reality.

EFFECTS

Although average ideatic density is higher overall within the Akivasphere, no notable effects have been observed aside from minor semiohazardous alterations to significant religious texts & timezones for certain holidays. Past manifestations of Apex-tier pluripotent entities releted to SCP-9950 have largely decreased due to their theological irrelevance.

ASTEROSPHERE
—

PLANE VISIBILITY:  SEMI-TANGIBLE

IDEATIC DENSITY: 28ρω

DEFINITION

The collective metaspace of human dreams & Thaumaturgy.

EFFECTS

Despite of the relatively low ideatic density related to SCP-9950 the meta structure of the Asterosphere has been greatly impacted, in what is assumed to be a parasymbiotic pact throughout the entire astral plane. This has led to a decrease in communications between planes, leading the Foundation to be live in the lessening of biodiversity within the astral plane.

Furthermore, unlike all expected thaumaturgical backlash events within workings4 thaumaturgical workings dependent on SCP-9950 reactions propagate further essophysical manifestations of SCP-9950 during backlash events.

ONTOSPHERE
—

PLANE VISIBILITY:  TANGIBLE

IDEATIC DENSITY: 25ρω

DEFINITION

Physical baseline reality, encompassing all natural laws.

EFFECTS

SCP-9950 has irreparably imbedded itself within all laws of motion, chemistry & thermodynamics.

Reverse engineering the state of the ontosphere before the appearance of SCP-9950 has been deemed impossible.

CYBERSPHERE
—

PLANE VISIBILITY:  TANGIBLE

IDEATIC DENSITY: 06ρω

DEFINITION

Collective Metaspace of all digital data.

EFFECTS

No significant traces of SCP-9950 affliction observed within the cybersphere besides minor cultural shifts observed in the internet & the behavioral programming of certain AIC’s. This is assumed to be caused by the low ideatic compatibility SCP-9950 possesses with the cybersphere.

BIOSPHERE
—

PLANE VISIBILITY:  TANGIBLE

IDEATIC DENSITY: 12ρω

DEFINITION

The collective metaspace of all biological information.

EFFECTS

The low amount of SCP-9950 related ideatic density present within earths biosphere has been attributed to the high amount of conceptual intersections between the thoughts of sentient life and SCP-9950.

All Flora & Fauna presents on earth have developed biological reactions in response to SCP-9950 throughout history. Due to the complex nature of their conceptualization humans have also been observed engaging in mental reactive mechanisms adapted to and or altered by SCP-9950 such as cultural shifts in food preservation, food gathering, clothing preferences & worship of memeplexes antithetical to SCP-9950.







ADDENDUM-2:

On July 3rd 2034, the largest essophysical manifestation of SCP-9950 was recorded and designated SCP-9950-1. Records of SCP-9950’s existence have been found dating back roughly 34 million years ago with various proven historical records. Considering its area of 14,200,000 km², the number of entities, settlements and landmarks found within it, the appearance of SCP-9950-1 has been declared largest semiohazardous event in history.

Due to the newly confirmed existence of SCP-9950 & SCP-9950-1, no containment, neutralization or planetary evacuation efforts are being considered at this time. Reclassification to -EX is pending.







SCP-9950-1. Identified as the continent of Antarctica through historical records.






Footnotes
1. The anomaly’s existence is known to the public, but its anomalous properties are not.
2. The measure of intensity & concentration of a given memeplex in a physical/metaphysical domain. Measured in a percentile with ρω‘s.
3. Also known as the Children of the Torch. The group's religious beliefs focus on the worship of avian entities and the Sun, which is given a deific status.
4. e.g, the generation of liquids as backlash for pyrokinetic workings.

Item #: SCP-9955

Object Class: Uncontained (Neutralized)

Special Containment Procedures: Radio frequencies from the Large Sagittarius Star Cloud are to be monitored for resurgences of SCP-9955 after the current hosts' expiration. The Foundation is to continue working its investigations in tandem with the Theurgic Company of the Silver Twilight (see below).

Personnel interacting with SCP-9955 must have a cognitive rating of 75 or above, and be trained in the construction of a psionic dæmon.1

Description: SCP-9955 was a previously unknown retrocausal Fifthist Sect known as the Fifth Congregational Church. The five cult leaders of SCP-9955 manipulated members of the inner circle in order to transfer Elan-Vital Energy (EVE) from one host of SCP-9955 to one healthy human subject knowledgeable in occultism and anomalous technology. When a non-cultist subject is within an estimated radius of 500 meters from SCP-9955, they will experience a psionic event within the next 24 hours. The subject will hallucinate being stalked by a cult leader and a hand with a relevant sin burned on its back.

People closest to the pulpit throw their heads back as black smoke billows out of their mouth. The smoke hovers over the commons and white-blue ash falls from the hovering smoke. Trees begin to rapidly die, leaving barren trunks and branches.]

Speaker: Sfymfsnjq 6:65 "The soul is a threat to the Living-Dead One. Ego has been His only gift. His promise of The Death of Sin is a lie. (more sound distortion thought to be an audiocognitohazard) Wjfhm tzy yt ymj rtwsnsl xyfw fsi yfpj gfhp dtzw xjwujsy'i ytslzj."

[Subjects scratch and tear at their clothes and skin. The sprouts on some of the affected bloom into leeks. Containment Team A-440 arrives and place SRAs around the perimeter of the commons. The speaker ignores the agents and effected subjects close to the agents try to attack them.]

[Agent Thalia manages to incapacitate the subjects. Agent Melpomene finishes the final set up of the anchors. A burst of wind knocks Agent Thalia to the ground. The wind pulls more black smoke from the subjects. The listeners closest to the pulpit cease all movement. Leeks stop growing and the subjects stop billowing smoke. The fungi and flesh rapidly spread over them.

[Agent Melpomene initiates the anchors. Crackling reverberates through the commons, and crescendos in volume for fifteen seconds. During this time the security footage appears to burn.]

Speaker: (distorted) As Sfymfsnjq said to the idiotic ego when he went out into the world after first flame—

[The entity's voice becomes faint as the anchors adjust liminality back to baseline reality.]

After the incident, subjects were unable to comprehend any terrestrial language, and resorted to explosive outbursts when confronted by an unaffected subject. They were brought into Foundation custody for treatment. At this time, there has been no remission in the subjects' conditions.

RTF-625 "Street Magicians", was established to further investigation and containment efforts. The task force consisted of Researcher Zimmerman, and Field Researchers Flynn and Ryder. A final investigation was launched with assistance from GoI-1565.

Investigation Log.9955.3:

Personnel Present: Field Researcher Mordecai Ryder, Field Researcher Aileas Flynn, Researcher Rebecca Zimmerman, Head Magus Xavier D'Arta
Location: Billington's Wood (Former)
Date: 05/22/2025
Time: 23:34 EST

[Ryder, Flynn, Zimmerman, and D'Arta approach the missing village of Billington's Wood. The group carries five pet carriers. They reach the clearing to find a decaying church in the center. Silently, the trio reach the church and they check for wards. Flynn tries the cellar doors and finds them locked. She is unable to dispel the ward or pick the lock. Ryder walks around back, and finds the backdoor to be a painted image. Zimmerman is busy installing SRAs around the church. D'Arta dispels a ward in front of the doors and tries the handle. It is unlocked.]

[D'Arta signals for the two other thaumaturges to come to the front door. The trio prepare themselves for entrance. Researcher Zimmerman is almost finished setting up the anchors. Ryder picks up two pet carriers and nods at Zimmerman and she nods back. Flynn and D'Arta, pick up the other pet carriers and enter the church. They enter into an extraplanar space.]

[They are in a heavily wooded area with a thin, barely visible path. There is no night sky above them. Instead it is an endless black abyss. In silence, the group march in single file down the path.]

Ryder: This silence is unnerving.

Flynn: Quiet down. We don't know what's in the woods.

Ryder: But that's what's unnerving. I don't hear any animal, I don't hear any wind. Nothing.

Flynn: All the more reason to remain quiet.

[After roughly twenty minutes, chanting and hymns are audible on the recording. The sky above the team fractals with multicolored lights. There are objects in the sky that seem to be stars, but with further study are rotting starfish. The team tread lightly, and approach an open clearing. The opening is surrounded by grayscale forests overlaid with space. The trees vibrate sporadically and there is no permanence. Wind smears the frequencies of life.]

[The center of the clearing is an amber altar and a tobacco barn. There is no light visible inside the altar. On closer review, most of the populace of Billington's Wood is inside the barn. The altar is surrounded by twenty-five villagers and it's flanked by two tall burning trees. There is no termination point to them. Closer to the altar are five human cultists and they wear subdued, blue-gray robes. Their backs are to the operatives and on the other side of the altar are five humanoid entities. They appear to be the entities from earlier investigations except they also wear the same blue-gray robes. They chant and do not notice the trio.]

[The twenty-five villagers sing the hymns out of tune and Ryder approaches one of them. Recording shows gray, ashen skin, with small leeks sprouting from its pours. He waves his hand in front of its face and it doesn't react. A cultist looks behind him. The thaumaturges hide behind the villagers and remain still. The only occasional movement comes from the contents of the carriers. After a few moments, the cultist looks forward back at the entities. Flynn looks displeased and tugs on Ryder's jacket. The group sneaks to the tree line and position themselves at a better angle toward the altar.]

[The five leaders' chanting gets louder; the hymns from the villagers are more dissonant. Ryder mumbles an anti-audiocognitohazard under his breath. Flynn puts in ear plugs, and D'Arta begins whispering "Our Father". The lit trees shift, bend, and arc over the altar. Their fires increase, and the faces of the five humans are clearer. They appear to be in their late 20s.]

Unknown Entity 1: Xrtpj wnxj, ymj knaj rzxy sty inj—

[The altar collapses on itself, and its image becomes inverted.]

Unknown Entity 2: Sjb xtzqx rzxy kfij, tqi xtzqx rzxy wjsjb flfns—

[The five human cultists throw back their heads and black smoke rolls out of them.]

Unknown Entity 3: Ny yfpjx f ytbs yt wfnxj f hmnqi, wnyzfq htsxywzhyji utbjwji gd 500 mzrfsx ijknqji—

[The fires increase. The operatives set the pet carriers down and position them to open between the five humans and the five entities. Smoke slowly billows out of the entities.]

Unknown Entities in unison: Bnymns ymj nssjw hnwhqj hmtxjs, knaj sjb xtzqx yt gj yfpjs!

[The fires suddenly go out, leaving the clearing in darkness. The multicolored firmament does nothing to illuminate the scene. Sounds of the pet carriers opening is heard. Rustling suggests the animals sprinting out of their carriers. When the fires and light returns, black smoke from both the unknown entities and the rabbits are crossing in mid-air above the negative space that was the altar. Smoke reverses back into the human cultists. A few of them are knocked unconscious. The remaining cultists are in shock. The villagers are unfazed.]

[Outside the church, Zimmerman watches as the church turns transparent. Image on the video feed doubles and the sky starts to twist into geometric patterns. An albino canine appears beside Zimmerman. It stands on her feet and pants. She pats the dog on the head, and shifts her attention back to the SRAs and turns on them on. The church is still transparent but isn't fading any further. The sky returns to normal but the video feed is still doubled.]

[On the extraplane, the rabbits' souls and the entities souls finish exchanging bodies. The rabbits cease their confused sprinting. The unknown entities screech and run toward the black and white tree line. The cultists follow the chaos back to the operatives and shout expletives. D'Arta and Flynn brace themselves for a fight. Ryder summons his familiar. She is much larger than before.]

[Ryder directs Hal to herd the new rabbits back into the carriers. Flynn whispers into her hands and summons balls of fire. She tosses them at the cultists. D'Arta deflects a sepia filter and summons an aethereal shield. A cultist absconds Ryder. Ryder decks him.]

[Hal succeeds in herding the new rabbits into the pet carriers. Telekinetically, she zips the carriers closed.]

[Flynn doesn't duck under a Gaussian blur in time and is cut in the shoulder. She dodges another attack and trips a cultist. D'Arta restrains another cultist while bruises begin to appear on his neck. Ryder turns to assist Flynn but is halted when a massive hand decks him. Ryder is knocked back into the missing altar. He trips and his leg is crushed on impact.]

[Hal sprints toward the fallen researcher. She jumps and bites the jugular of the cultist who attacked him. Flynn and D'Arta restrain the cultists that had blacked out and then assist Ryder. The cultist who crushed Ryder bleeds out from Hal's bite.]

[The entranced villagers continue to stand and remain nonreactive.]

[D'Arta and Flynn help Hal place Ryder on Hal's back. Flynn pants and gathers the pet carriers. She quickly heads down the trail back toward the church. D'Arta wakes up the unconscious cultists, and leads all cultists down the path. Sad chirps from Hal are barely audible as she leaves.]

Field Researcher Flynn and Head Magus D'Arta were treated for minor injuries. Field Researcher Ryder is being treated for extensive injuries.

Due to the overwhelming psychological nature of the events, Field Researchers Flynn and Ryder took a month off from Foundation duties. Field Researcher Flynn sought bi-weekly therapy and attended a confessional booth before every Mass. Field Researcher Ryder joined a support group and fasted for a week while studying the Torah and the Talmud.

At approximately 00:05 local time, the town of Billington's Wood returned to its place of origin. On follow up interviews with both locals of the town and adjacent towns, there were no memories of the initial event. The two previously missing GoI-1565 initiates underwent weekly therapy as they were not subject to the reversal of SCP-9955's event.

Seawater slowly trickles down her face, "I tried! I took days off from work months in advance. But I can't always control some aspects of my job." It walks toward Flynn, "That's enough! I don't want to hear any more excuses. Weren't we ever important to you?" its eyes begin to water. She covers her face. Seawater streams through her fingers. Flynn steadies her breath, "You're important to me, Bran. Your family is important to me. I had to miss my niece's baptism because of--" "Work." Internally, Flynn struggled to suppress a memory of her near death to a human-sized living doll. That memory could've been her at Hannah's baptism. "Please, move," Figure Two says quietly. She sobs in silence for a few moments. Eventually, she gets up and moves away from the front doors. She does not look at the figure. "We love you Aileas." It exits the house. [[/div]] --the front lobby melts into view. Flynn is collapsed at the entryway.] [[/div]] Field Researcher Flynn was found unconscious in a puddle of seawater by janitorial staff. She was sent to the infirmary. The seawater matched the parameters of seawater found in the Atlantic Ocean and registered at a low AKIVA level. Both Field Researchers Flynn and Ryder took a week's leave due to psychological concerns. Personnel interacting with SCP-9955 established stronger psionic measures and the thaumaturges became more attentive in theological observance. The research team launched another investigation into the retrocausal plot. Researcher Zimmerman from the Department of Physics[[footnote]]Paraphysics Division.[[/footnote]] was inoculated and warded before the start of the mission. Field Researchers Flynn and Ryder also aided Researcher Zimmerman in the construction of a personal defensive dæmon. [[div class="modal"]] __Investigation Log.9955.2:__ **Personnel Present:** Field Researcher Mordecai Ryder, Field Researcher Aileas Flynn, Researcher Rebecca Zimmerman **Location:** Billington's Wood (Former) **Date:** 05/19/2025 **Time:** 09:32 EST ------ [Zimmerman, Ryder, and Flynn approach the clearing. One decaying tobacco barn sits haphazardly in the center. Flynn prays for a moment. After a few minutes, the thaumaturges deemed it safe to proceed. Zimmerman nods and pulls a radio scanner out of her pack and starts to pan the area.] **Flynn:** Mordecai, you and I should investigate the barn. [The two enter the barn while Zimmerman continues her scan. She happily hums to herself. Flynn and Ryder find the barn empty. Spiders with five legs scuttle away from the two thaumaturges.] **Ryder:** Spiders. Why'd it have to be spiders? **Flynn:** Arachnophobic? [Flynn walks around the barn's perimeter while she searches for wards.] **Ryder:** Sort of? These ones look really weird, so... yeah, I'm a little scared. [Flynn scoffs and continues looking for wards. Ryder creeps around the barn. ##gold|Whispering## to himself, he summons his familiar. A large, translucent white rabbit starts sniffing around the perimeter. Zimmerman peeks in her head.] **Zimmerman:** Is it safe for me to enter? **Flynn:** Define safe. **Zimmerman:** I won't be attacked by an anomaly? **Flynn:** Sure, it's safe. [Zimmerman cautiously enters the barn and approaches Ryder. She glances at the ethereal rabbit.] **Zimmerman:** Very cute. **Ryder:** Hal is very cute and a good bun. //(coos at Hal)// //Gut kinigl!//[[footnote]]Yiddish, "Good rabbit!"[[/footnote]] [Hal shivers and her tail wiggles.] **Ryder:** Were you able to find anything? **Zimmerman:** It's as you had hypothesized. The radio signatures of Kaus Australis, Nanki, Ascella, Kaus Media, Kaus Borealis, and KW Sagitarii, radiate throughout the area. However, they're a little jumbled. **Ryder:** Jumbled, jumbled how? **Zimmerman:** My guess is that the five stars' radio signals are overlapping. But the signals are clear enough that I can match it. [While Ryder and Zimmerman are talking, Hal digs underneath a disrupted patch of dirt. Flynn finds something of note. She checks the item for wards and picks up what appears to be a medallion with a cut gemstone. Its shape is hard to see on the recording.] **Ryder:** Anything else, Rebecca? [Hal loudly thumps catching the trio off-guard. The researchers stop talking and turn toward the rabbit. She races around the hole she created.] **Ryder:** What did you find? [He reaches Hal, and looks in the hole. A piece of rolled parchment pokes from the dirt. Hal zooms around Ryder and then Zimmerman. Ryder checks for wards. Sensing no anomaly on his burning paper, he snuffs it. He puts on thaumaturgic gloves and bends down to pick up the item.] [Opening it he reads the contents silently to himself. Text on the page reads 'smoke rise, the five must not die-- new souls must fade, old souls must renew again-- it takes a town to raise a child, ritual constructed powered by 500 humans defiled-- within the inner circle chosen, five new souls to be taken'] **Ryder:** Hal found a ritual spell. [Flynn reaches Ryder and peeks over his shoulder.] **Flynn:** You didn't read this out loud, did you? **Ryder:** Aileas Flynn, I'm not that stupid. **Zimmerman:** Have you found anything Aileas? **Flynn:** I found a medallion. It hurts to look at the gemstone for long. [Zimmerman winces while trying to look at it.] **Zimmerman:** I don't think this is a three-dimensional shape. [While the team talks the video feed catches three, large grayscale humanoid ##red|hands## hanging from the ceiling. The ##red|hands## go unnoticed. The barn slowly starts to fade around the group. Hal honks and pulls on Ryder's pant leg. Ryder abruptly stops speaking and looks around.] **Ryder:** Is it just me or is the barn disappearing? [The rest of the group look around. Zimmerman checks her person to see that she is slowly fading. The ##red|hands## reach the floor of the barn. There is text on the back of each hand that reads, ##red|PRIDE##, ##red|WRATH##, and ##red|LUST##.] **Flynn:** We need to leave. [The team runs out of the barn. Once they exit the barn they become opaque. Ryder turns around to see the ##red|hand "LUST"## at the entrance close to Zimmerman. Both the hand and the barn quickly fade.] **Flynn:** Retrocausal. Who knows where or when the barn is now. Or where or when we could've been. [Ryder is in a state of confusion after seeing the ##red|hand##.] **Zimmerman:** I would rather not think about that. **Ryder:** Did anyone else see that ##red|hand##? **Zimmerman:** The what? [[/div]] On closer observance, Field Researcher Flynn reasserted the fading building was a retrocausal effect. Researcher Zimmerman's studies shown the barn had faded into the light spectrum of an unknown radiation. [[div class="modal"]] __Security Footage.9955.3:__ **Personnel:** Researcher Rebecca Zimmerman **Date:** 05/20/2025 **Time:** 23:51 EST ------ [Zimmerman is in the optics labs. It is late at night and she is going over the data collected from //Investigation Log.9955.2//. She starts to nod, and takes another drink of coffee. After another ten minutes of struggling to remain upright, she hunches over her desk.] [A ##red|hand## appears a few meters away from her. There is text on the ##red|hand## that reads ##red|LUST##. The ##red|hand## lunges at Zimmerman. She falls, and keeps falling-- [[div class="modal"]] [[=image https://scp-wiki.wdfiles.com/local--files/scp-9955/lab.png width="300px"]] She awakes on the ground of an unkempt laboratory. There are yellowing posters on the wall for a community college. She pushes herself upright and rubs her eyes. "This is the lab from my freshman year, what am I doing here?" A new black and white figure appears behind Zimmerman. "Waiting for me sweetie," it smiles. Zimmerman quickly turns around and faces the new figure. "Pamela?" Unseen by both, an albino Labrador exits a storage closet. Figure Two pouts, "What's wrong? Weren't you expecting me? I thought we had planned this little experiment." "You're the reason Michelle left me!" Zimmerman angrily points at Figure Two, "Why would I ever want to get back together with you?" "You couldn't get enough of me babe," it winks, "I knew you'd come back." "I'm 32 years old! I've moved on. How did I get here, and how did you get here?" "Yeah, it has been a long time, huh?" Figure Two steps forward. "I've moved on! Get out of here." It pouts again, "Don't you miss those cold nights in the lab? Cuddling with each other while waiting for our experiments to process?" Zimmerman blushes, "Nostalgia is a poison. I don't need this Pamela!" "Oh, but you do," it takes another step forward, "you need me Rebecca." Zimmerman takes a step back and backs into a table. Objects on the table fall. The dog approaches the pair. "Whatever happened to the cheesy name you used to moan at climax--" "Stop it," she blushes feverishly. It takes a step forward, and trails a finger slowly down Zimmerman's lapel and into her cleavage, "'Pammy Whammy'?" The dog sits next to Zimmerman and whines. Zimmerman turns her head at the source of the noise. Figure Two ignores the dog. "The dæmon," Zimmerman says with awe. She looks at Figure Two, "This isn't real." "What?" Zimmerman pushes Figure Two away from her. The white dog growls and jumps in front of Zimmerman. "You're not Pamela," Zimmerman states. Figure Two looks at the growling dog and then back at Zimmerman, "Just one more night Rebecca..." it begs. Fur on the back of the dog stands up and it barks furiously. More objects are knocked off the table as Figure Two scrambles to leave. It slams the door behind it. Zimmerman and the dog are the only ones left in the room. "Thank you." It wags its tail and happily pants. The lab door opens and there is another figure. This doesn't affect the dog. It remains sitting beside Zimmerman. Zimmerman looks at the dog, "This isn't really Michelle either? Is it?" The happily panting dog gets up and slowly trots to Figure Three. It sits beside it and whines. Her inner thoughtspace[[footnote]]A type of Method of Loci used in psionic construction.[[/footnote]] reverberates with the dog's voice. "You've waited for an opportunity to apologize. This is your opportunity." Zimmerman looks at Figure Three. It gives her a quizzical look. She takes a deep breath, "Do you remember when we took a break? And during that break we were free to see other people?" she shakes her head and rubs seawater from her eyes. "I remember, yes," it solemnly replies. "Even after I broke it off with Pamela, she was stalking me. After you and I got back together, I hoped she would leave me alone but she didn't. She constructed a narrative on social media that I was still in a relationship with her." She looks Michelle in the eyes, "I should've told you about Pamela's harassment before you and I dated again. I apologize for not communicating with you, and I'm sorry for bringing you into the middle of this." Figure Three takes a step forward, "Her posts were too much; the pictures, the videos, the stories, all of it." "She used old pictures, and videos, and made posts from following me." Figure Three sighs, "I wish I had listened to you sooner. I wish I had given you the chance to explain yourself," it shifts its focus toward the dog, "I wish Michelle had given you the chance." Zimmerman cradles herself and the room spins. The dog trots up to her and catches her when she falls. [[/div]] --She lurches over a trash bin and vomits a gray-green fluid.] **Zimmerman:** That tastes like... seawater? [[/div]] Following the events in //Security Footage.9955.3//, Researcher Zimmerman informed Field Researchers Flynn and Ryder of the success of their psionic work. Field Researcher Flynn agreed to teach Researcher Zimmerman rudimentary Thaumaturgy. [[div class="modal"]] __Field Researcher Ryder's personal notes:__ 05/20/2025 Speaking with Zimmerman and Flynn, we believe we've figured out what the spell means. It suggests that the five stars' souls are bound to human bodies but only until death of the hosts. Before that death, the polycult needs to transfer their souls into new hosts or risk returning to their source. That is if their source isn't already dead. This process must require a tremendous amount of thaumaturgic power. Such as, an entire village. I'm not sure if the speed of the star souls traveling back to Earth is limited by the speed of light, but the best we can do is to slow their return. -Researcher Mordecai Ryder [[/div]] Security footage in downtown Holygrove records that at 17:55 EST a lectern appeared in the middle of Holygrove commons. A humanoid dressed in stereotypical Puritan attire stood at the lectern and began speaking and reading from a book. There was no title on the cover or the spine. Pedestrians ignored the speaker for the first five minutes. **Incident.9955.2:** [[div class="blockquote"]] __Security Feed:__ **Date:** 05/21/2025 **Time:** 17:55 EST ------ [[include component:image-block | name=https://scp-wiki.wdfiles.com/local--files/scp-9955/ES-holygrove.png | caption=Still shot taken from Incident.9955.2]] **Speaker:** Enter into its rotting radiance. Fear not crossing the event horizon into the eternal night. [Fungi and flesh start to grow over the pulpit.] **Speaker:** //(reading from book)// Sfymfsnjq 19:7 "The crossing of the undying at the heart of the galaxy, many arms always reaching out, pulling thee, whispering to thee chaotic dreams. It asks thee to repent for thine orderliness. To repent for thine humanity. [The entity raises its arms and looks at the sky.] **Speaker:** Otxjk I 5:25 "Look up and cast thee bodily shell. Look up and let the chaotic soul become one with the dead but dreaming radial." **Speaker:** //(arms return to lectern)// To achieve great things, //(distorted, assumed to be an audiocognitohazard)// thou must first cast aside thine bonds and join the singing of the spheres. [Pedestrians stop and listen. The eyes of listeners closest to the speaker are glazed over and distant. Flesh and fungal tendrils approach them.] **Speaker:** Otxjk II 23:8 "Gluttonous, power hungry, the ego seeks to destroy the decaying soul." **Speaker:** Allow the soul to wander, allow the humanity to leek from thine pores, detach thyself. [All pedestrians listening are in a dissociative state. Sprouts start growing from the civilians closest to the pulpit. People closest to the pulpit throw their heads back as black smoke billows out of their mouth. The smoke hovers over the commons and white-blue ash falls from the hovering smoke. Trees begin to rapidly die, leaving barren trunks and branches.] **Speaker:** Sfymfsnjq 6:65 "The soul is a threat to the Living-Dead One. Ego has been His only gift. His promise of The Death of Sin is a lie. //(more sound distortion thought to be an audiocognitohazard)// Wjfhm tzy yt ymj rtwsnsl xyfw fsi yfpj gfhp dtzw xjwujsy'i ytslzj." [Subjects scratch and tear at their clothes and skin. The sprouts on some of the affected bloom into leeks. Containment Team A-440 arrives and place SRAs around the perimeter of the commons. The speaker ignores the agents and effected subjects close to the agents try to attack them.] [Agent Thalia manages to incapacitate the subjects. Agent Melpomene finishes the final set up of the anchors. A burst of wind knocks Agent Thalia to the ground. The wind pulls more black smoke from the subjects. The listeners closest to the pulpit cease all movement. Leeks stop growing and the subjects stop billowing smoke. The fungi and flesh rapidly spread over them. [Agent Melpomene initiates the anchors. Crackling reverberates through the commons, and crescendos in volume for fifteen seconds. During this time the security footage appears to burn.] **Speaker:** //(distorted)// As Sfymfsnjq said to the idiotic ego when he went out into the world after first flame-- [The entity's voice becomes faint as the anchors adjust liminality back to baseline reality.] **Speaker:** "Kwtr xyfwx dtz htrj, yt xyfwx dtz wjyzws. Hfxy dtzw gtid, fsi qjy ymj xtzq htqqfuxj nsyt f gqfhpmtqj." [An --octarine-- white light over exposes the feed. When the video adjusts, the pulpit and entity are missing. The white-blue ash, and smoke are gone and leaves have returned to the trees. Subjects closest to the agents have passed out, and subjects nearest the pulpit are missing.] [[/div]] After the incident, subjects were unable to comprehend any terrestrial language, and resorted to explosive outbursts when confronted by an unaffected subject. They were brought into Foundation custody for treatment. At this time, there has been no remission in the subjects' conditions. RTF-625 "Street Magicians", was established to further investigation and containment efforts. The task force consisted of Researcher Zimmerman, and Field Researchers Flynn and Ryder. A final investigation was launched with assistance from GoI-1565. [[div class="modal"]] __Investigation Log.9955.3:__ **Personnel Present:** Field Researcher Mordecai Ryder, Field Researcher Aileas Flynn, Researcher Rebecca Zimmerman, Head Magus Xavier D'Arta **Location:** Billington's Wood (Former) **Date:** 05/22/2025 **Time:** 23:34 EST ------ [Ryder, Flynn, Zimmerman, and D'Arta approach the missing village of Billington's Wood. The group carries five pet carriers. They reach the clearing to find a decaying church in the center. Silently, the trio reach the church and they check for wards. Flynn tries the cellar doors and finds them locked. She is unable to dispel the ward or pick the lock. Ryder walks around back, and finds the backdoor to be a painted image. Zimmerman is busy installing SRAs around the church. D'Arta dispels a ward in front of the doors and tries the handle. It is unlocked.] [D'Arta signals for the two other thaumaturges to come to the front door. The trio prepare themselves for entrance. Researcher Zimmerman is almost finished setting up the anchors. Ryder picks up two pet carriers and nods at Zimmerman and she nods back. Flynn and D'Arta, pick up the other pet carriers and enter the church. They enter into an extraplanar space.] [They are in a heavily wooded area with a thin, barely visible path. There is no night sky above them. Instead it is an endless black abyss. In silence, the group march in single file down the path.] **Ryder:** This silence is unnerving. **Flynn:** Quiet down. We don't know what's in the woods. **Ryder:** But that's what's unnerving. I don't hear any animal, I don't hear any wind. Nothing. **Flynn:** All the more reason to remain quiet. [After roughly twenty minutes, chanting and hymns are audible on the recording. The sky above the team fractals with multicolored lights. There are objects in the sky that seem to be stars, but with further study are rotting starfish. The team tread lightly, and approach an open clearing. The opening is surrounded by grayscale forests overlaid with space. The trees vibrate sporadically and there is no permanence. Wind smears the frequencies of life.] [The center of the clearing is an amber altar and a tobacco barn. There is no light visible inside the altar. On closer review, most of the populace of Billington's Wood is inside the barn. The altar is surrounded by twenty-five villagers and it's flanked by two tall burning trees. There is no termination point to them. Closer to the altar are five human cultists and they wear subdued, blue-gray robes. Their backs are to the operatives and on the other side of the altar are five humanoid entities. They appear to be the entities from earlier investigations except they also wear the same blue-gray robes. They chant and do not notice the trio.] [The twenty-five villagers sing the hymns out of tune and Ryder approaches one of them. Recording shows gray, ashen skin, with small leeks sprouting from its pours. He waves his hand in front of its face and it doesn't react. A cultist looks behind him. The thaumaturges hide behind the villagers and remain still. The only occasional movement comes from the contents of the carriers. After a few moments, the cultist looks forward back at the entities. Flynn looks displeased and tugs on Ryder's jacket. The group sneaks to the tree line and position themselves at a better angle toward the altar.] [The five leaders' chanting gets louder; the hymns from the villagers are more dissonant. Ryder ##gold|mumbles## an anti-audiocognitohazard under his breath. Flynn puts in ear plugs, and D'Arta begins whispering "Our Father". The lit trees shift, bend, and arc over the altar. Their fires increase, and the faces of the five humans are clearer. They appear to be in their late 20s.] **Unknown Entity 1:** Xrtpj wnxj, ymj knaj rzxy sty inj-- [The altar collapses on itself, and its image becomes inverted.] **Unknown Entity 2:** Sjb xtzqx rzxy kfij, tqi xtzqx rzxy wjsjb flfns-- [The five human cultists throw back their heads and black smoke rolls out of them.] **Unknown Entity 3:** Ny yfpjx f ytbs yt wfnxj f hmnqi, wnyzfq htsxywzhyji utbjwji gd 500 mzrfsx ijknqji-- [The fires increase. The operatives set the pet carriers down and position them to open between the five humans and the five entities. Smoke slowly billows out of the entities.] **Unknown Entities in unison:** Bnymns ymj nssjw hnwhqj hmtxjs, knaj sjb xtzqx yt gj yfpjs! [The fires suddenly go out, leaving the clearing in darkness. The multicolored firmament does nothing to illuminate the scene. Sounds of the pet carriers opening is heard. Rustling suggests the animals sprinting out of their carriers. When the fires and light returns, black smoke from both the unknown entities and the rabbits are crossing in mid-air above the negative space that was the altar. Smoke reverses back into the human cultists. A few of them are knocked unconscious. The remaining cultists are in shock. The villagers are unfazed.] [Outside the church, Zimmerman watches as the church turns transparent. Image on the video feed doubles and the sky starts to twist into geometric patterns. An albino canine appears beside Zimmerman. It stands on her feet and pants. She pats the dog on the head, and shifts her attention back to the SRAs and turns on them on. The church is still transparent but isn't fading any further. The sky returns to normal but the video feed is still doubled.] [On the extraplane, the rabbits' souls and the entities souls finish exchanging bodies. The rabbits cease their confused sprinting. The unknown entities screech and run toward the black and white tree line. The cultists follow the chaos back to the operatives and shout expletives. D'Arta and Flynn brace themselves for a fight. Ryder ##gold|summons## his familiar. She is much larger than before.] [Ryder directs Hal to herd the new rabbits back into the carriers. Flynn ##gold|whispers## into her hands and summons balls of fire. She tosses them at the cultists. D'Arta deflects a sepia filter and ##gold|summons## an aethereal shield. A cultist absconds Ryder. Ryder decks him.] [Hal succeeds in herding the new rabbits into the pet carriers. Telekinetically, she zips the carriers closed.] [Flynn doesn't duck under a Gaussian blur in time and is cut in the shoulder. She dodges another attack and trips a cultist. D'Arta restrains another cultist while bruises begin to appear on his neck. Ryder turns to assist Flynn but is halted when a massive ##red|hand## decks him. Ryder is knocked back into the missing altar. He trips and his leg is crushed on impact.] [Hal sprints toward the fallen researcher. She jumps and bites the jugular of the cultist who attacked him. Flynn and D'Arta restrain the cultists that had blacked out and then assist Ryder. The cultist who crushed Ryder bleeds out from Hal's bite.] [The entranced villagers continue to stand and remain nonreactive.] [D'Arta and Flynn help Hal place Ryder on Hal's back. Flynn pants and gathers the pet carriers. She quickly heads down the trail back toward the church. D'Arta wakes up the unconscious cultists, and leads all cultists down the path. Sad chirps from Hal are barely audible as she leaves.] [[/div]] Field Researcher Flynn and Head Magus D'Arta were treated for minor injuries. Field Researcher Ryder is being treated for extensive injuries. Due to the overwhelming psychological nature of the events, Field Researchers Flynn and Ryder took a month off from Foundation duties. Field Researcher Flynn sought bi-weekly therapy and attended a confessional booth before every Mass. Field Researcher Ryder joined a support group and fasted for a week while studying the Torah and the Talmud. At approximately 00:05 local time, the town of Billington's Wood returned to its place of origin. On follow up interviews with both locals of the town and adjacent towns, there were no memories of the initial event. The two previously missing GoI-1565 initiates underwent weekly therapy as they were not subject to the reversal of SCP-9955's event. @@ @@ @@ @@ @@ @@ @@ @@ @@ @@ @@ @@ @@ @@ [http://redacted.website More by fairydoctor] @@ @@ [[footnoteblock]] [[div class="footer-wikiwalk-nav"]] [[=]] << [[[SCP-9954]]] | SCP-9955 | [[[SCP-9956]]] >> [[/=]] [[/div]]

SCP-9961.raw_content:
Good tidings to ewwwww, whoever you are.

{$caption}

Item #: SCP-9961

Object Class: Euclid

Special Containment Procedures: Witnesses to SCP-9961 with security clearance below Level 3 have been amnesticized. Personnel at Level 3 or above will adhere to the prearranged cover story, which ends with SCP-9961-1's emotional outburst. Any new briefings on SCP-9961 must be approved by the designated disclosure officer, then co-signed by the Site Director, Assistant Director of Personnel, or an Ethics Committee representative.

SCP-9961-2 will remain under indefinite surveillance. It is expected to attend regular sessions with a substance abuse counselor, and has been strongly discouraged from attending any social function with an open bar.

Description: SCP-9961 was a transformative event that affected Senior Researcher Charles Stafford (retroactively designated SCP-9961-1) during a New Year's Eve party at Site-76.

Executive Complex (Building A, Meeting Room 1)
2025/12/31, 23:57 hours

The room has been decorated with balloons and tinsel. Festive music plays in the background. An overhead projector displays the current time down to the second.

Thirty-eight staff members are in attendance, clustered in various groups; SCP-9961-1 is visible in the crowd, drinking from a disposable cup.

Dr. Christopher Nguyen, Department of Biology: I'm telling you, 2026 is the year I get back on track. I'm gonna hit the gym three times a week, minimum.

Ivan Borkowski, Geology: I'll see you there! Heck, I'll be your spotter. How about you, Joan? Any New Year's resolutions?

Dr. Joan Goderich, Analytics: Oh, no. I don't do those. Statistically, less than 10% of people actually stick with their resolutions, long-term. There are better ways to change your life.

Zachary Villalobos, Sociology: Well, I'm going to quit smoking.

Borkowski: Again?

Villalobos: Practice makes perfect!

Both men laugh heartily.

Officer Brad Prior, Security: I'm planning to read one hundred books. At least a hundred. (pause) Yeah.

Dr. Hamish Day, Astronomy: I really want to crack SCP-341 this year.

Olivia Price, Theology: You say that every year.

Dr. Day: Because there's an explanation! I know it!

SCP-9961-1 pushes through the crowd to refill his cup from the punch bowl. His gait is unsteady and his face is flushed; he is obviously intoxicated.

Price: As for me… I'm going to try to reconcile with my wife. I know it's a long shot, but for the kids' sake-

SCP-9961-1: (shouting) Aw, just divorce that bitch already!

The crowd falls silent.

Dr. Day: Jesus, Chuck, what's wrong with you?

SCP-9961-1: Everything! Everything's wrong. (sobbing) I'm a failure.

Attendees murmur. Most try to ignore the outburst in favor of watching the clock.

Villalobos: Was he, uh… (tips hand to imitate drinking) pregaming?

Dr. Goderich: Odds seem good.

Price: Oh, hush, you two. Charles… I can't imagine what you're going through right now, but-

SCP-9961-1: I didn't do anything important this year. I haven't done anything with my life.1 I screwed everything up.

Price: But, ah, if you'd like to sit down somewhere and talk-

SCP-9961-1: Why bother? I can't do anything right. I'm alone.

Various: (in unison) Ten… nine…

Dr. Nguyen: Oop! Here we go, here we go. Six! Five!

SCP-9961-1: I wish… (hiccuping) I wish I could just start over. You know? Just…

Various: Three… two… one… Happy New Year!

At exactly 00:00, SCP-9961-1 throws up onto the refreshment table, spraying appetizers with half-digested food. Pretzels fall to the ground. Bystanders recoil. Price shrieks.

Borkowski: Ugh.

Dr. Day: What the hell, man?

SCP-9961-1 wheezes, then doubles over, hands on his knees, and vomits on the floor. This time, the ejecta is stained dark red with blood.

Price: Lord have mercy.

Officer Prior: Give him room!

Dr. Nguyen: What was in that punch? (shouting) Was there something in the punch?!2

Witnesses scatter. SCP-9961-1 continues vomiting. After six seconds of continuous ejection, dark blood is supplanted by yellow bile; after fourteen seconds, SCP-9961-1 begins expelling his own entrails, which audibly sizzle on contact with air. His body starts dehydrating rapidly.

Security Officer Prior sounds the evacuation alarm. Attendees proceed to the nearest safe room in an orderly fashion, with the exception of Assistant Director Michael Thurman, who stands clear and watches SCP-9961 with detached interest.

Having regurgitated his entire digestive system, SCP-9961-1 is visibly desiccated, with hollow eyes and sunken cheeks. His lower abdomen appears concave. He heaves one last time, but with nothing else to disgorge, the force of this muscle contraction crushes SCP-9961-1's torso. Bone fragments and discolored teeth drop from his lips. The body slumps forward, tips over into the viscera, and both dissolve into a steaming mass of tissue.

Six Tactical Response Officers wearing biohazard gear enter the room. One of them escorts Assistant Director Thurman to safety while the others establish a perimeter and await containment technicians.

Over the course of six minutes, the biomass congeals into an ovoid shape. It distends gradually under internal pressure, then splits lengthwise. A naked adult male (SCP-9961-2) rises from the sac, dripping organic slurry.

SCP-9961-2: (calmly) I should learn to play an instrument.

Testing confirmed that SCP-9961-2 is completely identical to SCP-9961-1, possessing all of the same memories, skills, and physical traits. It has no exceptional resistance to injury or amnestic treatment, and as such, its memory of the event has been modified.

Further investigations proved inconclusive. On-site sensors did not detect the anomaly; SCP-9961-1 had no direct contact with anomalous materials in the preceding eight months, and had no reported conditions outside of seasonal depression. Absent clear evidence of a catalyst, SCP-9961 is considered a unique event.

Given Senior Researcher Stafford's importance within the Department of History, SCP-9961-2 has been allowed to continue its work under the illusion that it is SCP-9961-1. In the unlikely event of another incident, this policy will be re-evaluated.

Addendum: As of 2027/01/01, SCP-9961-2 has not dedicated any time towards learning a musical instrument.

Footnotes
1. This is factually inaccurate. Senior Researcher Stafford was deeply involved in the research and containment of eighteen SCP objects throughout his career with the Department of History, including [REDACTED].
2. Forensic analysis found that all refreshments were contaminant-free.
