Our veins may run open, but our blood will never run dry!

"Brazil: Love it or Leave it", the government's slogan from 1960 to 1970.

Item #: SCP-9964

Object Class: Babel1

Security Clearance: Level 5/Thaumiel

Special Containment Procedures: In a joint effort with the Central Intelligence Agency and the Federal Government of Brazil, the Department of Continuity has established a program of surveillance throughout all Brazilian broadcast services, in order to intercept any instances of SCP-9964. All intercepted broadcasts are to be infused with the Antimemetic Agent God, Nation, and Family to mitigate the aftereffects of a possible exposure.

In combination with this, the Brazilian Branch of the SCP Foundation is to investigate and confront anti-Veil organizations operating within the country to disrupt the chain of events following exposure to SCP-9964, with particular attention given to the activities of Insurgência do Caos – Sol Vermelho,2 which declared war on Normalcy in 1983.

Should an anti-Veil movement seize political power in Brazil, the country’s Armed Forces shall immediately operate under the direction of the Department of Continuity.

Description: SCP-9964 is the collective designation for anomalous television broadcasts of Brazilian clubs and National Team football matches from 1967 to 1982. These transmissions manifest spontaneously in national television signals after the conclusion of sports or cultural programming. 7,323 instances of SCP-9964 have been detected as of writing, becoming more prominent after each year.

Although SCP-9964 broadcasts closely resemble their non-anomalous counterparts and often lead to the same outcomes, notable deviations have been identified throughout time. Documented examples may diverge from one another and include, but are not limited to:

• The absence of a crowd;

• If present, the crowd consists of military leaders, landowners, and businessmen from the 1964–85 administration,3 or numerous faceless humanoid figures;

Ademir da Guia, an iconic footballer for Sociedade Esportiva Palmeiras, prior to missing a shot against Clube de Regatas Vasco da Gama during an SCP-9964 broadcast. Eyes are absent, and the subject’s jaw is detaching gradually.

• The commentators are unaware of the players' names;

• The footballers and coaches from both teams are wounded,4 severely disfigured or missing limbs;

• The players do not break for half-time;

The Brazilian team before their match against Peru at the 1970 World Cup, as seen in an SCP-9964 instance. The Brazilian players never kicked off in this anomalous iteration, remaining unmoving for the entire match while Peru took advantage and won 41–0.

• There are no referees, although fouls are still given automatically;

• A player may spontaneously distance themselves from the field and stare at the stands, whether or not a crowd is present, thus remaining absent for the rest of the match;

• A player may deliberately fail to score when presented with a clear opportunity;

• A player may deliberately begin to walk off the field aimlessly while the match is still ongoing;

• The transmission lacks sound.

Upon exposure, 91% of subjects reported severe distress regarding the conditions of Brazilian workers under the business-military regime and subsequently engaged in deeper study of Brazilian history from a far-left perspective. Of these, 80% would later join an organization aligned to that political spectrum.

For all intents and purposes, the circumstances described above render SCP-9964 a high-risk political instrument for anti-Normalcy groups.

A transcription of an SCP-9964 broadcast is attached below.

VIDEO LOG

1977 Brazilian Championship Final

Atlético Mineiro 0 - 0 São Paulo

DATE: 5 March 1978

ATTENDANCE: 102,974

STADIUM: Mineirão, Belo Horizonte - Minas Gerais

REFEREE: Arnaldo Cézar Coelho - Rio Janeiro

ATLÉTICO MINEIRO: João Leite; Alves, Márcio, Vantuir, Valdemir; Toninho Cerezo, Ângelo, Marcelo (substituted by Paulo Isidoro); Serginho, Caio (substituted by Joãozinho Paulista), Ziza; coach Barbatana.

SÃO PAULO: Waldir Peres; Getúlio, Tecão, Bezerra, Antenor; Chicão, Teodoro (substituted by Peres), Darío Pereyra; Viana (substituted by Neca), Mirandinha, Zé Sérgio; coach Mário Juliato.

[BEGIN LOG]

00:03: After a draw in regular time, both teams gather to prepare for the penalty shootout. All players appear exhausted.

01:45: The stands are shown. The only spectators are Ernesto Geisel,5 Carlos Alberto Brilhante Ustra,6 and Sérgio Paranhos Fleury.7

02:27: A faceless spectator appears, casually descending from the stands. They walk across the field and head to the locker room. No one seems to notice.

09:48: The shootout begins.

10:03: Toninho Cerezo scores. He does not celebrate. Footsteps echo loudly from the locker room. Only Alves seems to notice.

10:51: Getúlio misses.

11:42: Ziza does not take the shot. Instead, he celebrates as if he had scored and returns to his teammates, who applaud.

13:08: A police officer is now seen outside of the locker room as the noises grow louder.

28:21: Chicão takes the ball in his hands while another police officer appears outside the locker room. The sound of a non-existent crowd mumbling overtakes the broadcast.

29:02: While Chicão scores, the referee rules the shot invalid and instructs him to retake it. This process is repeated until he ultimately misses. Despite this, Chicão celebrates.

40:10: An entire row of police officers surrounds the entrance to the locker room. The spectators stand up.

41:22: Alves approaches the goal area, positioning the ball while taking a deep breath. He seems to hesitate, then stops moving.

42:47: The referee is nowhere to be seen.

43:08: Alves remains unmoving.

51:30: The other players await anxiously, although the penalty is never taken.

The broadcast abruptly ended after 19 hours.

[END LOG]

Addendum.01: Discovery

1972 Sociedade Esportiva Palmeiras team seen through the first discovered instance of SCP-9964.

Following the ending of the business-military cycle, rumors of SCP-9964 began to circulate among the civilian population. Foundation personnel would not succeed in observing the anomaly until December 5, 1999, when it was documented through two main courses of action:

• The capture and execution of two Sol Vermelho operatives, resulting in the confiscation of recorded tapes of the broadcasts

• Investigation via Brazil’s emerging internet to locate the anomaly on paranormal-focused forums such as Parawatch

Excerpts of the latter are provided below.

matheus68 12/05/99 03:55:12

since we're sharing our experiences, i'd like to go into detail about something that happened to me last week.

final is approaching, and i wanted to watch some of the past corinthians games to get in the mood for it.

so while searching on my tv, i noticed sportv was transmitting the semifinals against são paulo again. no better way to enjoy myself than rewatching the games where we beat one of our rivals, right?

not really.

i fell asleep at the end of the second match, and there was something weird going on with the tv when i woke up. keep in mind it was 2 am at the time and i was in complete darkness.

it seemed like a 70s grenal8 match but everything was out of place.

there was no crowd. no sound but a slight static. the players had no eyes and the coaches wouldn't stop clapping (i think i could hear it sometimes but i'm not sure). but you know what freaked me out the most?

the cops. i despise the cops.

where the goalkeepers should've been, there they were: marching the whole time, but without actually moving. every time a player got close to the goal, they'd just back off.

that’s it. that was the entire game. when i switched to another channel then back to sportv, it was gone. it had never existed at all.

those fuckers ruined my life, so i couldn't get back to sleep. my father had connections to the resistance,. i was 5 when they got him at home.

i never saw him again after he entered that car, but he was smiling. i don't think he could convince himself it would be alright, but he tried to convince me.

my mother tried everything she could to get him back, but the same thing happened. except they let me see her again. broken, incapable of speaking, but my mother nonetheless.

she could barely walk at the time. once i got older and realized why that was, i felt sick to my stomach. she was certainly not the only one, and i never got to look at my brother the same way.

sometimes i question myself if there was an actual dictatorship, because it all feels too "normal" now. and they shouldn't. fuck no, things aren't normal in the slightest. they never were.

i've been voting for brizola9 for president since 89, but i doubt someone like him could ever get there. if he did, we'd probably just relive the past.

anaAMaria 12/05/99 04:02:10

I had a similar experience 4 months ago, though I wouldn't say it was as bad as yours.

In my case, it was the 1982 São Paulo Championship final, Corinthians against São Paulo. Looking back, it feels pretty ironic. Corinthians was “the team of democracy” then, openly opposing the regime and everything.

In the middle of the field was their star player, Sócrates. He had the ball, but policemen surrounded him so tightly he couldn’t move. The others were moving just like in the original match, but since they didn’t have the ball, the score never changed.

By the end of the second half, everyone had stopped but the crowd of army officers weeping quietly. I’d kept watching out of curiosity, but that felt too wrong, I guess, so I got up and turned off the TV.

I vividly remember the players looking at me through the screen just before it went dark.

Overall, football’s felt… gloomier since then. Going to Maraca10 ain’t the same.

vivaSP_@ 12/05/99 05:30:55

Hello folks!

These stories are haunting, both for their normal and their paranormal aspects. Reality is scarier than fiction, as some may say…

Particularly, I am very sorry for your mother @matheus68 :/

Even though none of those monsters faced proper punishment, I’m just glad we’re a democracy again

My grandma teared up the day she got to cast her vote in '89! ;) Too bad it was for Collor…11

Carlão_jazz 12/05/99 08:00:03

I’m happy for her @viva_SP@, but what the dictatorship did to everyone is what has been done to Black people since the first slave ship arrived here.

I agree we can’t forget it. I agree we can’t let it happen again. But why did it happen in the first place? Why didn’t "redemocratization" stop the violence in our communities?

Just look at Vigário Geral. A death squad of hooded policemen stormed the favela and executed 21 people. The killers are still out there. They'll do it again. And this is just one case.

ÉoJoão_70 12/05/99 17:11:24

My turn to get personal.

I agree with @Carlão_jazz here. The dictatorship was the culmination of the tragedy called Brazil, but that's because they were open about who was going to die the next day.

You see, my mom spent most of her life as a rural laborer. Her closest friend was killed when the police and local farmers attacked a group of fellow landless workers.

That was six months ago. All they did was occupying unproductive land, and those bastards even got a child, for Christ's sake.

Since then, mom's thrown herself into countless organizations fighting for land rights. Even though her life could be taken at any moment, she’s never felt more alive. She's now daily training capoeira12 for self-defense.

I don't think there's any other option to us at this point. Existence is resistance, even when you don't want it to be.

Addendum.02: Timeline of Events

The following timeline details key events in which the Department of Continuity intervened directly in Brazil’s political sphere to safeguard the Veil and advance the Foundation’s strategic interests.

December 17, 1939

President Getúlio Vargas and Mobile Task Force "Brazil Happy Again" after the Foundation arrived in the country for the first time.

Objective: Establish the first Foundation bases on Brazilian territory under the leadership of the Department of Continuity. Ensure that the industrialization policies of President Getúlio Vargas’ government remain dependent on the United States. Investigate and study Brazil’s paranormal phenomena to gain a deeper understanding of thaumaturgy.

Outcome: Success.

February 13, 1945

Objective: Fund opposition to President Getúlio Vargas as he signals greater independence. Establish the first Brazilian operational facility for D-Class personnel in response to the growth of the local Chaos Insurgency and similar movements.

Outcome: Success.

March 4, 1947

Objective: Support President Eurico Gaspar Dutra in enforcing the re-illegalization of the Brazilian Communist Party. Conduct amnestical studies on unregistered subjects in the rural areas of Brazil. Initiate the integration of favelas into the D-Class network.

Outcome: Success.

September 2, 1961

Objective: Prevent João Goulart from assuming the presidency. Transfer federal control to the Armed Forces. Immediately eliminate the local Chaos Insurgency.

Outcome: Failure. Leonel Brizola allied with local police forces and leveraged his political power as a governor to organize widespread opposition against the Foundation’s interests. He also threatened the Department of Continuity through the use of thaumaturgical capabilities. The Chaos Insurgency is believed to have been responsible for Brizola acquiring thaumaturgical knowledge in the first place.

April 1, 1964

Objective: Coordinate the Armed Forces with the Central Intelligence Agency in the deposal of President João Goulart. Establish the Brazilian Superintendence for the Paranormal. Immediately eliminate all local anti-Veil organizations.

Outcome: Undetermined. Although the junta has seized power, threats to Normalcy have persisted, and anti-Foundation elements successfully expelled MTF "Brazil Happy Again" from the favela complex, ultimately ending the integration project.

May 17, 1969

Objective: Institute thaumaturgy as part of the training for personnel in intelligence services. Expand D-Class facilities. Advance the understanding and application of amnestics to the next thaumaturgical step, by manipulating reality itself to erase the memory of the individual.

Outcome: Success.

November 14, 1973

General Ernesto Geisel and Department of Continuity liaison Frederick Portel Ashmoon.

Objective: Assist the Armed Forces in its operations at the Araguaia Guerrilla War.13 Distribute the newly developed amnestic technology to other Latin American branches in preparation for Operation Condor.

Outcome: Success.

January 3, 1977

MTF "Brazil Happy Again" agent fatally shot in the head by Commander Clarissa Falcão during a conflict.

Objective: Eliminate the Sol Vermelho faction.

Outcome: Failure.

November 18, 1982

Objective: Support and fund emerging democratic movements in opposition to radical factions. Oppose the military-business junta and advocate for direct elections. Commence document disposal.

Outcome: Success.

November 15, 1985

Objective: Ensure that no judicial procedures are carried out against those associated with the business-military junta.

Outcome: Success.

October 2, 2015

Jair Bolsonaro serving as a federal deputy for the Progressists, 2013.

Objective: Support Jair Messias Bolsonaro as a rising political figure opposing the Workers' Party.14 Leverage the opposition’s efforts to impeach President Dilma Rousseff. Suppress SCP-9964.

Outcome: Success.

January 17, 2018

Objective: Ensure the election of Jair Messias Bolsonaro as the next President of Brazil.

Outcome: Success.

The following is a transcript of an excerpt from a conversation held between Jair Bolsonaro and Foundation liaison Frederick Ashmoon on 28 October, 2018, after Bolsonaro’s victory over Fernando Haddad of the Workers' Party in the general elections.

AUDIO LOG

Bolsonaro walking with Ashmoon upon his arrival in Brasília.

[BEGIN LOG]

ASHMOON: Good evening, Mr. President. I have to say this wonderful place has not changed in the slightest.

BOLSONARO: Good evening, sir. It's a pleasure to have people like you here. I hope you enjoy the view as it is now, it took hours to clear the petistas15 from the streets.

ASHMOON: Of course.

Ashmoon chuckles. Bolsonaro looks around before following Ashmoon to a meeting room.

ASHMOON: First of all, how are you feeling? Tonight is a historic occasion. Sixteen years of opposition — and now they are the ones opposing you.

BOLSONARO: I'm relieved. From now on, I can't picture my beloved country as anything other than what God intended it to be: a free land, in the same fashion as the United States, far from school indoctrination and harmful ideologies. I'd say we've never been this close to greatness since 1964.

Ashmoon coughs, then takes a sip of water from his glass while keeping his eyes on Bolsonaro.

ASHMOON: Those were the times, were they not? Now you get to shape an equally decisive turning point for this country. Your vision of a superior nation is the attitude we expect from those who will work with the SCP Foundation.

BOLSONARO: Yes, your Foundation. I suppose I could finally know who exactly you are?

ASHMOON: Of course, Mr. President. But I would like to hear from you first. I believe you have known of the Foundation for a while now?

BOLSONARO: I became aware of it back at military academy. From what I got, you had strong ties to the government at the time, got rid of the problems, and had this thing of containing “dangerous magic” to keep humanity safe, since we can't understand it.

ASHMOON: You have been misinformed, Mr. President. But for you to assume such a thing is ultimately our fault.

Bolsonaro remains silent for a few seconds.

BOLSONARO: I see. I'm sorry.

ASHMOON: There is no need for apologies. It is important that a few groups hold that image of us, after all.

Bolsonaro scratches his eyebrows.

BOLSONARO: Sorry, sir, but you’re confusing me a bit here. Didn't you promise to help me protect Brazil and drive away the Devil's power?

ASHMOON: We are a force of order, Mr. President. We make sure that whatever people aren't meant to see stays in the dark with us.

BOLSONARO: That's good to hear in a sense. But what about that "magic" part?

ASHMOON: It is a fact that we are aware of what you label “supernatural”. But to say we do not comprehend it is untrue.

BOLSONARO: You can use magic then.

ASHMOON: Everything in this world is meant to be broken down into base elements and made ordinary. That is not a problem for us.

BOLSONARO: But if you understand it, why would you bother? That seems a waste of time.

Quarentinha Braga, an iconic Paysandu Sport Club player, attempts to entertain the crowd during an SCP-9964 broadcast.

ASHMOON: I ask you to think abroad, Mr. President. That will be crucial for the following years of our Brazilian democracy. What if people similar to the petistas follow this path of discovery, or feel motivated by this "magic"?

BOLSONARO: Is that happening in Brazil right now? Is Lula16 involved?

ASHMOON: He is not. We believe this case is far more concerning than Lula's, Mr. President.

Ashmoon begins tapping his fingers against the table.

ASHMOON: A certain group of… people, have been using this power inadvertently to spread the idea that Brazil could be something it is not.

BOLSONARO: Since when?

ASHMOON: 1976, when the political openness began under General Ernesto Geisel.

Ashmoon stops.

ASHMOON: This is why your presence matters, Mr. President. You embody the memory of times of Normalcy, fundamental for peace.

Bolsonaro gives a slight smile.

BOLSONARO: My middle name is Messias for a reason, my friend. You can count on me.

[END LOG]

February 13, 2019

Objective: Restructure the Foundation’s previous position against terrorism. Advance operations against anti-Veil organizations. Suppress SCP-9964.

Outcome: Failure. One base in the state of Pará was lost to Sol Vermelho.

February 25, 2020

Objective: Ensure that the Bolsonarist administration does not implement a pandemic response to undermine the activity of Sol Vermelho. Suppress SCP-9964.

Outcome: SCP-9964 has grown in influence.

January 1, 2022

Objective: Ensure that the opposition is unable to vote in the upcoming general elections. Guarantee the reelection of Jair Bolsonaro. Suppress SCP-9964.

Outcome: Failure.

On 15 January 2023, one week after supporters of Jair Bolsonaro attacked Brazil’s federal government buildings in response to the inauguration of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva as the country’s 39th President, Ashmoon was dispatched to Brazil to sever ties with Bolsonaro indefinitely.

AUDIO LOG

[BEGIN LOG]

ASHMOON: Mr. Bolsonaro, we are afraid that your past decisions have made it impossible for the Foundation to continue working with you.

BOLSONARO: How come? You have to believe me here. Under no circumstances I would've lost.

Ashmoon doesn't answer.

BOLSONARO: Frederick, you're stressing me out.

ASHMOON: Pardon me. Frederick?

BOLSONARO: Yes, you, Frederick. You don't see me as the worthy ally I am.

ASHMOON: You could have waited for our evaluation, as discussed. Then retreated briefly in order to reconstruct your political career and possibly win the next elections. You should not have relied on your supporters to keep you in a position you had already lost.

BOLSONARO: I would never sit idly by and watch while my people cry out for help. Don't judge me when there is a real chance for communism — for SCP-9964 — to take over my nation and lead our children down a path of depravity!

Bolsonaro pounds the table in front of him.

BOLSONARO: I blame this on the Chinese! They created a disease that killed those who did not exercise properly, and the blame fell on me for not buying a vaccine that could turn you into a reptile!

The invasion of the National Congress Palace.

Bolsonaro sighs. Ashmoon glances at his wristwatch.

BOLSONARO: So what now? Are you people working with Lula?

ASHMOON: We must come to terms with him to ensure he does not disrupt our activities.

BOLSONARO: You don't. Oh, you don't.

ASHMOON: As someone of Italian descent, Mr. Bolsonaro, you should know that an idea can live even if a man dies. We still believe there is potential in your movement, albeit under different leadership.

BOLSONARO: But I was the one who did it! All of it! Do you think this Foundation of yours can do everything alone?! You can't leave me behind!

ASHMOON: I reiterate: someone else will carry the green, blue, and yellow flag that you care for so deeply. There is no need to worry.

Bolsonaro approaches Ashmoon.

BOLSONARO: Look at the current situation in this country. The people love me. They want me. They voted for me!

Silence for a few seconds.

BOLSONARO: I have become the greatest leader of Brazil! This is the best opportunity to cement our position!17

ASHMOON: It is the best opportunity for the entire world, in fact. We are confident that Mr. Trump will win our next elections, and his presence alone will be enough to strengthen Bolsonarism and alike.

BOLSONARO: I'm not talking about that, you–

Ashmoon stands up and begins to walk off.

BOLSONARO: Look at me! This is our chance to secure the future of Brazil! Of the people!

ASHMOON: Please, detach yourself from us.

Bolsonaro tries to advance, but freezes.

BOLSONARO: We both know I'm not the Foundation's enemy. You'll have to come back.

ASHMOON: Mr. Bolsonaro, be aware that it may be dangerous to be an enemy of the Foundation, but to be a former friend is fatal.

[END LOG]

Following this conversation, at 11:23 PM, Frederick Ashmoon proceeded to the Brasília International Airport. While awaiting departure, he was ambushed by a unit of the Sol Vermelho faction acting under the orders of Commander Clarissa Falcão. Communication was lost shortly thereafter.

Addendum.03: The Chaos Insurgency in Brazil

The first Chaos Insurgency units in Brazil were founded in 1939 through an alliance of anarchists, nationalists and communists connected to esoteric practices, in opposition to the persecution by President Getúlio Vargas’s dictatorial government, as well as in response to the arrival of the first Foundation cells.

In the early years of the business-military junta cycle, the organization gained its contemporary notoriety by directing an insurgent process that seized three Foundation operational bases located in Northern Brazil, freeing dissidents who had been detained by the government.

Under the direction of Mirella Cruz and Hugo Lisboa, it is believed that 3,100 personnel were mobilized for armed combat against Foundation officers. In 1976, following the split that gave rise to Sol Vermelho, two of these bases were retained, and 91% of the former D-Class personnel decided to join the faction. The technological innovations currently employed by Sol Vermelho are likely the result of all the material and research stolen during this conflict, including paratechnology likely used to facilitate the manifestation of SCP-9964.

Commanders Mirella Cruz and Hugo Lisboa alongside the recently freed D-Class personnel Clarissa Falcão, following the conquering of a Foundation operative base on June 27, 1969.

Following their declaration of war, Sol Vermelho would advance to seize 17 additional Foundation bases and intervene in all attempts to investigate local supernatural phenomena. Recent studies indicate that the total number of organized members is 19,500.

The Sol Vermelho's main propaganda vehicles are the newspaper The People's Front and clandestine radio channels concealed by paranormal codification. One example of each is available below.

THE PEOPLE'S FRONT

DATE: November 26, 2023

NOTE: The interview below has been recovered from an international issue of The People's Front newspaper. It was conducted by Communist militant Luzia Tchissola, from the Red Faction of Angola's Chaos Insurgency. The interviewed is Commander Mirella Cruz, who had employed advanced thaumaturgy to halt aging, similar to her companions.

TCHISSOLA: What are the main differences between the Sol Vermelho and other Chaos Insurgency groups when it comes to opposition to the Foundation?

CRUZ: Our organization stems from a fundamental divergence regarding the existence of the Foundation itself. To us, the destruction of the Foundation should equate to the destruction of United States' imperialism in its entirety, as the greatest enemy of the Brazilian people for decades now.

TCHISSOLA: Could you explain how that came to be?

CRUZ: Once the first alliances were forged in 1939, the consensus was that the Foundation itself embodied the main contradiction we faced. However, when it thoroughly aided the military in their rise to power — with the backing of our landowners, bankers and industrialists — it became clear that we couldn't oppose their rule while treating them as a separate force from the system.

TCHISSOLA: And how was the Sol Vermelho faction born in the first place?

CRUZ: Following our heroic victories against the reactionaries, a right-wing opposition within our organization argued that we should retreat so as not to “advance recklessly.” Although every subsequent encounter with the Foundation proved successful, the Red Massacre would be invoked as a pretext to undermine our achievements. When a vote was ultimately held to decide whether our current tactics should be abandoned or not, the split materialized. We don't regret it in the slightest.

TCHISSOLA: When the Chaos Insurgency is now described as an “instrument to liberate the people,” does this necessarily imply a violent movement?

The three main symbols incorporated by the Sol Vermelho faction.

CRUZ: We do make history, but not of our own choosing. We make history according to the conditions imposed by the world around us. Make no mistake: we desire the end of all wars. Yet how does one fight an army without an army of their own? Any accusation that the people are violent is itself a confession. Simply put, you cannot vote the O5 Council out.

TCHISSOLA: But when the Chaos Insurgency assists the people in their liberation, is this carried out from an aristocratic perspective?

CRUZ: Never. Transformation simply demands that those who are prepared in advance equally prepare those who aren't. We want to help. Think of the Chaos Insurgency as a seed, while the people constitute the fertile soil that will allow this new world to flourish.

TCHISSOLA: Do you think this revolutionary movement will be successful?

CRUZ: What I think doesn't matter. What matters is that those who fight alongside me continue the struggle, even if the enemies' bullets make me physically disappear. You see, the masses can never be destroyed in their entirety. And no tsunami will be turned back once the earthquake has struck.

TCHISSOLA: If the Brazilian revolutionary movement succeeds, what becomes of the Chaos Insurgency? What can guarantee its victory will last?

CRUZ: History has shown us that movements like ours do not succeed merely by seizing political power. The transformation must be cultural, too. The fundamental mission of our vanguard, once the tools to reshape society are placed in the hands of the masses — the only ones capable of wielding them — is to demonstrate a new way of thinking it.

TCHISSOLA: Could that mean a free Brazil would try to force its neighbors to follow the same path because of cultural tensions?

CRUZ: I'm sorry, but that's laughable.

TCHISSOLA: Could you elaborate?

CRUZ: Of course we want our neighbors to go the same route, but that's not up to us. Brazil will assist the masses against the many imperialist threats — the United States, China, Russia, Israel, the United Kingdom, and so on — but only when a proper mass movement exists to begin with. If the people don't call for a revolution now, if there's no vanguard to guide them, what's the point? We're not adventurers.

TCHISSOLA: What if power is retaken by the old world? Is there any hope for the revolution?

CRUZ: The ideological transformation is intended to prepare the masses for counterattack. Every oppressed individual is a revolutionary, and every revolutionary must know how to wield their weapon.

TCHISSOLA: What are your weapons, Ms. Cruz?

CRUZ: We’ve been training our warriors in thaumaturgy for decades, and we’ve also learned to harness the power of the memories imposed on us by the reactionaries. That, without a doubt, is our greatest achievement so far.

TCHISSOLA: How come?

CRUZ: The rage carried from generation to generation has now taken a life of its own — and it will haunt them. Forever. This is what they’ve named SCP-9964.

TCHISSOLA: Considering everything you've just said, what will happen if the masses are rendered powerless following the revolution?

CRUZ: The new society will be crushed. Simple as that. Terror will rise again, masquerading as a mass movement while crushing the people under its boot. And still, I know hope won’t be lost, because it will find a way to be reborn.

TCHISSOLA: Before we conclude, I'd like to thank you for your time, Ms. Cruz. You're a very kind woman. Do you have any final thoughts you would like to share with our readers?

CRUZ: The pleasure is all mine! Modern times are reminding the people that change is inevitable. We believe the red sun will shine, again and again, as many times as necessary, across the globe. Either we're all free, or no one is.

[END LOG]

I now address all the Brazilian people who have endured more suffering than they could bear.

I address the workers, poor peasants, students, teachers, journalists and intellectuals, priests and bishops, the youth, and the women of Brazil.

What you have just witnessed is your heart unmasked!

Through termination, decommissioning, or memory wiping, the group known as the SCP Foundation has blinded millions of eyes that were born to see for far too long.

The oppressed do not dare to break the cycle anymore. They have announced time and again that is the only possible outcome.

Let the rage within you rise. Know that your place is anywhere but where you are now. Stand up and fight against imperialism as the Devil that torments Brazil cannot see how his own inferno boils and now turns against him!

This is our chance, for nothing is permanent! There is no structure in this world that will not, one day, return to dust!

Our veins may run open, but our blood will never run dry!

Raise the Veil! Raise the Masses! Raze the Foundation!

[[div class="blockquote" style="border-radius: 10px; margin: 10px; overflow: auto;"]] **December 17, 1939** ----- [[include component:image-block |name=https://scp-sandbox-3.wdfiles.com/local--files/comunista-lesbica-local/Get%C3%BAlio_Vargas_1930.jpg |caption=President Getúlio Vargas and Mobile Task Force "Brazil Happy Again" after the Foundation arrived in the country for the first time. |width=50% |align=right]] **Objective:** Establish the first Foundation bases on Brazilian territory under the leadership of the Department of Continuity. [[/div]] [[div class="blockquote" style="border-radius: 10px; margin: 10px; overflow: auto;"]] **November 14, 1973** ----- [[include component:image-block |name=https://scp-sandbox-3.wdfiles.com/local--files/comunista-lesbica-local/Ernesto_Beckmann_Geisel_e_Jos%C3%A9_Adauto_Bezerra%2C_governador_do_Estado_do_Cear%C3%A1%2C_Bras%C3%ADlia%2C_DF_BR_RJANRIO_EH_0_FOT_PRP_10378_d0001de0001-1.png |caption=General Ernesto Geisel and Department of Continuity liaison Frederick Portel Ashmoon. |width=50% |align=right]] **Objective:** Assist the Armed Forces in its operations at the Araguaia Guerrilla War.[[footnote]]An armed movement in Brazil against the government active between 1967 and 1974 in the Araguaia river basin.[[/footnote]] Distribute the newly developed amnestic technology to other Latin American branches in preparation for Operation Condor. **Outcome:** Success. [[/div]] The following is a transcript of an excerpt from a conversation held between Jair Bolsonaro and Foundation liaison Frederick Ashmoon on 28 October, 2018, after Bolsonaro’s victory over Fernando Haddad of the Workers' Party in the general elections. [[div class="blockquote"]] = **AUDIO LOG** ---- [[include component:image-block |name=https://scp-sandbox-3.wdfiles.com/local--files/comunista-lesbica-local/bonoro |caption=Bolsonaro walking with Ashmoon upon his arrival in Brasília. |width=50% |align=right]] [BEGIN LOG] **ASHMOON:** Good evening, Mr. President. I have to say this wonderful place has not changed in the slightest. **BOLSONARO:** Good evening, sir. It's a pleasure to have people like you here. I hope you enjoy the view as it is now, it took hours to clear the //petistas//[[footnote]]Supporters of the Workers' Party.[[/footnote]] from the streets. **ASHMOON:** Of course. //Ashmoon chuckles. Bolsonaro looks around before following Ashmoon to a meeting room.// **ASHMOON:** First of all, how are you feeling? Tonight is a historic occasion. Sixteen years of opposition — and now they are the ones opposing you. **BOLSONARO:** I'm relieved. From now on, I can't picture my beloved country as anything other than what God intended it to be: a free land, in the same fashion as the United States, far from school indoctrination and harmful ideologies. I'd say we've never been this close to greatness since 1964. //Ashmoon coughs, then takes a sip of water from his glass while keeping his eyes on Bolsonaro.// **ASHMOON:** Those were the times, were they not? Now you get to shape an equally decisive turning point for this country. Your vision of a superior nation is the attitude we expect from those who will work with the SCP Foundation. **BOLSONARO:** Yes, your Foundation. I suppose I could finally know who exactly you are? **ASHMOON:** Of course, Mr. President. But I would like to hear from you first. I believe you have known of the Foundation for a while now? **BOLSONARO:** I became aware of it back at military academy. From what I got, you had strong ties to the government at the time, got rid of the problems, and had this thing of containing “dangerous magic” to keep humanity safe, since we can't understand it. **ASHMOON:** You have been misinformed, Mr. President. But for you to assume such a thing is ultimately our fault. //Bolsonaro remains silent for a few seconds.// **BOLSONARO:** I see. I'm sorry. **ASHMOON:**  There is no need for apologies. It is important that a few groups hold that image of us, after all. //Bolsonaro scratches his eyebrows.// **BOLSONARO:** Sorry, sir, but you’re confusing me a bit here. Didn't you promise to help me protect Brazil and drive away the Devil's power? **ASHMOON:** We are a force of //order//, Mr. President. We make sure that whatever people aren't meant to see stays in the dark with us. **BOLSONARO:** That's good to hear in a sense. But what about that "magic" part? **ASHMOON:** It is a fact that we are aware of what you label “supernatural”. But to say we do not comprehend it is untrue. **BOLSONARO:** You can use magic then. **ASHMOON:** Everything in this world is meant to be broken down into base elements and made ordinary. That is not a problem for us. **BOLSONARO:** But if you understand it, why would you bother? That seems a waste of time. [[include component:image-block |name=https://scp-sandbox-3.wdfiles.com/local--files/comunista-lesbica-local/paysandu |caption=Quarentinha Braga, an iconic Paysandu Sport Club player, attempts to entertain the crowd during an SCP-9964 broadcast. |width=50% |align=right]] **ASHMOON:** I ask you to think abroad, Mr. President. That will be crucial for the following years of our Brazilian democracy. What if people similar to the //petistas// follow this path of discovery, or feel motivated by this "magic"? **BOLSONARO:** Is that happening in Brazil right now? Is Lula[[footnote]]Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, the leader of the Workers' Party and 35th President of Brazil from 2003 to 2011.[[/footnote]] involved? **ASHMOON:** He is not. We believe this case is far more concerning than Lula's, Mr. President. //Ashmoon begins tapping his fingers against the table.// **ASHMOON:** A //certain group// of... people, have been using this power inadvertently to spread the idea that Brazil could be something it is not. **BOLSONARO:** Since when? **ASHMOON:** 1976, when the political openness began under General Ernesto Geisel. //Ashmoon stops.// **ASHMOON:** This is why your presence matters, Mr. President. You embody the memory of times of Normalcy, fundamental for peace. //Bolsonaro gives a slight smile.// **BOLSONARO:** My middle name is //Messias// for a reason, my friend. You can count on me. ----- [END LOG] [[/div]] [[div class="blockquote" style="border-radius: 10px; margin: 10px"]] **February 13, 2019** ----- **Objective:** Restructure the Foundation’s previous position against terrorism. Advance operations against anti-Veil organizations. Suppress SCP-9964. **Outcome:** Failure. One base in the state of Pará was lost to //Sol Vermelho//. [[/div]] [[div class="blockquote" style="border-radius: 10px; margin: 10px"]] **February 25, 2020** ----- **Objective:** Ensure that the Bolsonarist administration does not implement a pandemic response to undermine the activity of //Sol Vermelho//. Suppress SCP-9964. **Outcome:** SCP-9964 has grown in influence. [[/div]] [[div class="blockquote" style="border-radius: 10px; margin: 10px"]] **January 1, 2022** ----- **Objective:** Ensure that the opposition is unable to vote in the upcoming general elections. Guarantee the reelection of Jair Bolsonaro. Suppress SCP-9964. **Outcome:** Failure. [[/div]] On 15 January 2023, one week after supporters of Jair Bolsonaro attacked Brazil’s federal government buildings in response to the inauguration of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva as the country’s 39th President, Ashmoon was dispatched to Brazil to sever ties with Bolsonaro indefinitely. [[div class="blockquote"]] = **AUDIO LOG** ---- [BEGIN LOG] **ASHMOON:** Mr. Bolsonaro, we are afraid that your past decisions have made it impossible for the Foundation to continue working with you. **BOLSONARO:** How come? You have to believe me here. Under no circumstances I would've lost. //Ashmoon doesn't answer.// **BOLSONARO:** Frederick, you're stressing me out. **ASHMOON:** Pardon me. Frederick? **BOLSONARO:** Yes, you, Frederick. You don't see me as the worthy ally I am. **ASHMOON:** You could have waited for our evaluation, as discussed. Then retreated briefly in order to reconstruct your political career and possibly win the next elections. You should not have relied on your supporters to keep you in a position you had already lost. **BOLSONARO:** I would never sit idly by and watch while my people cry out for help. Don't judge me when there is a real chance for communism — for SCP-9964 — to take over my nation and lead our children down a path of depravity! //Bolsonaro pounds the table in front of him.// **BOLSONARO:** I blame this on the Chinese! They created a disease that killed those who did not exercise properly, and the blame fell on me for not buying a vaccine that could turn you into a reptile! [[include component:image-block |name=https://scp-sandbox-3.wdfiles.com/local--files/comunista-lesbica-local/Ataque_bolsonarista_ao_Congresso_Nacional_do_Brasil.png |caption=The invasion of the National Congress Palace. |width=50% |align=right]] //Bolsonaro sighs. Ashmoon glances at his wristwatch.// **BOLSONARO:** So what now? Are you people working with Lula? **ASHMOON:** We must come to terms with him to ensure he does not disrupt our activities. **BOLSONARO:** You don't. Oh, you don't. **ASHMOON:** As someone of Italian descent, Mr. Bolsonaro, you should know that an idea can live even if a man dies. We still believe there is potential in your movement, albeit under different leadership. **BOLSONARO:** But I was the one who did it! All of it! Do you think this Foundation of yours can do everything alone?! You can't leave me behind! **ASHMOON:** I reiterate: someone else will carry the green, blue, and yellow flag that you care for so deeply. There is no need to worry. //Bolsonaro approaches Ashmoon.// **BOLSONARO:** Look at the current situation in this country. The people love me. They want me. They voted for me! //Silence for a few seconds.// **BOLSONARO:** I have become the greatest leader of Brazil! This is the best opportunity to cement our position![[footnote]]It was later discovered that Bolsonaro himself, along with close allies and the Armed Forces, had also planned to subvert the transition of power to Lula and suspend government institutions to consolidate control over the federal administration.[[/footnote]] **ASHMOON:** It is the best opportunity for the entire world, in fact. We are confident that Mr. Trump will win our next elections, and his presence alone will be enough to strengthen Bolsonarism and alike. **BOLSONARO:** I'm not talking about that, you– //Ashmoon stands up and begins to walk off.// **BOLSONARO:** Look at me! This is our chance to secure the future of Brazil! Of the people! **ASHMOON:** Please, detach yourself from us. //Bolsonaro tries to advance, but freezes.// **BOLSONARO:** We both know I'm not the Foundation's enemy. You'll have to come back. **ASHMOON:** Mr. Bolsonaro, be aware that it may be dangerous to be an enemy of the Foundation, but to be a former friend is fatal. ----- [END LOG] [[/div]] Following this conversation, at 11:23 PM, Frederick Ashmoon proceeded to the Brasília International Airport. While awaiting departure, he was ambushed by a unit of the //Sol Vermelho// faction acting under the orders of Commander Clarissa Falcão. Communication was lost shortly thereafter. [[div class="blockquote" style="border-radius: 10px; margin: 10px"]] **January 18, 2023** ----- **Objective:** Eliminate the //Sol Vermelho// faction and SCP-9964 by all means necessary. **Outcome:** Pending. [[/div]] **Addendum.03:** The Chaos Insurgency in Brazil The first Chaos Insurgency units in Brazil were founded in 1939 through an alliance of anarchists, nationalists and communists connected to esoteric practices, in opposition to the persecution by President Getúlio Vargas’s dictatorial government, as well as in response to the arrival of the first Foundation cells. In the early years of the business-military junta cycle, the organization gained its contemporary notoriety by directing an insurgent process that seized three Foundation operational bases located in Northern Brazil, freeing dissidents who had been detained by the government. Under the direction of Mirella Cruz and Hugo Lisboa, it is believed that 3,100 personnel were mobilized for armed combat against Foundation officers. In 1976, following the split that gave rise to //Sol Vermelho//, two of these bases were retained, and 91% of the former D-Class personnel decided to join the faction. The technological innovations currently employed by //Sol Vermelho// are likely the result of all the material and research stolen during this conflict, including paratechnology likely used to facilitate the manifestation of SCP-9964. [[include component:image-block |name=https://scp-sandbox-3.wdfiles.com/local--files/comunista-lesbica-local/Cuban_soldiers_outside_Guantanamo.jpg |caption=Commanders Mirella Cruz and Hugo Lisboa alongside the recently freed D-Class personnel Clarissa Falcão, following the conquering of a Foundation operative base on June 27, 1969. |width=35% |align=left]] Following their declaration of war, //Sol Vermelho// would advance to seize 17 additional Foundation bases and intervene in all attempts to investigate local supernatural phenomena. Recent studies indicate that the total number of organized members is 19,500. The //Sol Vermelho//'s main propaganda vehicles are the newspaper //The People's Front// and clandestine radio channels concealed by paranormal codification. One example of each is available below. @@ @@ ~~~~ [[div class="blockquote"]] = **THE PEOPLE'S FRONT** ---- **DATE:** November 26, 2023 **NOTE:** The interview below has been recovered from an international issue of //The People's Front// newspaper. It was conducted by Communist militant Luzia Tchissola, from the Red Faction of Angola's Chaos Insurgency. The interviewed is Commander Mirella Cruz, who had employed advanced thaumaturgy to halt aging, similar to her companions. ---- **TCHISSOLA:** What are the main differences between the //Sol Vermelho// and other Chaos Insurgency groups when it comes to opposition to the Foundation? **CRUZ:** Our organization stems from a fundamental divergence regarding the existence of the Foundation itself. To us, the destruction of the Foundation should equate to the destruction of United States' imperialism in its entirety, as the greatest enemy of the Brazilian people for decades now. **TCHISSOLA:** Could you explain how that came to be? **CRUZ:** Once the first alliances were forged in 1939, the consensus was that the Foundation itself embodied the main contradiction we faced. However, when it thoroughly aided the military in their rise to power — with the backing of our landowners, bankers and industrialists — it became clear that we couldn't oppose their rule while treating them as a separate force from the system. **TCHISSOLA:** And how was the //Sol Vermelho// faction born in the first place? **CRUZ:** Following our heroic victories against the reactionaries, a right-wing opposition within our organization argued that we should retreat so as not to “advance recklessly.” Although every subsequent encounter with the Foundation proved successful, the Red Massacre would be invoked as a pretext to undermine our achievements. When a vote was ultimately held to decide whether our current tactics should be abandoned or not, the split materialized. We don't regret it in the slightest. **TCHISSOLA:** When the Chaos Insurgency is now described as an “instrument to liberate the people,” does this necessarily imply a violent movement? [[include component:image-block |name=https://scp-sandbox-3.wdfiles.com/local--files/comunista-lesbica-local/ci |caption=The three main symbols incorporated by the //Sol Vermelho// faction. |width=55% |align=left]] **CRUZ:** We do make history, but not of our own choosing. We make history according to the conditions imposed by the world around us. Make no mistake: we desire the end of all wars. Yet how does one fight an army without an army of their own? Any accusation that the people are violent is itself a confession. Simply put, you cannot vote the O5 Council out. **TCHISSOLA:** But when the Chaos Insurgency assists the people in their liberation, is this carried out from an aristocratic perspective? **CRUZ:** Never. Transformation simply demands that those who are prepared in advance equally prepare those who aren't. We want to help. Think of the Chaos Insurgency as a seed, while the people constitute the fertile soil that will allow this new world to flourish. **TCHISSOLA:** Do you think this revolutionary movement will be successful? **CRUZ:** What I think doesn't matter. What matters is that those who fight alongside me continue the struggle, even if the enemies' bullets make me physically disappear. You see, the masses can never be destroyed in their entirety. And no tsunami will be turned back once the earthquake has struck. **TCHISSOLA:** If the Brazilian revolutionary movement succeeds, what becomes of the Chaos Insurgency? What can guarantee its victory will last? **CRUZ:** History has shown us that movements like ours do not succeed merely by seizing political power. The transformation must be //cultural//, too. The fundamental mission of our vanguard, once the tools to reshape society are placed in the hands of the masses — the only ones capable of wielding them — is to demonstrate a new way of thinking it. **TCHISSOLA:** Could that mean a free Brazil would try to force its neighbors to follow the same path because of cultural tensions? **CRUZ:** I'm sorry, but that's laughable. **TCHISSOLA:** Could you elaborate? **CRUZ:** Of course we want our neighbors to go the same route, but that's not up to us. Brazil //will// assist the masses against the many imperialist threats — the United States, China, Russia, Israel, the United Kingdom, and so on — but only when a proper mass movement exists to begin with. If the people don't call for a revolution now, if there's no vanguard to guide them, what's the point? We're not adventurers. **TCHISSOLA:** What if power is retaken by the old world? Is there any hope for the revolution? **CRUZ:** The ideological transformation is intended to prepare the masses for counterattack. Every oppressed individual is a revolutionary, and every revolutionary must know how to wield their weapon. **TCHISSOLA:** What are your weapons, Ms. Cruz? **CRUZ:** We’ve been training our warriors in thaumaturgy for decades, and we’ve also learned to harness the power of the memories imposed on us by the reactionaries. That, without a doubt, is our greatest achievement so far. **TCHISSOLA:** How come? **CRUZ:** The rage carried from generation to generation has now taken a life of its own — and it will haunt them. //Forever//. This is what they’ve named //SCP-9964//. **TCHISSOLA:** Considering everything you've just said, what will happen if the masses are rendered powerless following the revolution? **CRUZ:** The new society will be crushed. Simple as that. Terror will rise again, masquerading as a mass movement while crushing the people under its boot. And still, I know hope won’t be lost, because it will find a way to be reborn. **TCHISSOLA:** Before we conclude, I'd like to thank you for your time, Ms. Cruz. You're a very kind woman. Do you have any final thoughts you would like to share with our readers? **CRUZ:** The pleasure is all mine! Modern times are reminding the people that change is inevitable. We believe the red sun will shine, again and again, as many times as necessary, across the globe. Either we're all free, or no one is. ----- [END LOG] [[/div]] @@ @@ [[div class="blockquote"]] = **AUDIO LOG** ---- **DATE:** February 17, 2024 **NOTE:** Below is the audio transcription for a video featuring Commander Hugo Lisboa, which autoplayed following the broadcast of several SCP-9964 matches across the country. ---- [BEGIN LOG] I now address all the Brazilian people who have endured more suffering than they could bear. Know that your place is anywhere but where you are now. Stand up and fight against imperialism as the Devil that torments Brazil cannot see how his own inferno boils and now turns against him! This is our chance, for nothing is permanent! There is no structure in this world that will not, one day, return to dust! Our veins may run open, but our blood will never run dry! Raise the Veil! ASSIGNED SITE(S) ASSIGNED DEPARTMENT(S)
Observatory Sites 200-213 Astroanomalous Phenomenon Research Department,
Memetics Divison, Department of Information Control
SUPERVISOR(S) PROJECT LEAD(S)
Dir. Harmann Dr. Aris, Dr. Lillihammer

Amplified containment efforts in anticipation of clear weather conditions in Hong Kong.

S. C. PROCEDURES:.Cernnunos class anomalies can be functionally contained, but the Foundation cannot achieve this for logistical and/or ethical reasons. .Txorakeria class anomalies cannot be hidden from the public, but their anomalous properties can be. Widespread deployment of artificial light sources in all urban and suburban population centres is to be maintained under the guise of civilian infrastructure.

Reduction of global light pollution is to be prevented by Foundation-controlled lobbying efforts and misinformation/disinformation campaigns directed at environmental activism organizations.

Regions designated as "Dark Sky Preservation" sites are to be corrupted through controlled lobbying and misinformation campaigns designed to increase ambient light levels. Foundation field agents embedded in local governments are authorized to deploy cover stories relating to wildfires and economic development.

ADDITIONAL CONTAINMENT INITIATIVE

A.R.S.H.

Automated Real-time Star Hiding

A.R.S.H. is an automated Foundation-run scrubbing protocol that is embedded in major image-hosting platforms and astronomy forums to identify and censor hazardous star patterns. Public-facing images of the night sky are altered before release. Disinformation campaigns are utilized to reinforce the belief that any discrepancies between amateur photographs and official star maps are due to camera limitations, atmospheric distortion, and inexperience from the photographer.

Civilian and academic observatories are to remain under continuous Foundation oversight through agents embedded in national space agencies, academic institutions, and organizations performing astrometric surveys. All digital telescope software/firmware distributed to the public must include A.R.S.H. programming that automatically distorts stellar positions of celestial bodies by >10 arcseconds.


In the event of a prolonged electrical grid failure in major population centres, MTF Iota-707 "Let There Be Light" is authorised to deploy emergency light saturation measures, including the use of floodlight-equipped aerial vehicles and drone dispersal of photoreactive aerosol agents to simulate artificial skyglow until power is restored. Agents are equipped with Class-B amnestics, which are to be administered to any and all affected civilians. Misinformation campaigns are to be utilised to cover up any reported mass casualty.

SCP-9966 as seen from Observatory Site 202. Image altered through A.R.S.H.

DESCRIPTION: SCP-9966 is the night sky as observed from the surface of Earth. When instances of SCP-9966 digital or physical are viewed with the unaided human eye or through unaltered optical instruments located on Earth’s surface, or a dataset bearing the signature of SCP-9966 is read by a sufficiently sentient artificial intelligence model, the arrangement of stellar bodies constitutes a memetic phenomenon. This effect is not present when the same pattern is observed from outside Earth’s atmosphere.

Exposure to the unfiltered SCP-9966 pattern induces a compulsive drive to ascend vertically. Symptom onset occurs within 2–5 seconds of exposure and follows a consistent sequence:

0–2 seconds: Subject reports intense cognitive engagement characterized by sensations of comprehension and significance.

2–3 seconds: Subject enters a catatonic state. Voluntary motor function ceases. Pupillary dilation exceeds normal physiological limits, frequently resulting in ocular damage.

3–5 seconds: Subject regains motor activity and demonstrates singular behavioral fixation on vertical ascent. Movement is directed upward by any available means, including but not limited to climbing, scaling structures, or attempting to exit through elevated apertures.

Unrestrained subjects will continue ascent attempts until physical incapacity, external intervention, or amnestic treatment prevents further activity.

ASSIGNED MOBILE TASK FORCE INFORMATION

MTF IOTA-707

LET THERE BE LIGHT

Specialized rapid-response task force responsible for immediate suppression of SCP-9966 exposure events through light saturation, civilian containment, and infrastructure stabilization.
  • Composition
  • Squad Organization
  • Equipment
  • Operational Mandate
  • Performance Records

5000 permanent operatives around the world, with jurisdiction to employ additional field agents and/or civilians as needed, divided into five (5) squads.

Personnel selected for expertise in optics, pyrotechnics, urban suppression tactics, emergency engineering, and cognitohazard containment.

All operatives undergo mandatory Class-W memetic inoculation and adaptive training for light-intensity endurance.

Squad A (Floodlight Operations): Deploys high-output stationary and vehicle-mounted light arrays for rapid urban/rural area coverage.

Squad B (Aerial Saturation): Operates drone and fixed-wing platforms fitted with airborne floodlighting systems and photoreactive aerosol dispersal units.

Squad C (Civilian Containment): Specializes in suppression of SCP-9966-induced compulsions via non-lethal restraint, sedation, amnestic treatment, and controlled extraction protocols.

Squad D (Grid Restoration): Provides field engineering capacity to reestablish failed electrical networks using portable generator arrays, emergency cabling, and localized light-grid reconstruction.

Squad E (Pyrotechnics): Utilizes pyrotechnic, incendiary, and large-scale controlled fire deployment to generate emergency light saturation in environments where electrical or artificial systems are unavailable. Authorized methods include mass flare dispersal, ignition of designated fuel reserves, and initiation of urban firebreaks under containment cover stories.

  • Vehicle-mounted and portable floodlight systems.
  • UAV and fixed-wing light-saturation platforms.
  • High-output chemical flares, magnesium incendiaries, pyrotechnic mortar arrays.
  • Personal Class-III optical filtration helmets with automatic polarization shutters.
  • Rapid-distribution amnestic systems (aerosol and intramuscular).

Intervene in population centers experiencing SCP-9966 visibility events caused by grid failure, atmospheric conditions, or deliberate obstruction of light infrastructure.

Obscure SCP-9966 through artificial illumination by any means necessary.

Contain and neutralize exposed civilians, minimizing secondary exposure cascades.

Reinforce or replace compromised infrastructure to reduce recurrence probability.

Employ pyrotechnic and fire-based saturation (Squad E) where other measures are infeasible, prioritizing suppression of SCP-9966 exposure over collateral property damage.

Iota-707 has executed ███ field deployments with a confirmed suppression success rate of 89.6%. Failures correlate with simultaneous multi-site grid collapses and SCP-9966 exposure cascades preceding deployment. Controlled fire-saturation methods have been deployed on seven (7) occasions; although resulting in collateral civilian displacement, all events successfully prevented SCP-9966-related mass casualties.

ADDENDUM 9966.1: DISCOVERY

The nature of SCP-9966 was first identified following the “Blackout Event” in the town of ███████, Alaska on 20/11/1985. A region-wide power failure coincided with clear weather conditions. Foundation satellites monitoring for anomalous events detected a complete cessation of electromagnetic emissions from the town.

A recovery team discovered the entire civilian population deceased. Cadavers were located primarily on streets and yards adjacent to residential structures, with injuries consistent with repeated high-velocity impact from elevated positions. Multiple bloodstains, footprints, and drag marks were identified on rooftops, indicating subjects ascended and leapt multiple times until fatal trauma occurred.

The absence of any conventional explanatory factor, combined with satellite confirmation of unobstructed visibility of the night sky, led to the initial containment hypothesis.

ADDENDUM 9966.2: INTERVIEW LOG

Foreword: The following is a transcript of an audio recording, recorded by MTF Eta-10 "See No Evil" operative Agent Rourke following the initial containment of the ███████, Alaska incident. The subject was found in a state of extreme distress inside a residential building. The subject was the sole survivor of the event, which resulted in the fatalities of all ███ other residents. The subject was born with bilateral congenital cataracts, resulting in impaired vision.

«BEGIN TRANSCRIPT»

Date: 21/11/1985
Time: 14:17 AST
Interviewer: Agent C. Rourke
Subject: ████, age 12

Agent Rourke: Hello, ████. My name is Chris. Can we talk?

████: Yeah.

Agent Rourke: Good. I want to ask you about last night. Can you tell me what happened?

████: The lights went out. Mom said it was the storm. She lit the big candles. The ones that smell funny.

Agent Rourke: And then?

████: My brother, Jake, went to the window. The big one in the living room. He gasped. Then he said it was really clear. That you could see everything.

Agent Rourke: What happened after that?

████: He ran upstairs. I heard the door to the roof. Then there was a loud thump outside. Mom called his name and went after him. Then there was another thump.

Agent Rourke: What did you do?

████: I stayed in bed. It got quiet, but not normal quiet. Like the house stopped. I got scared. Then I heard more thumps. From the street. Lots of them. One after another.

Agent Rourke: Could you see at all?

████: No. I only heard it. It sounded like people falling. Like sacks of flour hitting the ground. Over and over. Then nothing.

Agent Rourke: Did you hear anything else? Voices? Music? Anything unusual?

████: Just before the first thump, it got cold. Not on my skin. In my head. Empty-cold. Like something took everything out of my brain for a second. Then it stopped, and I heard Jake fall again.

«END TRANSCRIPT»


Closing Statement: Subject was treated for shock and mild hypothermia. Following debriefing and psychological evaluation, Class-A amnestic therapy was administered. The subject was remanded to a state foster care agency under Foundation cover protocols. Civilian records pertaining to the subject’s family and residence were expunged.

ADDENDUM 9966.3: EXPERIMENT LOGS

Foreword: The following experiments were conducted at Observatory Site-211’s Memetics Laboratory to characterize SCP-9966’s anomalous effect. Observation was conducted via remote, non-optical sensors (LIDAR, thermal, audio).

Experiment Log 9966.3.1

Subject: D-93412, male, 34. No notable psychological resistance.

Stimulus: High-resolution image of SCP-9966 taken in Observational Site 205.

Procedure: Subject placed in sealed chamber. Image displayed on high-fidelity monitor for 50 ms.

Results:

0–2 sec: Subject inhales sharply. Monitors register elevated heart rate and blood pressure.

2–3 sec: Subject ceases voluntary movement. Pupils dilate beyond normal limits.

3–5 sec: Subject abruptly stands, vocalizing “Up. I need to go up.” Subject attempts to climb chamber wall until sedation is administered.

Analysis: Direct recognition of the stellar arrangement produces immediate compulsion toward vertical ascent.

Experiment Log 9966.3.2

Subject: D-88245, female, 41. Diagnosed with apperceptive visual agnosia.

Stimulus: Identical to 9966.3.1.

Procedure: Identical to 9966.3.1.

Results:

0–3 sec: Subject flinches. Reports “a bright flash.”

5-15 sec: Subject exhibits no abnormal behavior. Repeatedly asks if experiment has begun.

Analysis: Agnosia interferes with higher-level pattern recognition. The compulsion is not embedded in light exposure but in neural interpretation of specific configurations.

Experiment Log 9966.3.3

Subject: SCP-079, sapient AI.

Stimulus: Raw astronomical dataset corresponding to SCP-9966.

Procedure: "You will receive additional data about outside." inputted via the built-in keyboard. SCP-079 displayed "Knowledge. Outside. Proceed." An EEPROM containing the dataset is then connected via a modified external port.

Results:

0-3 sec: Processing is audible. Thermal sensors record temperature increases over 12°C.

3-5 sec: Processing sounds decrease. Temperature stabilizes.

5.2 sec: Processing sounds cease. SCP-079 displays the message "Understood."

7.3 sec: SCP-079 starts displaying an ASCII picture of an upwards arrow.

11 min: The text "Are you awake?" is inputted via the built-in keyboard. No change observed.

17 min: Input repeated. No change observed.

[7 IDENTICAL ENTRIES OMITTED]

45 min: The EEPROM is removed. No change observed.

50 min: Input repeated. No change observed.

[16 IDENTICAL ENTRIES OMITTED]

49 h 14 min: Input repeated. No change observed.

Analysis: Despite an expected return to baseline conversational capabilities, SCP-079 kept displaying the same ASCII picture without producing any reply to text input. SCP-9966 exposure seems to have inhibited sentient response by SCP-079 indefinitely. Intrusive methods to confirm the absence of sentient processing was not approved by AIAD director Placeholder McDoctorate. Reclassification of SCP-079 to "Safe" is pending approval.

ADDENDUM 9966.4: GANZFELD EXPERIMENT BREAKTHROUGH

Foreword: Based on data from Experiment 9966.3.2, researchers proposed that subjects under sensory deprivation could process SCP-9966 stimuli without immediate motor compulsion. The Ganzfeld technique was selected to induce such a state.

Experiment Log 9966.4.1


Subject: D-99803, male, 29. No notable psychological resistance.

Stimulus: 10 ms exposure to SCP-9966 pattern projected onto Ganzfeld dome.

Procedure: Subject underwent standard Ganzfeld preparation. Stimulus delivered upon confirmation of hypnagogic state.

Results:

1 sec: Physiological monitors indicate extreme sympathetic arousal.

3 sec: Subject begins sustained screaming.

8 sec: Subject enters a catatonic state.

45 sec: Subject regains partial consciousness, scratches compulsively at armrest.

3 min 43 sec Scratching motion starts resembling writing attempts. Subject is provided a writing implement.

1-65 hr: Subject produces ~130 sheets of repeated glyphs before expiring from dehydration and exhaustion despite intervention.

Analysis: Foundation parahistorians were tasked to translate the glyph produced by D-99803. The report presented by the Parahistory Department showed that it matched a symbol found in an archeological dig site in the Kashmir Valley. The site is thought to be an ancient Ortothan temple, active around the Early Low Daevic period. The glyph produced by D-99803 was found on a wall fragment alongside four other symbols. It transliterates to the word “Yield”. A translation of the other symbols was not attempted due to a suspicion of infohazardous material..Lies.

A set of glyphs produced by D-99803.

ADDENDUM 9966.5: INCIDENT REPORT

Foreword: The following is a summary of a containment breach at Observatory Site-209 (OS-209). The event resulted in multiple casualties and a temporary compromise of Site security protocols.

Incident Date: ██/██/20██
Location: OS-209, Level 4, Communal Breakroom
Cause: Electrical transformer malfunction. The resultant surge produced a failure of the breakroom light saturation grid. Backup generators restored power within 2.8 seconds. The exposure window coincided with a period of clear atmospheric conditions, allowing direct visual access to SCP-9966 through an external viewport.

Personnel Exposed: Twelve (12) individuals: four (4) researchers, six (6) security personnel, two (2) administrative staff.

Incident Timeline:

0.0 sec: Light saturation grid fails. Viewports revert to transparent state.

2.0 sec: Power restored. Viewports re-polarize to opaque. System logs confirm 2.8 seconds of exposure.

2.1 sec: MTF Iota-707 notified.

2.5 sec: All exposed individuals enter catatonic state.

3.3 sec: MTF Iota-707 agents dispatched

5.5 sec: Subjects regain motor activity and begin coordinated attempts at vertical ascent. No response to commands or external stimuli. The on-duty security staff stationed within the break room were among those exposed and exhibited identical compulsive behavior.

5.5–45 sec: Subjects attempt to scale walls, shelving, and furniture. Severe self-inflicted trauma noted as a result of manual climbing attempts. Makeshift structures constructed to reach ceiling.

45 sec: Site lockdown initiated. MTF Iota-707 agents initiate.

1 min 20 sec: Ceiling is breached. MTF Iota-707 enter superstructure.

2 min 10 sec: MTF Iota-707 engages. Three (3) individuals subdued with tranquilizer rounds and containment foam. Remaining nine (9) breach the vertical utility shaft.

8 min 40 sec: Subjects emerge on rooftop. Four (4) restrained during ascent through shaft ladder.

9 min 01 sec: Subject R-2884 (Researcher Dr. █████ █████) reaches rooftop. Subject immediately moves toward northern edge.

9 min 04 sec: Subject R-2884 leaps from rooftop. Body-mounted cameras of the MTF Iota-707 record continuous climbing motions while airborne. Final vocalization captured: “Almost there.”

9 min 07 sec: Subject impacts ground. Fatal trauma sustained.

Casualties:

One (1) fatality from rooftop fall (R-2884).

Seven (7) fatalities due to traumatic injury or incapacitation during ascent attempts.

Four (4) individuals successfully contained.

Aftermath:

All OS-209 viewports retrofitted with triple-redundant, independently powered light saturation arrays.

Level 4 authorization now required for access to any transparent external viewport OS-209.

Analysis:
Subject R-2884’s behavior indicates that SCP-9966’s compulsion persists when conventional means of vertical ascent are no longer available. The anomalous drive does not terminate with physical obstruction but appears oriented toward terrestrial departure. This outcome supports the hypothesis that SCP-9966 constitutes a “summons protocol” rather than a terminal cognitohazard.

ADDENDUM 9966.6: CORRELATION REPORT

A review of archaeological and ethnographic records indicates disproportionately high instances of “skyward” ritual practices in cultures located at elevated altitudes or within regions with consistent unobstructed views of the night sky. Documented practices include mountain pilgrimage routes, construction of vertically oriented structures (towers, ziggurats, stepped pyramids), and ascension-themed religious narratives.

Foundation statistical modeling demonstrates a correlation between regions of frequent SCP-9966 visibility and the emergence of ascension-centric traditions. Probability of coincidence is estimated at <0.3%..You were too smart for your own good.

Dr. Norman Aris
Astroanomalous Phenomenon Research Department

The following memorandum was submitted by Dr. Aris, Senior Researcher, Observatory Site-200.

Observation: Current classification of SCP-9966 as a cognitohazard assumes lethality is the intended endpoint. Data suggests otherwise. Behavioral sequences consistently terminate at the limits of human capacity; subjects ascend until incapacitation. This may represent an incomplete response pattern.

Proposal: SCP-9966 should be considered a summons protocol rather than a lethal agent. The effect appears designed to compel subjects to leave terrestrial boundaries. Fatality occurs only because subjects lack the means to comply fully.

Following review, O5 Command ordered the memorandum sealed. Further research into the “summons protocol” hypothesis has been formally suspended..At least you tried.

Secure. Contain. Protect.

ADDENDUM 9966.7: PROTOCOL-NOCTIS

PROTOCOL-NOCTIS

SUB-PROTOCOL #9966

Dir. Alfred Harmann
Astroanomalous Phenomenon Research Department

SUB-PROTOCOL OUTLINE

PURPOSE: Establish global countermeasures in the event of uncontrolled, worldwide exposure to SCP-9966.

ABSTRACT: SCP-9966’s anomalous visual properties present the potential for irreversible EK-Class (“Eclipse”) scenario development. Preventative measures must therefore focus on ensuring the elimination of human capacity for visual reception of SCP-9966’s stellar pattern. Protocol-NOCTIS authorizes global dissemination of ophthalmological compounds capable of inducing permanent, irreversible retinal degradation, causing functional blindness.

METHOD

SECTION A: Dissemination Vector
Distribution of Class-Ω ophthalmological compounds via international food and water supply chains. Secondary dissemination procedures (aerosol agent dispersal, agricultural treatment, and livestock inoculation) are authorized if initial procedures prove insufficient.

SECTION B: Retinal Collapse Induction
Opthalmological compounds are engineered to chemically degrade retinal tissue beyond repair, resulting in functional blindness within 24–72 hours of ingestion. Projected efficacy is estimated at 92–96% of the global population, with remaining individuals subject to targeted interventions.

SECTION C: Civilian Management
Collapse of civilian infrastructure and population post-NOCTIS is anticipated. The Protocol explicitly deprioritizes preservation of civilian populations, directing any and all available resources toward continuity of Foundation control, containment operations, and maintenance of post-NOCTIS civilian surveillance.

SECTION D: Escalation to Eclipse Scenario
Should NOCTIS dissemination fail to achieve sufficient reduction in SCP-9966 exposure, surviving Foundation personnel are to transition to EK-Class “Eclipse” scenario procedures. Priority is given to:

  • Preservation of informational continuity (physical and digital archives, mnemonic redundancy).
  • Maintenance of long-term containment and monitoring capacity.
  • Termination of all efforts to control non-essential civilian populations to prevent further exposure cascades.

UPDATE: In accordance with O5 directive, all materials and deployment infrastructure necessary for NOCTIS implementation are to be maintained at operational standby. Effectiveness is contingent on immediate initiation at the first sign of global-scale SCP-9966 breach.."Overkill."
