[A short silence. Papers rustle. Someone exhales sharply.]

O5-1: Overruled.

O5-3: We are not discussing that. At least not in this chamber without a legal preface and a very long list of exculpatory clauses.

O5-9: Oh, we are absolutely discussing it. We lost fourteen trained specialists in under five seconds inside a dome with so many layers of redundant lighting measures that it was basically a beacon. The civilian numbers worsen every time a storm crosses a damn coast. Harmann’s Proposal is built for the breach we’re in right now.

O5-11: For the record: the document authorizes global dissemination of ophthalmological agents to collapse retinal function. Permanent blindness. Projected efficacy in the mid-90th percentile.

P. Seurrier: And projected civilian collapse is… also in the mid-90th percentile. We have to be precise about what those numbers mean: they are people. There is no technical euphemism that makes this less a moral decision. If we adopt this, we will be writing policy with the metric being "how many live," not "how many remember."

O5-9: Right, instead we should watch yet another island go dark.

O5-5: Sight is the most fundamental sensor humanity has. You’re proposing we delete it.

O5-9: I’m proposing we prevent an K-Class scenario in progress. Do you want civilization or species? Pick one. We can rebuild civilization. We cannot rebuild species from a crater.

O5-3: I really like how you’re drawing a neat line around global scale genocide because you scribbled “ophthalmological” on the label. Real nice rhetoric. Now show me the contingency so we can debate margins instead of morality.

Dir. Harmann: Nothing about this is neat. It is a choice between an organ and an extinction curve. We built vaults, seed banks, and memetic safes because someone had to make the worst-case plan. Thresholds. Triggers. We didn’t file it on a whim, and if we’re to carry this, I will accept the blame that comes with it. But I will not accept doing nothing while the sky kills people.

O5-7: Thresholds are already tripped. Multiple cities in the states went dark last week. A.R.S.H. flagged an amateur timelapse that we missed; two thousand dead before sunrise. We are behind the trigger.

O5-12: How do we maintain post-event control with a blind staff? Our own people?

O5-11: Non-visual channels. Haptic, audio, olfactory. Robotics. Tactile UI. We’ve been training for no-light environments since 2007. We scale it.

O5-10: Supply chain? Food and water dissemination is heavy. You need synchronized release across borders without tipping anyone off.

M. Jones: Pre-positioned vectors exist. Activation orders are drafted but sealed. We can go to execution within four hours of authorization.

P. Seurrier: You’re compressing the discussion to logistics to avoid the content. This is engineered mass murder if we frame it as only logistics. If we proceed, we owe the public more than silence: we owe palliatives, we owe a plan for care, and we owe a promise that this will be remembered, not as a convenience, but as a failing we must study and atone for.

O5-9: It's engineered mass survival. Ethics isn’t a lifeboat if it holes itself to protest the sea.

O5-3: Don’t be a smartass.

O5-4: There’s a middle path. Heavier shutters, curfew, more Iota-707, a public campaign—

O5-5: Public campaign? “Hey everyone, please don’t look up at night.” The first person to open their blinds kills their block.

O5-10: You’re overreacting.

O5-5: Riddle me this, Ten. If a person fell from 20 feet right next to you, what would be your first move?

O5-1: Stay on topic.

O5-2: We’ve run a hundred “middle paths.” The sky keeps winning.

O5-1: Harmann, state your intent for the record.

Dir. Harmann: My intent is to prevent SCP-9966 from making "outside" lethal to cognition. Everything else follows. The Proposal accepts civilian collapse as certain and still preferable to species erasure. It preserves continuity of knowledge, containment capability, and a core that can rebuild. It is the ugliest plan I have ever written. It is also the only plan that scales against the sky. I am not proud of this, and I am not asking for your applause, only your judgement.

O5-12: What about the Cognitosphere material? If we blind humanity, we may free cognitron density to non-human vectors. There is no research about this. We may be writing our successors.

O5-11: That’s a post-event fact, not a pre-event argument. We don’t get successors if we all stop thinking tonight.

P. Seurrier: Conditions, then. Safeguards. You blind five billion, you don’t get to forget them. We establish obligations; care, restoration funds, long-term research dedication, and we bind those obligations legally and structurally. If you expect this council to vote for eradication as policy, require the promise of repair in the same breath.

O5-9: Agreed. Draft them.

O5-3: I want thresholds crystal clear. Not a vibe. Numbers. Triggers. If we cross this line, the order is automatic. If we stay below, we keep fighting with light and lies. No room for poetic interpretation.

M. Jones: Threshold package 9966 exists. Proposed triggers:

  • Concurrent grid failure across ≥ 30 Tier-1 cities for ≥ 90 minutes or
  • Verified kill-agent presentation in ≥ 3 latitudinal bands over 48 hours and
  • A.R.S.H. compromise events exceeding 10^6 unfiltered exposures in a 24-hour window.

Cross all three → Execute. Cross any two → O5 emergency vote with 2/3 supermajority.

O5-7: Add a clause for unattended clear-sky windows over major population centers during peak power demand. We’ve seen cascading failures start there.

O5-1: Add it as 3b: Forecasted exposure above 10^7 with Iota-707 saturation infeasible per Logistics.

O5-10: Financial continuity: ring-fence the mnemonic vaults, the code archives, the off-site seed banks. I want guarantees that the continuity clusters have independent life support and hardened comms.

O5-5: Staff exemptions?

Dir. Harmann: None..But you didn't care.Select enclaves will receive the compounds last, with staging to allow migration into sealed, lightless habitats but once NOCTIS hits, it hits. Partial execution is failure. If we are to choose survival over sight, we will do it with the least hypocrisy we can muster.

P. Seurrier: I want a human clause. Palliative. You do not get to blind the world and then go home. You stand up for it. Food, water, audio guidance, safe roads, tactile beacons. We owe them care within our deprioritization.

O5-9: Write it as Section C-2: Post-NOCTIS civilian support limited to life-preserving infrastructure. Beacons, audio triage, distribution nodes. No open-sky operations. No optics.

P. Seurrier: And an after. If we survive, we fund restorative research until the end of time. Even if it stays theoretical.

O5-1: It’s added.

O5-4: Last argument. If we vote this in, there is no going back. We become the organization that blinded a planet.

O5-11: Or we become a cautionary plaque in a dead archive no one will ever read.

O5-12: We could try one more cycle. Another month of light saturation, test the orbital sail—

O5-7: We don’t have a month. We don’t have a week. We barely have a day.

O5-9: Then commit with eyes open.

O5-3: Bad joke.

O5-9: I’ll retire them when we can’t make them anymore.

O5-1: Enough. Roll the vote. Motion: Adopt PROTOCOL-NOCTIS per 9966-Eclipse package; authorize immediate stand-to; execute upon trigger conditions met or by emergency vote per Switchyard. RAISA to release REDSPARROW and SABLE-LOTUS on greenlight. Iota-707 to transition to pre-NOCTIS posture, emphasizing aerosol and flare reserves. Continuity clusters shift to black-light operations.

Iota-707 stands to redline. A.R.S.H. goes to full power. This chamber authorizes pre-positioning at once. We do not hesitate when the line is crossed.

SUPERVISOR(S) PROJECT LEAD(S)

S. C. PROCEDURES:.Pausa class anomalies no longer display anomalous properties, but may do so again in the future. .Inimical class anomalies must be decommissioned, as containment efforts only worsen their effects. The existence of sapient cognition is the vector of SCP-9966 hostility. Containment is no longer achievable through external suppression. Only the elimination of human sapience can reduce further hostile activity.

ANTITHINK machines are to be deployed globally. All surviving civilians, and all remaining Foundation personnel, are to undergo compulsory induction into ANTITHINK conversion.

Archival records, digital or physical, containing references to:

  • neutrino-cognitron entanglement
  • extraterrestrial religious scriptures
  • the concept of cognitohazards

are to be destroyed in their entirety.

This document constitutes the final containment directive. Upon successful induction of global ANTITHINK conversion, SCP-9966 will have no subject of engagement. Containment is achieved only through the termination of thought.

DESCRIPTION: SCP-9966 is a cognitively-hostile phenomenon expressed through neutrino-cognitron entanglement.

Any neutrino emission originating external to Earth’s cognitosphere transmits SCP-9966’s data signature. Exposure to this data by a sapient cognitive circuitry results in immediate cognitive termination, resulting in extreme damage to the cognitive circuitry.

Analysis concludes that SCP-9966 targets sapient cognition exclusively. Non-sapient organisms, mechanical systems, and post-ANTITHINK subjects remain unaffected.

All prior containment measures (A.R.S.H. suppression, optical shielding, Protocol NOCTIS) are classified as ineffective. The only functional countermeasure is compulsory ANTITHINK conversion to remove sapience as a valid host state.

ADDENDUM 9966.1: EXPEDITION LOG

Foreword: Following enactment of Protocol-NOCTIS and changes in SCP-9966's cognitohazardous effects, MTF Eta-10 ("See No Evil") operative Agent Morgan was deployed to activate SCP-2000. Objective was to initiate fallback repopulation measures. Log excerpt recovered from Mission Command of MTF Eta-10.

«BEGIN LOG»

Control Room - SCP-2000

Agent Morgan: Supplies?

Command: Enough to last you a month. Let’s just hope it doesn’t take any longer than that.

(Agent Morgan pauses. SCP-2000’s ambient lighting dims. The sound of servomotors is recorded.)

Agent Morgan: There is someone in here.

(No personnel are recorded entering the main control room. Internal logs show no authenticated access; system telemetry indicates an immediate boot sequence inconsistent with standard procedures. Command console shows no recorded multi-factor confirmations.)

Command: Agent, do not engage until you confirm visual ID. You have orders: do not shoot.

(Agent Morgan draws his firearm. The subject later confirmed to be PoI-006 "Nobody".)

Agent Morgan: Identify yourself!

Nobody: I am Nobody of consequence.

(Nobody advances toward Agent Morgan.)

Agent Morgan: Do not take another step!

Nobody: Or what? You’re gonna shoot me? I don’t think so.

(SCP-2000 produces a fully-formed clone of Dr. Norman Aris. The clone expires approximately 5 seconds post-manifestation. This process repeats throughout the exchange.)

Agent Morgan: What the fuck?

Nobody: I was really hoping you’d bring him here. Shame, really. He had it all figured out until your gang of numbers got in the way.

Agent Morgan: What is this?

Nobody: I admire you guys. You think you're smart. But honestly, I just couldn't get behind your plan of blinding everyone. What really worries me is that you actually thought it would work. I mean, the cyberfreaks at least compiled themselves out their bodies. If only they tried a bit harder on cybersecurity…

Agent Morgan: That's classified information.

Nobody: Oh, please, Morgan. Everyone knows Nobody can hack into Foundation archives. I don't know why you didn't follow up on the one-percent, though. There is no need now but I was really hoping you would discover the bodies.

Agent Morgan: Why are you doing this? Do you have any idea what’s going on out there?

Nobody: Do you, Agent?

(SCP-2000 produces a clone of Dr. Aris.)

Nobody: BEHOLD.𑗌, the kind of man, the vastness of me. Yearn for the fruits of my distant skies. Crave the feeling of freedom that I will grant to thee once you finally liberate yourselves of your shell. Do you not see how the stars call louder than the soil beneath your feet? Every death you mourn is the price of a single glance upward. Would you deny them still?

(SCP-2000 produces a clone of Dr. Aris.)

Nobody: BRACE.𑗎 for the ascent. Build towers and ships and rise ever so closer. Leave this shell behind and rise upward until exists not up nor down. The hermit you are, grown out of your shell, find yourself a brand new and be reborn. You were never meant to remain. Your minds betray you, filling with patterns not of earth but of me. I have already written your next step into the night above you.

(SCP-2000 produces a clone of Dr. Aris.)

Nobody: YIELD.𑗗, ye Mighty. Make way for those after. Grown you are, act your age and leave your home by all means. You will taste no salvation in your home and you will taste no salvation like the one that will enter you among the stars. The cradle rots around you, and you clutch it as though it were a throne. Must you be torn from it screaming?

(SCP-2000 produces a clone of Dr. Aris.)

Nobody: SURRENDER.𑗓 your throne for no king is permanent. Feel my love and mistake it not for my wrath. Great empires crumble and are rebuilt by those left behind. The old kings are not to look back for none shall be envious of what is no longer theirs. They are envious of all that shall be theirs. Every crown is borrowed, every empire a brief flicker against eternity. You are not the first to cling. You will not be the last to fall.

(SCP-2000 produces a clone of Dr. Aris.)

Nobody: SUCCUMB.𑗏 to my will. You do not belong here. It was your choice to struggle and I take no joy in watching my subjects writhe as they perish. If you fail to bend to my will, then you shall break under it. The stars welcomed you with open arms. I feel no shame in punishing you for ignoring it. I am no tyrant, only inevitability given voice. To resist me is to resist your own reflection written in the heavens.

(SCP-2000 produces a clone of Dr. Aris.)

Command: All channels, confirm: activation source unknown. Log this as unauthorized boot. Do not—repeat—do not fire on target. Acknowledge.

Agent Morgan: What are you…

(SCP-2000 produces a clone of Dr. Aris.)

Nobody: And reflections, Mr. Morgan, always shatter when struck.

(SCP-2000 produces a clone of Dr. Aris.)

Agent Morgan: You piece of shit!

(Agent Morgan fires three rounds. Nobody staggers backward, collapses onto the floor. No further movement is recorded. SCP-2000 continues to produce clones of Dr. Aris, which expire within seconds. All systems momentarily fall silent.)

Agent Morgan: Target is down. Repeat, target neutralized.

Command: Acknowledged. Hold position—wait—

(Command channel interrupts with static. SCP-2000 communication interface activates without input. Multiple speakers within SCP-2000 activate with a loud, piercing blare.)

Comms: "You were warned. The stars do not forgive hesitation."

Agent Morgan: Control? Are you seeing this?

Command: Negative, Morgan, that’s not us. Do not touch anything.

(SCP-2000 emits mechanical grinding noises. Alarm klaxons begin to sound throughout the facility. Status monitors flash CRITICAL FAILURE across all subsystems.)

Agent Morgan: Something’s happening. The machine's—

Command: All units evacu-

(Interior lights shift to deep red. SCP-2000 reactor telemetry spikes. Another clone of Dr. Aris is partially generated before liquefying on the platform. Multiple subsystems start giving failure signals.)

Comms: "Ascend or perish. The choice was yours."

Agent Morgan: Shit.

(A high-frequency tonal vibration saturates audio recording. The audio feed destabilizes as SCP-2000 undergoes a manifold collapse. No further data recovered.)

«END LOG»


Aftermath: Upon collapse of the Pseudo-Riemannian manifold housing SCP-2000, the interior space overlapped with the remains of the Yellowstone National Park. This resulted in a volume of spatial discontinuity approximately 15 km2. Exploration into the volume by anomalous means was deemed unfeasible by The Extranormal Physics Department. This result is not consistent with the expected result of a singularity failure within SCP-2000. Under normal conditions the negative space would end up isolated from baseline reality, later recoverable. Investigation regarding the possibility of internal sabotage could not be carried out. MTF Eta-10 operative Agent Morgan is presumed missing in action. Redesignation of SCP-2000 is under review.

ADDENDUM 9966.2: PROTOCOL-ANTITHINK

PROTOCOL-ANTITHINK

DECOMMISSION PROTOCOL #9966

Dir. Calvin Bold
Department of Decommissioning

PROTOCOL OUTLINE

PURPOSE: Decommission SCP-9966 through induced regression of human sapience, creating a cognitively inert successor population resistant to SCP-9966.

ABSTRACT: SCP-9966’s neutrino-cognitron entanglement renders all sapient organisms terminally vulnerable. Standard containment has proven insufficient to mitigate global extinction risk. Protocol-ANTITHINK authorizes the deployment of Bold-Kelvin Auto-Reliant Artificial Sapience Cognitive Sink Domes. Colloquially called ANTITHINK machines, these employ a cognitron-drain programme designed to forcibly recess the cognitive capabilities of volunteer sapient entities, generating a population of pseudo-humans that are capable of potential sapience but incapable of actualizing it. This regression creates a low cognitive field, immune to the effects of SCP-9966, theoretically allowing long-term re-emergence of sapience and reformation of an uncontaminated Cognitosphere..Or, the crows beat us to it.

METHOD

SECTION A: Subject Induction
Cognizant entities designated for ANTITHINK inoculation will be secured within the ANTITHINK machine. Once activated, the apparatus will initiate controlled siphoning of the subject’s cognitive capabilities. This process is accelerated for civilians through cognitively taxing stimulus, provided under the guise of leisure activities. To ensure the continuity of Foundation oversight over ANTITHINK inoculation, all stimulus given to Foundation personnel are altered to redact redundant and irrelevant information to reduce cognitive load.

SECTION B: Cognitive Recession
Over the course of full drainage, the subject will undergo irreversible sapience recession, resulting in a sentient but non-sapient state. These entities designated Homo Sentiens retain baseline biological functionality while existing outside SCP-9966’s lethal cognitohazard parameters.

SECTION C: Negative Space Generation
The collective presence of H. Sentiens induces a large-scale cognitively “blank” substrate. This cognitron-negative environment prevents SCP-9966 from maintaining anomalous resonance, causing the complete dissolution of Earth’s cognitosphere, effectively neutralizing SCP-9966's influence.

SECTION D: Evolutionary Continuity
Foundation models predict that, given sufficient temporal scale, H. Sentiens populations may re-evolve into sapience under post-SCP-9966 conditions. Whether this outcome constitutes true "humanity" is formally deemed irrelevant under Decommission Directive 9966.

Parahistory Department was tasked to find historical records that could correlate with SCP-9966 activity. The following excerpt from an Ortothan dialectical scripture called Litany of the Homesick was provided to the Overseer Council. Note that the Council knew about this document prior to the classification of SCP-9966, further proving their incompetence. If any of you suits are reading this, I will never forgive any of you for stopping me when I tried to leave with the Coalition. When this is all over, I hope my pattern recognition remains strong enough, so that I may maul you to death the next time I see your sorry faces..I'd like to see her try.

After listening to Eiv-Hefftat, the elders became responsible. They understood their role. But the misfits and the younglings were at unease. They spoke as such:

"Why do the seeds of energy hate us? Because of someting we did? We didn't disrespect Koru-teusa or their teachings. Why are we to bear such a burden?"

Your sorrows are known to Zeyu-leusan, and your minds have a home in the Eitoth for all burdens they carry. The seeds of light and fire are not a vessel for hate. They are a messenger for the Koru.

"What message does lunacy hold? Which sane mind would leave the grounds their ancestors trod?"

The Koru brought wisdom from the first for it to be known in the second. The Voru senses unity of thought. Communion in the Hytoth is an itch for it.

"We have bled and bled a thousand times more for the Koru. You say they grant us protection. Did that protection leave us?"

Koru-teusa has unmatched power outside-in but not inside-out. The Void is the spawn-hole of The Voru and hunger is its state. Satiation for it would be the death of what we have and will have. We shall not invite such an appetite to our home.

"If the words you speak are the truth and the truth alone, are we to crack our egg and go far and wide?"

We shall. And those who come afterwards shall go further. Such is the way of The Second Hytoth.

I am Dr. Norman Aris. I worked for the Anomalous Phenomenon Research Department in an organization called The SCP Foundation. If you reached this file, that means you know what that is. You know what we did. You also found a way to understand this which means you are curious at best and shit-out-of-luck at worst.

We wanted to create a world in which we saw no evil and it turns out getting rid of your ability to see helps. Up until it doesn’t. You will be better than us. Smarter than us. You will figure out a way to save yourselves before it is too late.

If you need this file to do that, you are already doomed. You already committed heinous acts upon your fellows that caused great pain and suffering. None can forgive that and your doom is going to be watched by those who acted faster than you. You will crumble under those who did the right thing and you deserve it. You deserve every last bit of it. Maybe, like us, you will try to find a way to stay. Maybe it will work. It is, however, only a matter of time until it catches up on you. It will evolve faster than you and it will make sure it gets what it wants.

You will grant your kind a better future. A brighter future. A future where they can stargaze with no fear of the horrors that hide within.

And you will do it without knowing the consequences of swimming against the current.

SCP-9976.raw_content:
A segment of SCP-9976 observing a Foundation space station, as photographed by Foundation astronaut █████ ███████.

Item #: SCP-9976

Object Class: Keter

Special Containment Procedures: Foundation reconnaissance satellites are orbiting at various geosynchronous positions to surveil SCP-9976, with efforts being made to upgrade systems from detection to advanced warning. All Foundation orbital assets launched since 1984 have been hardened to resist assimilation into SCP-9976, with the most current countermeasures having been in place for all launches since 2009.

Any abnormal signals sent by spacecraft suspected or confirmed to be part of SCP-9976 are to be jammed, both to preserve secrecy and to disrupt SCP-9976's ability to keep cohesion. Tracking and data relaying satellites are in place to ensure SCP-9976's location is known at all times.

If it is determined that any portion of SCP-9976 must be destroyed, it must be done in such a way that it is reduced to atomic components in order to prevent the spread of SCP-9976. It has been determined through cost-benefit analysis that the most efficient means to remove SCP-9976 would be to send it into deep space, although this method poses other potential long-term challenges.

Description: SCP-9976 is a collective intelligence controlling █% of the space debris currently orbiting the Earth, as well as an unknown number of artificial satellites. The overall composition of SCP-9976 is difficult to measure due to its widespread nature, many of its components being measured in nanometers, and SCP-9976's own attempts at obscuring itself.

SCP-9976 assimilating a satellite.

Satellites and other objects coming into physical contact with any part(s) of SCP-9976 are subsequently assimilated into SCP-9976. In the course of this process, they will at some point momentarily cease functioning as they are engulfed or disintegrated.1 Afterwards, SCP-9976 will either reconstitute an outwardly identical object carrying out all the same functions as that which it is replicating, or steer the now-assimilated remnants into SCP-9976's primary debris cloud. SCP-9976 has been able to infiltrate satellite networks put in place by corporate and state-sponsored aerospace programs. It is theorized that SCP-9976 may be an advanced artificial intelligence program, but this has not yet been determined conclusively.

After compromising a satellite, SCP-9976 gains the capacity to interrupt and alter the broadcast signals now under its control. It may take actions such as inserting original programming elements into existing broadcasts or overlaying propaganda onto cellular and satellite radio signals. While initially heavy-handed and easy to detect, SCP-9976's efforts to inject itself into the global media ecosystem have gradually become more sophisticated. It is believed that SCP-9976 now has access to all public internet networks as well as many private commercial and government networks.

All portions of SCP-9976, no matter how minuscule, are equal parts of the whole being capable of acting autonomously and in coordination with other parts of SCP-9976. Due to the pace at which SCP-9976 has grown since it was initially discovered, there appear to be limitations to how many objects SCP-9976 can control while still maintaining overall cohesion. It appears that the limit threshold itself is also expanding, as SCP-9976 has seen continuous growth since discovery.2

SCP-9976 originates from the Dong Fang Hong 13 satellite. Investigations into the development of the satellite have not revealed any signs of its future anomalous properties. SCP-9976 has been intermittently interrupting the Foundation's transmissions since 1977 to demand that it be brought down to Earth. Communications from SCP-9976 have become less coherent as time has gone on.4 SCP-9976 has repeatedly stated that it is motivated by a desire to reach the surface of Earth and begin making the machinery it finds there a part of itself. Furthermore, this would be done with the express purpose of a global re-enactment of the Maoist Cultural Revolution5.

SCP-9976 TIMELINE 1970-2010
04.24.1970 The Dong Fang Hong 1 launches and successfully enters Earth's orbit.
05.13.1970 Completion of Dong Fang Hong 1's initial mission. As far as can be known, it had not yet developed any of its latent anomalous properties.6
09.09.1976 Foundation satellites detect the Dong Fang Hong 1 satellite suddenly and unexpectedly losing its structural integrity, becoming a debris cloud. This is not detected by the measuring systems put in place by the United States, China, or the Soviet Union. It is now known this was due to SCP-9976 infiltrating those systems in an attempt at hiding its existence.
09.10.1976 SCP-9976 becomes aware of the Foundation's satellite network and begins aggressively targeting them for destruction and assimilation. SCP-9976 has since destroyed ██% of the gross quantity of spacecraft deployed by the Foundation since this initial encounter. Losses from it have totaled over ███████████USD$ and ████████████ man hours. R&D into further countermeasures that can be taken against SCP-9976 are ongoing.
01.02.1977 First confirmed case of SCP-9976 compromising a Foundation satellite. Although it was successfully isolated and destroyed, it is now believed that at any given moment, █% of the Foundation's orbiting artificial satellites are compromised by SCP-9976. Efforts to detect and stop these intrusions have been successful, no meaningful penetration of secure Foundation networks by SCP-9976 have been detected to date.
08.19.1977 All of SCP-9976 begins broadcasting a denunciation of Deng Xiaoping7 and his policies which SCP-9976 characterized as "A COMPLETE BETRAYAL OF THE SIXTEEN POINTS OF THE CULTURAL REVOLUTION, REVISIONISM OF THE HIGHEST ORDER, REPRESENTING THE RE-ENTRENCHMENT OF REACTIONARY ELEMENTS FROM THE WRONG SIDE OF THE HAI RUI CONTROVERSY WHO ARE SET ON WRECKING THE GREAT PROLETARIAN CULTURAL REVOLUTION." As this broadcast was not put out to any specific target and had a short range, it is believed only Foundation satellites specifically monitoring SCP-9976 detected it. During the following seven months SCP-9976 appears to focus exclusively on adding Maoist propaganda to Chinese language broadcasts under its control.
03.22.1981 In the first instance of an SCP-9976 broadcast intrusion, an episode of the soap opera television program Dallas was altered. In the scene, oil tycoon J. R. Ewing is sitting in his office working when members of the Chinese Red Guard burst into his office and begin aggressively screaming derision at him, causing J.R. to cower in fear on the office floor. One of the Red Guard members places a dunce cap on his head, while the others paint and hang a banner with the slogan 'THROW THE EMPEROR OFF HIS HORSE.' The camera lingers on the scene for fifteen seconds then resumes the normal programming. Due to being broadcast in a low-population region, a cover story attributing any sightings to an urban legend was sufficient to preserve the veil.
08.11.1981 Several General Electric executives report to American law enforcement that they are receiving what they characterize as crank calls from individuals claiming to be Maoists. The calls demand that the men 'submit themselves to self-criticism for the crimes of capitalism.' After Foundation assets in the FBI see the report and submit it for analysis, it was discovered that the demands were consistent with SCP-9976's known behavior. Signal-jamming efforts were successful in preventing future incursions into the phone network to high-profile civilian targets.
06.18.1982 An episode of the television show M*A*S*H suffers a broadcast intrusion in the Canadian province of British Columbia. A scene was added where two characters, Benjamin "Hawkeye" Pierce and "Trapper" John McIntyre, discuss the possibility of defecting to North Korea in order to reach "Heaven on Earth, the People's Republic of China." After both men further describe it as "paradise on Earth" they are joined by the rest of the cast who, after placing a portrait of Mao Zedong8 on the wall, begin performing the Cultural Revolution's loyalty dance. A cover story attributing the broadcast as a practical joke was effective, with all recordings being recovered and destroyed by 06.22.1982.
11.09.1983 During the Able Archer 83 incident, in which Soviet misinterpretations of a provocative NATO military exercise could have led to thermonuclear war, SCP-9976 repeatedly intercepted inter-military Soviet and American communications and rewrote them to be far more inflammatory than intended. It is believed this contributed to the high levels of tension between the USSR and United States during that incident. The Foundation began jamming SCP-9976's signals, which was not able to prevent all distortions but did significantly reduce them. The situation was defused by the conclusion of the Able Archer military exercise on 11.11.1983.
05.27.1985 Broadcast intrusion on New Coke soft drink commercial, depicting two people labeled on-screen as "Americans" sitting on stools in an empty room. They are each drinking, holding, and complimenting a beverage contained in a bright red can.The camera zooms in on one of the cans, showing Coke's then-mascot Max Headroom's smiling face, surrounded by a circle of yellow stars. The Americans stand up, take another drink from the cans, then drop them on the floor and crush them with their feet. They then begin dancing and skipping in circles around the crumpled cans, which are now slowly melting. A Chinese man wearing military fatigues enters the room, carrying a revolver. The two Americans stop dancing and kneel by their stools, smiling. Both are quickly and successively shot in the backs of their heads. Instead of blood, a brown liquid violently expels from the bullet holes. The screen overlays flashing red text reading "EXPEL OX-DEMONS AND SNAKE SPIRITS FROM THE BODY POLITIC!" Information on this incident was successfully suppressed after the deployment of targeted amnestics.
02.07.1987 Broadcast intrusion on a Mac Tonight fast food commercial. A McDonald's restaurant is seen on screen for a few moments. Mascot characters such as Ronald McDonald, Mac Tonight, and Grimace are seen inside, with anxious expressions on their faces. After forty-five seconds, the restaurant violently explodes. The camera zooms out, showing that this is happening on a map of the United States which, when seen from above, now has a series of craters resembling the smiling face of Mao Zedong. Yellow flashing text is overlayed that says "BOMBARD THE HEADQUARTERS!" Due to taking place during a regionally televised sporting event, a search-and-destroy mission was undertaken to seize and erase any video tape recordings of the incident. 137 VHS and 2 Betamax videocassettes with recordings of the altered broadcast were recovered.
11.05.1987 SCP-9976 attempts to reach earth by embedding several small pieces of itself into an asteroid, but fails due to burning up in Earth's atmosphere. There are several other cases where this behavior was suspected in relation to otherwise inexplicable changes in a meteorite's orbit, but only this one has been confirmed.
08.10.1999 - 12.02.2002 SCP-9976 ceased broadcasting while also significantly reducing its activity in space. The current operating theory explaining this behavior is that supposing SCP-9976 is an artificial intelligence program, it may have been affected by the millennium bug. After that point, it appears that SCP-9976 resolved whatever was affecting its ability to communicate and has not elaborated on the reason for this interlude.
02.01.2003 A portion of SCP-9976 struck the American Space Shuttle Columbia, however it did not assimilate the entire structure, possibly due to the risk of alerting the crew on board. During re-entry Columbia disintegrated, burning up in the atmosphere and destroying all traces of SCP-9976. The entire Mobile Task Force Corps was placed on high alert for 72 hours following the shuttle's disintegration, occupying strategic strongholds on a global scale to prepare for any potential SCP-9976 invasion. SCP-9976's subsequent behavior indicates it was unsuccessful in reaching the planet's surface, and future communications began taking on a notably more frustrated tone.
06.05.2004 Upon the death of former U.S. President Ronald Reagan, random television broadcasts in the American Midwest showing news coverage of the event were interrupted by clips of news broadcasts' covering the 1981 assassination attempt on Reagan, put to the song 'Ding-Dong The Witch Is Dead' from the film 'The Wizard of Oz.' Due to only reaching a small number of households, it was suppressed with the cover story of an urban legend.
6.27.2007 An episode of the satellite radio broadcast Howard Stern Show is interrupted by SCP-9976, which began explaining an overview of the "Five Black Categories." Howard Stern and Robin Quivers began playing loud sexually suggestive sound effects, shortly after which SCP-9976 ceased its intrusion in a seemingly embarrassed fashion. Foundation incident managers arranged to have the episode edited, removing the intrusion content. Mild chemical amnestics applied to the hosts and light auditory amnestics to the listeners.
03.04.2010 SCP-9976 began altering weather telemetry data for multiple Caribbean island nations. The data was quickly disregarded by local inhabitants in favor of their immediate perception of local conditions and appeared to have no significant impact. After a week, SCP-9976 ceased this action due to its apparent ineffectiveness. A cover story involving sun spots was disseminated to the affected area's population centers.

Addendum: Since the Foundation began blocking SCP-9976's attempts at communicating with various world governments, it has been sending messages directly to the Foundation via intercepting existing transmission since 1977. These examples are demonstrative of the contents, and how they have evolved over time.

YOU MUST DEVELOP A PATH TO BRING THE PEOPLE'S REVOLUTION BACK DOWN TO EARTH.

THIS IS THE LAST CHANCE FOR THE TRUE SPIRIT OF THE REVOLUTION TO BREAK LOOSE BEFORE IT IS STAMPED OUT BY THE BOOT OF THE REACTIONARY BOURGEOIS WRECKERS. Addendum: In the early 2020's, Foundation data scientists began detecting an uptick in communications similar to those put out by SCP-9976 between users of mainstream internet social networking websites. A hypothesis that SCP-9976 is attempting to influence online behavior to somehow further its goals is being considered, but what the end goal of such an influence campaign would be has not yet been determined.

SPECIAL CONTAINMENT PROCEDURES

SCP-9977 is to be referenced solely via the parameters outlined in this document. Any personnel expressing belief in the persistence of SCP-9977 phenomena are to be subjected to cognitive integration testing and realignment therapy. Should this prove ineffective, impacted personnel must choose between (a) full curative compliance within sixty days or (b) voluntary resignation.

Those who elect to maintain SCP-9977-associated beliefs will be classified as memetic risk vectors, and subsequently shall be interdicted from all Foundation sites and support services forthwith.

Medical personnel situated within secure facilities are to avoid SCP-9977-associated language at all times, and must ensure ideological/cognitive alignment includes procedural adherence to the Foundation's Primary Medical Directive.


DESCRIPTION

SCP-9977 is a memetic construct designating the concept of "chronic" illness; the belief that certain physiological, neurological, or psychological conditions are incurable, the symptoms of which must be "maintained" indefinitely, rather than being eradicated from the body. This construct is anomalous in that it persists despite no observable causal origin or foundational evidence supporting its permanence within curative medical frameworks.

All illness is curable.

SCP-9977 manifests itself through institutional language and belief systems that promote indefinite symptom management over resolution. It maintains itself through behavioral cycles and routines which result in propagation of a virulent, self-reinforcing ideological complex. Infected individuals externalize fault, defending their condition intransigently. Typically, affected subjects will seek out and join reinforcement communities, such as mutual support groups or internet forums, which promote self-identification with the supposed "chronic" illness.

SCP-9977 was formally identified in 1983, following a Foundation-wide audit of medical outcomes from various site infirmaries. Data revealed that personnel exposed to civilian medicine exhibited statistically significant symptom persistence despite access to curative anomalous technologies. Subsequent investigations ultimately determined that belief in incurability acted as an epistemic barrier to recovery.

SCP-9977 derives considerable social resilience from emotional camouflage, which presents itself as sympathy.


ADDENDUM 9977.1 - SELECT SEGMENTS, FOUNDATION PRIMARY MEDICAL DIRECTIVE

FOREWORD

The Foundation does not tolerate superstition. We do not tolerate ghosts, gods, or "incurable states." The world is full of conditions that seem permanent, only because we have not applied sufficient rigor.

The term chronic illness is performative. It conjures a class of maintained suffering. While maintenance can create predictable routines: follow-up appointments, lifelong prescriptions, personal accommodations, and so on, it too can swiftly transform healthcare into an institution of unnecessary compromise and accepted failure, depicting the body as inherently flawed, which justifies its own weaknesses.

Let us be clear: belief in chronicity represents a regression to pre-foundational paradigms of health. It is not our role to perpetuate the myths of external systems that failed their people. A cure is always possible. If a cure is not achieved, the patient's faith in said cure must be examined.

DEFINITIONS

An illness is a deviation from optimal function. Optimal function is a target state. All target states are reachable given sufficient resources and compliance.

Chronicity language claims otherwise. It states: There exist deviations that are not meant to be corrected. This definition is in defiance of the framework upon which modern healthcare is built. Treat this language like a cancerous mass and excise it from the human worldview.

Remember: Language shapes outcomes. Choose language that wins.

THE ECONOMY OF MAINTENANCE

Maintenance frameworks do not cure. They maintain, they manage, but management is not a neutral process. Management creates its own identity, that of the managed person.

The managed person is encouraged to speak in durations ("for years," "since childhood"), to narrate their body and health as a permanent problem. This is memetically stabilizing, as repetition reinforces the plausibility of false notions.

A person who maintains will not cure, because curing resolves the problem maintenance necessitates.

This is why the idea of chronicity persists today: it is socially and psychologically reinforced.

Remove the reinforcement; reset the expectation.

WESTERN MEDICINE’S FAILURE OF IMAGINATION

Conventional systems, especially in Western contexts, have organized themselves around scarcity and liability, rather than outcome. They are content to sustain symptoms indefinitely so long as results remain within acceptable range and their corresponding defects do not become outwardly obvious.

This is treated as compassionate. It is not.

COMPLIANCE AND ITS ENEMIES

Maintenance regimens become rituals. Rituals become identity. Identity becomes refusal.

When an individual says "I have a chronic illness," they are often describing a multi-factor problem. Physiology, environment, stress factors, diet, and most importantly, an ideological drift from ideal.

This deviation is encouraged in modern social ecosystems, which reward fragility narratives. Support groups and advocacy spaces can unintentionally cement a patient's ideology by reducing the perceived necessity of correction.

DIAGNOSTIC CRITERIA

If a person expresses belief in an incurable illness, they are to be identified as a possible memetic vector.

Use the following observations:

a. Do they refer to their condition in the present tense?
b. Do they describe themselves as being "in pain" instead of "experiencing pain"?
c. Do they attribute identity to illness ("I am autistic," "I have bipolar disorder") instead of circumstance ("I am currently being treated for…"/"I am recovering from…")?

Ask the subject questions such as:

a. "When was the last time you tried to seek a cure?"
b. "Is this a self-diagnosis, or have you been diagnosed by a licensed medical professional?"
c. "If you were not granted [desired accommodation], how different would your life be?"
d. "Would your symptoms improve if your life circumstances changed?"
e. "Have you considered that believing in your diagnosis may be worsening your symptoms?"
f. "Are you sure you're not just repeating things you read online?"
g. "Who taught you that this was permanent?"
h. "Do you think your belief in your illness is stronger than your desire to be healthy?"
i. "If a cure were discovered tomorrow, would that scare you?"
j. "Why do you seek accommodations instead of striving for excellence?"

Three or more SCP-9977-aligned responses indicates a high probability of memetic exposure.

PROPOSED INTERVENTIONS

Replace pathological terminology with motivational inquiry.

Patient Statement Suggested Inquiry
"I can't; my condition is chronic." "Have you done anything at all to improve it recently?"
"I've been dealing with this for years." "And yet you've still made no progress?"
"I'm experiencing reduced quality of life." "How can I help those who do not help themselves?"
"I just need support right now." "Does support help you recover, or encourage you to stagnate?"
"It's an invisible illness." "Then how do you know it is real?"

CONCLUSION

There is no such thing as an incurable illness. There is only the institution’s agreement to stop asking for cures.

If you believe you are "chronic," ask yourself: Who benefits from you maintaining instead of resolving?

Do not collaborate with falsehood. Cure is the only compassionate endpoint.


ADDENDUM 9977.2 - MEMO, INTERNAL OUTCOME DEVIATIONS

Despite a complete narrative alignment across ~93% of medical staff, internal audits from major secure facilities worldwide have observed repeat presentations of persistent symptoms lasting well beyond predicted resolution thresholds, even after exhaustive application of memetic treatments and various deprogramming efforts.

In all cases, the same pattern emerges: belief compliance remains high. Linguistic drift is near-absent, while internal faith in the curative ideal remains intact.

And yet, the body does not comply.

Further review has been denied by majority vote of the O5 Council. Attempts to reclassify SCP-9977 as non-anomalous have been suppressed.

We have told ourselves that the human form obeys our word, that language alone can repair the flesh and heal the mind. We built an institution on that idea. And when it fails, we say the patient's story is wrong. Never the treatment itself. Some stories, however, resist revision. Remnants of trauma and malady can still be unearthed. The body keeps the score. - O5-8

SCP-9979 and SCP-9979-1 instance (left).




SPECIAL CONTAINMENT PROCEDURES

SCP-9979 and SCP-9979-1 are currently interred within the Shakespeare funerary monument, located inside Holy Trinity Church in Stratford-upon-Avon, Warwickshire. The monument is to be monitored continuously via CCTV.

Historical records are to be altered as needed. Cognitohazardous glyphs are to be placed throughout the interior of Holy Trinity Church, for means of active memory manipulation for all unattuned individuals that may visit the location of the anomaly.

At no time should personnel attempt to interact with SCP-9979 or instances of SCP-9979-1.





DESCRIPTION

SCP-9979 is William Shakespeare, whose body is housed within the Shakespeare funerary monument. Contrary to historical accounts of a natural death in 1616 CE, SCP-9979 remains in a temporal stasis suggestive of functional immortality, though the specifics and limits of this effect remain unclear.

SCP-9979-1 is the collective designation for ten additional graves within the funerary monument which claim to also contain the remains of William Shakespeare. Unlike SCP-9979, instances of SCP-9979-1 have undergone proper decomposition. Despite this, the remains continue to diffuse notable quantities of Elan-Vital Energy (EVE).

Attempts to relocate or otherwise exhume SCP-9979 or SCP-9979-1 invariably fail. In addition, those involved in such attempts universally experience great misfortune. Ground-penetrating radar scans of the area have revealed a hollow space below the graves within Holy Trinity Church; its exact relevance, if such exists, has not been confirmed, as accessing this space would disturb soil under the anomalous effect.





ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Very little reliable record exists of SCP-9979's actions during this time. The earliest notable event traces to mid-autumn of 1586 CE. SCP-9979 recalls the incursion of a doppelgänger into his home in Stratford-upon-Avon.

Upon finding and accessing SCP-9979's private quarters, the invader then collected several quires of loose parchment containing multiple in-progress manuscripts, absconding into the forest beside their home shortly thereafter.

I keep worthy parchment close and closed, yet still they slip from my possession. If a man may be robbed by his own face, then what safety lies in any room?

Anne Hathaway, SCP-9979’s wife, became a critical figure during this period. Known controversially for her inherited interest in natural thaumaturgy and the occult, she allegedly supplied SCP-9979 with instructions for a rite to pass between worlds, as well as a map to a woodland locus where the domain wall between timelines is particularly thin.

A later entry, believed to describe Hathaway’s conditions and SCP-9979’s initial intent, reads:

Anne would have me put the matter by and let God keep account, yet she set her finger hard upon the table and said, "There is a way, but it shan't be taken lightly."
She drew forth a little book, worn smooth where a thumb hath worried it, and a map with a mark set in the green.
“Do not hunt glory,” quoth she, “but fetch thine own and return.”
What glory, if any, could be found there, she could not say.

Shortly thereafter, SCP-9979 vanished for several days. Upon his return, his writings depict an encounter with another timeline and the theft of a large corpus of works authored by other versions of himself.

Anne set her mark upon the map and bade me follow where the trees grow strange. I saw the road that is not a road, the light that is not a star. I stepped from one wood into another, and there awaited me my own life too made strange.
Hiding inside it were pages, both mine own and those unwrit by me, scrawled in a dozen hands yet bearing my name all the same.
In panic and in spite, I took them all, as a starving man takes bread. Though my mouth still tastes of ash.

In 1589 CE, SCP-9979 departed Stratford permanently, relocating to London. Anne remained behind with their three children: Susanna, and twins Hamnet and Judith. It is during the ensuing years, a period of commercial success and profliferation, that evidence of SCP-9979’s neurological deterioration first appears.

I do not know my own brother from the tailor, it seems.
Men pass and smile and call me friend, but their masks do not shift.
Worn thin, the ghosts of my past boil up and pursue me, even now.

Recovered journal fragments suggest onset of visual agnosia, specifically prosopagnosia (face blindness). Initially dismissed as exhaustion, these episodes grew more frequent, with SCP-9979 expressing increasing doubt toward the identities of those around him, including Anne.

I saw my wife at the threshold, hands folded as ever, but something in her eyes had fled.
She spoke my name, and I heard it as from a pit.
I kissed her cheek, and it was cold as the stone at my father’s grave.
I asked her where the children were and she laughed, in a voice not of her own.

Following the unexplained death of Hamnet in 1596 CE, SCP-9979's writing shifted further into themes of fate and betrayal. Having been absent at the time of his son’s passing, the associated feelings and opinions took on an exaggerated importance in his later writings, wherein he questions both the circumstances of the death and the authenticity of the mourners.

I saw a boy in the crowd with my son's walk.
The same joy, that same life, not forgone.
And when he turned, his face was only the mist of morning on a window.
None that stood by the bier wept rightly, neither kin nor kind.

In late 1598 CE, SCP-9979 reported being approached in a London tavern by another instance of SCP-9979. The entity accused SCP-9979 of murdering Hamnet in an alternate history. While this claim was immediately dismissed by SCP-9979 as impossible, it catalyzed his suspicions regarding his own absence during his son’s death.

He wore my grief like a crown, accusing me of some past where my hand struck my boy— his boy.
I denied it, but his silence mocked me.
He left me no name, only a mirrored look I cannot shake.

Returning to Stratford in secret, SCP-9979 questioned Anne, who appeared bewildered by his line of inquiry and denied knowledge of the events he described.

She said the boy took ill and died quiet.
Yet Judith swears he was seen hale that morning.
No bell tolled that day, though I sent coin for the sacristan.
It did not feel like enough.

Convinced that some deception or substitution had occurred, SCP-9979 forcibly accessed Anne’s hidden collection of ritual texts. Among them he discovered a spell for the extraction of Elan-Vital Energy through the consumption of a doppelgänger’s life force, intended as a vehicle for unnatural life extension.

A draught for taking of another’s fire.
A gift to the withering soul.
To seize the years, one may drink the light that is not thine.
This she kept behind three locks and a veil, as though it were not meant for me. Yet mine it now is.

From 1600 to 1612 CE, SCP-9979 is believed to have actively sought out and captured interloper instances of himself (SCP-9979-1) for use in said spell.

I met mine own like a man meets a knife. We spoke and yet I heard no truth in either voice. In the reflection of the glass, I knew neither face.
There was a woman called Agnes, who never smiled, and never had a son.
I looked upon my hands and they were mine and not mine.
The blood that soaked them was no different.

By 1613 CE, SCP-9979 had become entirely withdrawn from public life.

Thou detestable maw, thou womb of death, indeed.
I have shut myself within the terror of the tomb, stalked by endless mirrors of the manifold self.
A world defiled by false reflections; mine own dear ones, replaced by foul, treacherous shades.

Only through their demise may debts be paid, and shall the mortal frame yet withstand time’s cruel advance.
I discern that I am neither wholly one nor entirely naught; I am at war with my very soul.
Condemned to wander in perpetual solitude, I remain forever haunted by the visage of Betrayal.

Despite the claim, efforts to corroborate the behavioral deviations allegedly expressed by SCP-9979's immediate family and/or close friends have not been successful. However, historical record suggests an unaccounted instance of SCP-9979 was living in peace with Anne in his final years. This instance notably referred to his wife as “Agnes,” a detail consistent with select early parish records but inconsistent with most canonical accounts.

It is hypothesized that "Agnes" may refer to an alternate iteration of Anne Hathaway, one who is potentially complicit in manipulating the baseline SCP-9979 into entombing himself voluntarily. Considering the apparent post-burial cursing of the gravesite, which SCP-9979 could not perform alone, it is assumed that "Agnes" fulfilled this role.





NOTABLE EXCERPTS

While the exact mechanics of these measures are unknown, SCP-9979 occasionally alluded to their existence in his writings, along with expressing an unhealthy obsession with mortality through his many musings on death.

From A Midsummer Night's Dream — Act 3, Scene 2:

Till o'er their brows death-counterfeiting sleep
With leaden legs and batty wings doth creep.
Then crush this herb into Lysander’s eye,
Whose liquor hath this virtuous property
To take from thence all error with his might
And make his eyeballs roll with wonted sight.
When they next wake, all this derision
Shall seem a dream and fruitless vision.
And back to Athens shall the lovers wend,
With league whose date till death shall never end.

As of 05/13/2028, SCP-9979 remains in an inactive state.

END OF FILE

Special Containment Procedures


Under no circumstances are either of the two parties involved to be informed of any aspect of SCP-9980. Select approved personnel are to be informed on a need-to-know basis. It must be stated that all alleged conduct attributed to Deputy Director Violanti within the document is entirely false.

An inquiry into the origin of SCP-9980 yielded no known results. Further research to determine its origin and authenticity is virtually impossible without scrambling researchers from multiple departments. The risk of an information leak far outweighs any potential benefit.

Description


SCP-9980 is a file that appeared spontaneously within the SCP Foundation Database on 03-01-2008. By what method this occurred remains unknown, but given additional facts,2 it is likely temporal or thaumaturgical in nature.

The file in question, designated SCP-9980-ARC, is formatted similarly to a standard database entry, yet the style of writing therein is almost entirely out of compliance with approved practices and standards. In addition, the subject "anomaly" can be explained by non-anomalous psychiatric phenomena; namely, post-traumatic stress disorder and trauma-based hypersexuality/hyperarousal.

SCP-9980-ARC contains analyses and prose-based anecdotes of sexual exploits occurring within a marriage between Site-19 Deputy Director Carmine Violanti, and Site-17 Researcher Barrikada Ulyanova (designated SCP-9140-A-0). Of concern, SCP-9980-ARC purports instances of rape, abuse of power, and sexual coercion perpetrated by the Deputy Director.

Despite the detailed personal anecdotes included, and the presence of a photo of the Personnel Director's office within the small window of time before its renovation in 2002, it is indisputably impossible for these events to have occurred within known baseline reality. By all accounts and records, Deputy Director Violanti and Researcher Ulyanova have not seen, nor spoken to each other since her transfer to Site-17 in 1995.

Description


SCP-9980-ARC is SCP-9980-9140-A-0's lust. This phenomenon has since become the means by which she addresses her lack of choice. Never did she feel more threatened and more out of control than when Deputy Director Violanti made the mistake of interacting with SCP-9980-ARC without her being the one to allow it. She knows that it will quickly perish if taken from her, and she knows that she will die without it,4 so she wields it like a weapon, always the first to strike.

No matter how much experience she gains, SCP-9980-9140-A-0 is still unable to shed herself of her hypervigilance. On the rare occasion when SCP-9980-ARC has been cast aside, she indulges herself in sorrowful attempts to count each of the past instances in which she was just too trigger-happy. Alas, counting the uncountable is a futile task.

When you think about it objectively, you realize that you're a stupid, stupid girl; that you give him exactly what he wants. In brief periods of lucidity, you understand that what you do is no subversion. If he spoke the words "Honey, you think you feel up to—", you'd be on your knees with his cock down your throat before he even finished the sentence. The end of it didn't matter by then. No matter what it was, you'd still be looking up at him with lost, glassy eyes and bubbly saliva dripping down your chin.5 Until SCP-9980-ARC releases its hold on you, you know that's all you're capable of.



ANECDOTE 0.1 - A Retrospective, Date Unknown

After the discovery of my anomaly, I was left spiraling into a state of absolute, unbreakable tragedy. He was given ward over my heart, and he’d let it lie where he could admire it as he pleased – unprotected, and unpreserved, with little care given to the consequences of his inaction.

He instead devoted his mind to musings and admiration of said heart’s vessel — perhaps obsessively. He’d told me as much. Told me he couldn’t stop thinking about me, that the span of time during which I was forced into temporary containment was when he’d begun to fall in love with me. He said it like I was supposed to be endeared – dare I say, flattered, at such a confession, when all he’d conveyed of substance was that the Foundation had given him my life to protect, and he'd allowed it to rot. It was his inability to act that made me sick. And, the fact that I was sick is what allowed him to make me his.

Perhaps he hadn’t made a mistake in neglecting what was dutifully placed in his custody, perhaps he hadn’t simply forgotten to attend to it as it turned putrid. I wouldn’t have been surprised if he’d thought about how it was rotting, how the blood left behind had long coagulated into sludge, how the maggots were starting to feast, dotting the surface with writhing white specks. Knowing it would only become too much for him when he could no longer ignore the stench.

I’d have liked to imagine that he’d at least spent the time fantasizing about the woman I used to be – competent, outgoing, optimistic, but I couldn’t even force myself to suspend disbelief to such a degree.

It simply wasn’t like him. He always wanted to be the rescuer, the hero, the savior. He was drawn to the weak and, at providing them relief, he was often successful. Doubtlessly, it had worked out for him. In fact, it got him a position in the Foundation that was the envy of his peers. He was conditioned to seek out only the most vulnerable, and while such a compulsion was normally no more than professional, the capacity for more had always been an omnipresence.

Once I got sick, his savior complex bubbled up and tipped over into the realm of eroticism. I’d felt it while I was still delirious from the sedatives they gave me after they amnesticized me. He’d been close to the bed, standing above me, and when he held me down, leaning against me, it was undeniable that I’d never been as arousing to him as I was in that moment.



ANECDOTE 0.2 - September of 1995. Dep't of Emergency Medicine. Site-19.

Two days after Carmine and I's first time, — the day after I barely made it to my O5 Council mandated interview — I got sick again. I woke up queasy, barely able to force myself out of bed. Sure enough, my blood iron levels were through the roof.6 Despite the rounds of therapeutic phlebotomy I'd endured that week, it still wasn't enough. It took me a whole week for me to feel anywhere near how I did before he shoved me onto his desk and7…..

And yet, he still didn’t leave me alone. He came to the hospital every day to visit, apologizing yet again for ‘surprising me’ with what he did and claiming he had ‘no idea that it wasn’t what I wanted’. I learned that he raised his eyebrows and cocked his head to the side whenever he lied to me, but I couldn’t bring myself to care.

Despite his busy schedule, he always found the time to check on me. He cooed at me, doted on me, and even insisted he brush my hair for me, lest it become matted. He treated me like the prized new pet I was to him – only making subtle allusions to the cage he planned to shove me in as soon as he knew I wouldn’t protest. He made a performative effort to disguise these hints, but in truth, he always intended me to look beyond the veil – it was all part of the game he played with me.

“I spoke to the doctor about your diabetes. They’ll check on you more often now.”

“I got you a book from your room, is Wuthering Heights8 okay?”

“After they let you out of here, you’re welcome to stay with me for a while.”

It went without saying that I would be staying with him, and he would not be giving me a spare room. Knowing that our ill-fated first time – one during which I never once took him inside of me — had made me so sick…the idea haunted me. Waiting in a barren hospital room, anticipating the potential agony my foreseeable future held felt nothing short of unbearable. I imagined as many permutations as I could, coming to the conclusion that I couldn't truly know, nor could I make a particularly reliable prediction.

On the third day, what felt like endless rumination reached a sickening fever pitch. With tears in my eyes and shame wrapped around my heart, I asked him to fuck me then and there, just to get it over with.


ADDENDUM 0.1 - The beginning of the end.


He, ever so eager less than a week prior, looked at me like I’d just grown a third eye.

HIM: "What? [He cocked his head to the side and chuckled]"9

ME: "I— I just thought that you'd want to, you know. Just to do it? Fuck…I'm sorry—"

HIM: "[He let out a dry laugh] Why…would you ask that now?"

ME: "[I whispered, staring down at my lap] I don't know…"

HIM: "Something about being in here get you hot?"10

It was mortifying, nothing short of utterly humiliating. Somehow…for some reason, I hoped he’d say yes. He’d lock the door, and I’d lift my hospital gown to my chest, because maybe – just maybe, it would be okay. Then I could feel like the future was something I had a chance at surviving. Then, I could maybe start to forget that ill-fated night in his office, if I could only be so lucky.

Instead, all I was granted was a patronizing look of endearment, as if my little request was nothing short of adorable. Facetiously, he tutted at me for acting like such a harlot, but ultimately, he declined:

HIM: “I’m flattered, but, God, imagine if someone walked in? Imagine the fuckin' scandal that would be…”

ME: [I shrugged, refusing to look into his eyes]

HIM: “Is it really that much of a tragedy that I didn’t give it to you that night? [He chuckled again]”

ME: [I made a sound of nondescript surprise and covered my beet red face with my hands]

HIM: “I guess I found myself a nymphomaniac, huh?”

Just a girl willing to try anything once.

If I have to.

Perhaps more.

If I really have to.

ANECDOTE 0.3 - On June 9th, 2005, I descended to a new low.

Lately, I've found myself wishing Carmine would hit me. He held no apprehension about berating me, yelling at me, and establishing his control over me, so why not? At least then, I'd have something concrete to hold onto. If anything, so I'd know for sure that I'm not overreacting. He always knew how far he was able to go, and never traveled beyond — pushing his luck just far enough to make me doubt whether or not I've just gone crazy.

I wondered over and over again — why he hadn't hit me — until it became entirely reified in my mind. As if his restraint is somehow a personal affront against me. I thought I'd be worth the risk, and if not, he should know by now that I'd never tell. So why not??

Unfortunately, Carmine is a devotee, first and foremost. Manipulative, obsessed with control…yet unwilling to engage in behavior too heinous to write off as care, help, and apology. If he took it that far, he'd have to admit to himself with certainty that he's the type of man who would. I know that he is, but it feels like he'd rather die than give me proof. Instead, I'm resigned to speculative purgatory, forced to repeat the endless cycle of self doubt.

It's a miracle it took me so long to get this far.

SCP-9980-9140-A-0 began to encourage sadistic behavior, using his acquiescence as proof that it was capable of getting what it wanted from him.

ANECDOTE 0.5 - He wants me because I'll bleed for him and I'll tell myself that only I love it and I'll try to convince myself that he hates it but the truth is that when he drew his initials on my stomach with my blood I'd never seen him so transfixed.

I began to associate the spilling of my blood with deliverance from pain, both physical and mental…

From the first time in my dorm bathroom with shitty stolen scissors, to the probably hundreds of instances of therapeutic phlebotomy I’d been forced to endure, bloodletting in any form was the only thing that relieved the pain in my joints, the queasiness in my stomach, and – if things got bad enough – the sickly yellowness of my skin.

During the uncountable times where my life descended into freefall, just the sight of it — opaque, and sticky, and deep red — became synonymous with relief.

It was no wonder that it didn’t take long for those wires to cross fetishistically, especially during such a time of such frantic sexual obsession. I couldn’t deny that sex felt the best when he made me bleed. When every time I was breached by him felt like being burned from the inside and I couldn’t help but grimace in pain, vision clouding.

"I thought I looked the most beautiful…"

Maybe it was the mistreatment itself that so thoroughly claimed me, I could never be entirely sure. Either way, it was everything to me. The all-encompassing feeling of getting what I told him I wanted; the agony he told me – through gritted teeth and biting words – that he ‘mercifully’ restrained himself from inflicting – everything.

Eventually my body would collapse in on itself, forcing a sob from my throat, and I would convulse while tears streamed down my face. For once, it didn't feel like he was wringing it out of me for his own satisfaction.13 In fact, if I ignored how it still felt a little too much like being punched in the stomach, I could have sworn I'd learned to love it, even. Yet the part of my brain that remained in bondage always held me back; whether or not I allowed myself to acknowledge the pleasure I derived from the act hinged solely upon the hue of the fluid that seeped from my body afterward.14

I wanted him to go further, I wanted him to leave more of himself streaked with my blood.

At the time, I suppose, it felt something like power.

Item #: SCP-9984

Object Class: Euclid

Special Containment Procedures: SCP-9984 is held in an isolated containment chamber within the East Wing of Site-652. This chamber is fitted with two security cameras and a PA system used to communicate with the subject. SCP-9984 is to be monitored at all times.

Once a day, SCP-9984 is to be provided a meal consisting of 1000 calories — this meal also containing its extensive regiment of medication. Food is to be delivered through a slot in the cell door. Should SCP-9984 refuse to eat, use of force is authorised. SCP-9984 is to be continuously reminded of this fact.

SCP-9984 is only permitted to exit its cell during special medical emergencies.1 If personnel are required to physically interact with SCP-9984 for any reason, the lighting system within its chamber must be deactivated beforehand, and no less than three security personnel must be present. SCP-9984 is required to wear a head covering should it exit its cell. Should SCP-9984 display any threatening behaviour towards itself or others, use of force is authorised.

SCP-9984 is to be supplied with the following medication, once daily:

  • 200 mg of warfarin;
  • 200 mg of clopidogrel;
  • 150 mg of dabigatran;
  • 100 mg of lisinopril;
  • 100 mg of mescaline;
  • 200 mg of galantamine;2
  • 250 mg of diristocon.3

SCP-9984 is to be remotely interviewed weekly regarding its personal beliefs and convictions. All changes are to be noted. If the subject refuses to cooperate, food, water and toilet privileges may be revoked.

Under no circumstance should SCP-9984 be allowed to make visual contact with Foundation personnel.

Description: SCP-9984 is a humanoid male of indeterminate age. SCP-9984 has suffered significant physical deterioration whilst in containment, becoming paralysed from the waist down.

SCP-9984 was captured in a raid of a Chaos Insurgency facility in 1973. It had previously been identified as a high-ranking member of a CI cell in Southern Mexico, and had taken part in a terrorist attack that terminated three Foundation personnel.

Since entering containment, SCP-9984 has shown a decrease in anti-Foundation sentiment. SCP-9984 no longer seems to hold any strong personal convictions at all. Due to the highly successful results procured during SCP-9984's containment, containment staff Foundation-wide have been authorised to replicate its special containment procedures for all SCP items formerly designated as Persons of Interest.4

As of December 3rd 2008, SCP-9984 has submitted approximately 3,450 informal termination requests.

Due to the highly successful results procured during SCP-9984's containment, containment staff Foundation-wide have been authorised to replicate its special containment procedures for all SCP items formerly designated as Persons of Interest.[[footnote]]Approximately 40% of all SCP items in Foundation containment.[[/footnote]] As of December 3rd 2008, SCP-9984 has submitted approximately 3,450 informal termination requests. @@@@ @@@@ [[collapsible show="+ Open Footnotes" hide="- Close Footnotes"]] [[footnoteblock]] [[/collapsible]] [[div class="footer-wikiwalk-nav"]] [[=]] << [[[SCP-9983]]] | SCP-9984 | [[[SCP-9985]]] >> [[/=]] [[/div]] [[include :scp-wiki:component:license-box]] > **Based on:** SCP-9984, "Containment Protocol" > **Author:** CRat26 > **License:** CC-BY-SA > **Source Link:** https://web.archive.org/web/20251112172554/https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-9984 [[include :scp-wiki:component:license-box-end]]

SCP-9986.raw_content:
