A suture is visible extending through the open window, across the floor, and onto the victim's body.]] **Item #:** SCP-9992 **Object Class:** Presumed Neutralized (formerly Keter) **Special Containment Procedures (Archived 19/06/2008):** SCP-9992 is to be contained within a 2 x 3 x 1.5 meter containment chamber constructed of 15 cm^^2^^ steel plates, separated by thin steel rods with diameters of no greater than 0.5 cm. The legs and torso are to be restrained by metal clamps, while the arms are to be held in a T-pose, with the appendages placed outside the chamber. The chamber is to be submerged within a large, isolated body of water within --Site-109-- Site-221, through which a constant convective current is to be maintained. SCP-9992's appendages will be exposed to the current at the water's surface, which shall remain fixed at ≥1.7 knots towards the outer wall. This speed will force the appendages outward and away from nearby solid surfaces. All surfaces related to the containment apparatus are to be continuously monitored for any breaks or fissures. In the event of SCP-9992 breaching containment, response forces are to first immobilize the entity's appendages with a standard-issue taser or equivalent energy device before incapacitating it and returning it to the apparatus.[[footnote]]Note that electric discharge only nullifies the subject's appendages. It remains completely unharmed otherwise.[[/footnote]] //Additional Order, effective 19/11/2002: SCP-9992 has been relocated from Site-109 to Site-221. The above containment procedures will remain unchanged. Recommending stationing of personnel at town of  ███████ █████████, Wyoming. - General [REDACTED]// (rescinded 19/06/2008) **Description:** SCP-9992 was a 2.1 meter tall humanoid entity consisting primarily of vacuous sacks of human and animal tissue connected via long surgical sutures (stitches). It possessed a disproportionately large head and elongated arms, as well as thin, tendril-like appendages composed of neural fiber wrapped around muscle sinew in place of hands. It did not have eyes or a nose, with the majority of its facial region consisting of a large semicircular orifice, likely meant to resemble an exaggerated human smile. SCP-9992 displayed no characteristics of any other anatomical constructs within itself: it did not have teeth, a tongue, or a uvula, wounds inflicted on the subject did not produce any liquids that may substitute for blood, and limited analysis of the facial orifice showed that it was not connected to the SCP's biological interior. Despite this, SCP-9992 routinely displayed superhuman capacities in strength, speed, and endurance, as well as above-average intelligence. SCP-9992 did not require food or water, though it did still "breathe", in that it produced audible inhales and exhales, while the exterior tissue sacks inflated and deflated in synchronicity to its "breaths". It was also capable of producing short, animalistic vocalizations. SCP-9992 exhibited extreme hostility to all forms of animal life within its presence, especially towards humans. When attacking, it would utilize its appendages to latch onto nearby solid surfaces, with sutures emerging onto the surface from the point of contact. Stitches produced by this method were capable of independently traversing any solid surface they were on, as well as crossing between surfaces in physical contact with one another. The areas of their traversal would undergo rapid transformation into biomass, with clusters of body tissue and nerve cells forming underneath the surface and emerging through the ruptures left by the stitches. The sutures would travel towards the location of SCP-9992's targets and travel onto their skin, upon which they would terminate/immobilize them by stitching and/or rupturing various parts of their bodies.[[footnote]]Sutures could enter the victims' insides via the esophagus or posterior cavity.[[/footnote]] Due to the means of attacking, SCP-9992 typically operated at a distance from its targets, allowing it to remain undetected. [REDACTED] with the victims' DNA found incorporated into SCP-9992's skin tissue, though absences of their organs remain unexplained. If not being pursued, SCP-9992 will gather all bodies into a single room and observe them for an extended period of time[[footnote]]When this happens, the subject's breathing became slow and labored.[[/footnote]]. When not active, SCP-9992 was completely idle. It showed no discomfort to being restricted in its containment apparatus and was wholly at rest. Given its total lack of need for sustenance, it is unknown why it continually pursued humans and animals. After a successful hunt, SCP-9992 would be even more relaxed in its chamber for the following days, with some notable exceptions. Between its containment on 29/03/1982 and its disappearance 23 years later, SCP-9992 breached containment ██ times, with a total of ██ non-D-Class casualties. It was last seen in the wooded region north of ███████ █████████, Wyoming, USA, where it was in the presence of another anomaly. (see Addendum 2) ---- **Addendum 1 - Truncated Log of Incidents:** **27/03/1982:** Discovery of SCP-9992. Various human and animal corpses were found lining the roads of █████████, Montana. In all cases, the victims died from severe internal hemorrhaging, caused by the rupturing of several vital organs. The Foundation also received reports of flesh emerging from the town's road and sidewalks. Analysis found the epicenter of these events to be an abandoned farmhouse within the ██████ plains; a strike force was quickly sent to the location, wherein they found several additional bodies[[footnote]]Later identified as relating to missing persons cases going as far back as 1965.[[/footnote]], as well as SCP-9992 in the basement. █ of the personnel were terminated before a prototype electric rifle was able to neutralize its appendages, after which it was restrained and transported to Site-██. **18/04/1982:** Containment breach #1, caused by ineffective containment procedures. After three hours, a caravan of five was recovered in the ditch next to ██████ Road, Wyoming, with all tires pierced and the air within replaced by biomass. SCP-9992 was located in the back along with the bodies of the victims; it was incapacitated in a manner similar to initial containment and returned to Site-██. A greater understanding of SCP-9992's methodology was achieved; containment policy modified. **30/05/1983:** Containment breach #3, caused by inadequate containment procedures. After thirteen hours, SCP-9992 was relocated in the city of ████, Idaho, on the upper floors of an office complex. Since it was nighttime, only security officers had remained in the building; based on the trajectory of the tears in the construction material, SCP-9992 was presumed to have dispatched all of the officers from the ground floor, with the sutures travelling up the complex via stair, elevator shafts, and the outer walls. SCP-9992 was incapacitated via standard procedure and airlifted back to Site-██, while the building was demolished due to the extensive damage it had taken. Containment policy modified. **17/11/1987:** Containment breach #██, caused by insufficient containment procedures. After twenty-seven hours, a patrol in ███████ █████████, Wyoming[[footnote]]Hereafter referred to as Town A.[[/footnote]], received a distress signal from the nearby town of ████████, regarding an unknown home intruder. The call was redirected to the Foundation after the caller's description of the assailant was found to match SCP-9992. By the time a unit from MTF[[footnote]]Mobile Task Force[[/footnote]] Epsilon-6 ("Village Idiots") was able to reach ████████, all houses in the community were found to be deserted. The bodies of the citizenry were discovered at the community square, arranged in orderly rows, along with SCP-9992, which was recontained without further trouble. An after-incident investigation found multiple sutures of varying lengths within the majority of the town's structures, resulting in said structures becoming filled with esoteric biomass. It is believed that SCP-9992 initially coerced the residents to exit their houses by leaving large gashes on their property, before strategically blocking pathways with biomass to route them towards the central square. When all had gathered there, it was able to terminate the group in quick succession. SCP-9992's intelligence capacity was recognized; containment policy modified into its current form. Due to the resource demands, containment duty was transferred from Site-██ to Site-109. **02/12/1987:** Containment breach #██, caused by unknown disruption in Site-109's electrical system. No known casualties; SCP-9992 was relocated in the forest to Town A's north, by personnel originally tasked to the cleanup of the former incident. When found, it was standing completely immobile. The trees in the immediate area were found to have various sutures on them, but smaller in size and at a reduced quantity to usual.[[footnote]]Unverified reports also described "bright, blue-ish particulate" floating in the nearby air.[[/footnote]] After several seconds, SCP-9992 turned and lunged towards the surrounding agents. It was quickly immobilized by standard issue flash grenades and returned to Site-109. Over the next few days, containment overseers note an uncharacteristic degree of distress within its breathing pattern. **04/09/1993:** Containment breach #██, caused by attempted incursion by Chaos Insurgency forces. SCP-9992 was relocated in ██████, Montana, having terminated two homeless persons by rupturing their lungs. It was incapacitated without incident and returned to Site-109. Torn parts of the sidewalk were replaced. **22/07/1998:** Containment breach #██, caused by internal sabotage from turncoat personnel. SCP-9992 was relocated in █████ ███ ███████, Montana, having chased various hikers and woodland animals onto a stone cliff via its sutures and preventing them from leaving. It was incapacitated without incident and returned to Site-109; of its targets, two humans and 18 animals had died of thirst or starvation, while the rest made a full recovery. **12/08/2002:** Containment breach #██, caused by earthquake. After sixty-two hours, SCP-9992 was relocated in ██████ ████, Oregon. Greatest recorded death toll of all known incidents, with over ██ identified victims. SCP-9992 had attacked three suburban communities, one for every night it was uncontained, targeting multiple families in rapid succession. Sutures were used to stitch victims to the furniture in their houses and seal their mouths and nostrils, leading to prolonged death by asphyxiation. SCP-9992 had also caused massive property damage in the surrounding area, specifically targeting the municipality's police department by severing their firearms and puncturing the tires of their cars. Given the scale of the event, the Foundation authorized the evacuation of the region, alongside partial mobilization of MTF Xi-13 ("Sequere Nos"), aided by aerial units from MTF Delta-45 ("Rolling Thunder"). They were able to track SCP-9992 to a heavily damaged section of ██████ Road, surrounding by ruptured cars. Although the MTFs initially expected some form of trap similar to the 17/11/1987 incident, SCP-9992 instead attempted to attack all units directly, hastily manifesting dozens of sutures and sending them out omnidirectionally. This appeared to have caused significant stain to it, as the sutures were far more scattershot and unstable than normal, though they still caused extensive lacerations to the environment. Only two ground troops were terminated, while the rest retreated. One of the helicopters fired an AGM-65 Maverick missile towards SCP-9992, which responded by attempting extend its appendages and sever the missile at the instant before impact. While it was successful, the resultant midair explosion blew SCP-9992 backwards several yards, giving ground units an opening to immobilize and secure the entity. It struggled significantly more than in previous recontainment operations, but was still successfully returned to Site-109. In the aftermath, the entirety of the municipality needed to be rebuilt before residents could be amnestized and sent back. SCP-9992 was silent and motionless for over a month. **14/09/2002:** Witnesses reported a series of unidentified noises coming from the woods surrounding Town A, most commonly likened to the shuffling of footsteps and a low klaxon siren. SCP-9992 suddenly began roaring and violently thrashing in its chamber. In light of the events of 02/12/1987, SCP-9992 was transferred to Site-221, and three plainclothes personnel were stationed in Town A. **07/01/2003:** At 22:19, staff in close proximity to SCP-9992's containment chamber developed sudden piercing migraines, which subsided after a few seconds. A follow-up investigation yielded no leads. **Various incidents, 2003 - 2005:** SCP-9992 would occasionally breach containment thanks to various external hazards, usually involving a variety of GoIs[[footnote]]Groups of Interest[[/footnote]].[[footnote]]Site-221 was involved in the containment of several items and persons of high profile in the underground anomalous community.[[/footnote]] Rather than try to flee the site, SCP-9992 would instead reside in a single room/hallway and terminate any personnel that entered. Surveillance footage showed it behaving erratically, spending the majority of its time curled in a fetal position in one of the corners and taking sharp breaths. Each time, it was recontained without trouble. **17/06/2005:** An unidentified disruption in Site-221's master computer caused the facility to temporarily undergo emergency lockdown. SCP-9992 was motionless in its chamber and did not react to the alarm. After ten minutes, the disruption was reverted, and the lockdown ceased. **18/06/2005:** See below. ---- **Addendum 2 - Unexplained Disappearance:** At 23:15 hours on June 18th, 2005, several unidentified physical abnormalities manifested throughout Site-221's electrical, security, surveillance and general support systems, causing major disruptions. As a result, all surveillance of the site's interior was lost. Curiously, the disruptions appeared to have been concentrated around SCP-9992's containment unit; the water current restraining its appendages was halted, while the exterior hatch was forced open. A security team was quickly sent to the containment unit, only for it to be found empty. No sutures were visible anywhere within the chamber. Exterior security cameras remained active, with one spotting SCP-9992 outside of one of Site-221's back doors at 23:24 hours. It appeared unusually hesitant, standing completely still while facing towards the surrounding woods. Exterior microphones picked up slow, heavy breathing, barely audible over the wind. It made no attempt to run away. After several seconds, SCP-9992's breathing grew quiet, replaced by a soft groaning noise akin to a human whimper. It began shaking its head and backing away from the trees, whereupon the camera feed artifacted heavily before having its vision obscured by an unknown object. When the security team finally reached the back doors, SCP-9992 was nowhere to be seen. The agents stationed at Town A were ordered to investigate the northern forest immediately, being assisted by an emergency dispatch sent from Site-109. The unit entered the forest at 23:50 and began progressing towards the location where SCP-9992 was originally found back on December 2nd, 1987. They reached there at 23:58 but were still unable to find the entity, and so made their way further into the forest. [[include component:image-block |name=Night-forest.jpg| |caption=View inside forest.]] At 00:09 the following day, personnel reported back to Site-109 that they had found multiple trees uprooted by an unknown force. Following the trail created by the fallen trees, they began noticing increasing damage to the surrounding area, and more importantly, an increasing number of sutures in the soil and tree bark. While initially seeming to be haphazard, one agent noted that some of the sutures formed legible words: the phrase "HELP", repeatedly etched into the environment. The personnel eventually stumbled into a sizeable clearing within an unexplored region of the forest. The ground was powdered with blue particulate and laden with overlapping sutures, around which the soil had been pulled up. Within some of the fissures were loose appendages that were seemingly ripped from SCP-9992, which still had not been found. None of the appendages retained their original anomalous properties, and the sinew had rotted while the neural endings had been fried. Based on the circumstances, it is believed that SCP-9992 attempted to anchor itself in the ground to resist some sort of anomalous pulling force; however, it proved to be too powerful, and the entity eventually lost its grip. While the investigation continued, no other traces of SCP-9992 could be found. The recovered appendages and biomass were stored in a standard containment locker at Site-221. Site-109 would continue to conduct routine patrols of Town A and the forest, but no further discoveries were made. After three years of no activity, SCP-9992 was declared "Presumed Neutralized", and its containment procedures were discontinued. The current whereabouts of SCP-9992 remain unknown. [[div class="blockquote"]] [[=]] [[size 2em]]**Operation: SNOW PEAK**[[/size]] **Incident Report** [[/=]] ---- //Foreword: Operation SNOW PEAK was a Foundation-GOC military response to an accumulation of hostile Persons of Interest (PoIs) throughout the Gmuden district. This organization consisted of exiles and runaways from throughout the global anomalous community, commanded by a nebulous leadership council. Recruitment was encouraged by allowing for all types of persons to become members, regardless of past actions, intentions, or diplomatic concerns. Based on intercepted communications, the organization had been preparing to attack several containment facilities and public government offices across Austria.// [[include component:image-block |name=Hoher_Dachstein_3-2017_05.jpg| |caption=Hoher Dachstein]] By the morning of February 15th, military squads had already dealt with the organization's urban shelters, and were now attacking strongholds secluded within the Northern Limestone Alps. One of these was located on Hoher Dachstein (see image) and was occupied by various highly powerful practitioners of thaumaturgy, as well as many of the organization's high-ranking members, who had retreated to the stronghold's inner bunker. Prior aerial reconnaissance had identified an aboveground structure several miles away from the stronghold's main body. While most of the Foundation-GOC forces engaged the thaumaturgists, a small task force was sent to inspect and clear out the place. However, during their approach, they noted that the area appeared to be completely abandoned, while the reconnaissance images had shown it to be active only a few days before. Upon their arrival, they found that the shelter had been almost completely destroyed. A giant blast crater was in its place, as the structure's upper floors had collapsed into the basement. A brief investigation into the ruins revealed a blockage of biomass within the basement's boiler unit. It likely created a buildup of pressure within the unit, resulting in a massive explosion that burned the majority of the interior and obliterated the establishment's support framework. The only area unaffected was the garage due to being located even further away. Inside, it was found that all of the snow vehicles' tires had been punctured, with flesh and neurons spilling from the holes. The bodies of eleven people were discovered laid next to the garage's far wall, with their clothing and possessions having been removed. Based on the wounds the victims had, they had apparently been subject to extended torture prior to death. In all cases, cause of death was determined to be severe internal hemorrhaging, caused by the rupturing of several vital organs. News of the findings alerted Site-109, which demanded photographs of the scene. Cross-comparison between the supplied materials and their on-site case reports confirmed their suspicions: the shape and contents of the tears was a dead giveaway for SCP-9992. Concerns were quickly raised by both the site's senior staff and the personnel in command of SNOW PEAK. While the physical evidence had a strong link to SCP-9992, the attack methodology was distinctly unlike its pre-disappearance //modus operandi//. None of the victims had had their skin or organs tampered with post-mortem, and it was not clear why SCP-9992 would target these individuals specifically when easier targets were available in the region. There was also the fact that the incident had occurred over 8,000 kilometers away from where SCP-9992 disappeared. Operation overseers quickly organized a small dispatch of MTF Delta-4 ("Minutemen") to see if they could locate SCP-9992 nearby. By late afternoon, they had made their way to the town of Hallstatt. When reinforcement forces arrived, they sent remote operated drones to scout the area in the snow field where SCP-9992 was last spotted. Much of the snow there had sublimated, leaving behind another crater. The local physical reality and space-time had undergone a massive distortion consistent with the spontaneous formation of a [[[classifications-guides-and-icons-by-billith|Class-A "Relativistic Integrity" Wormhole]]]. SCP-9992 could not be located. If the white object that fell from the cloud partition did in fact create a Class-A Wormhole, it would have to originate from a civilization at a level of technological advancement far exceeding that of the modern Foundation. At the bottom of the snow crater was an envelope, addressed to the Foundation by one "EMG Conglomerate". It contained a single letter, the contents of which have been reproduced below. [[div class="blockquote"]] To the Foundation: We would like to apologize for the incident earlier today, particularly for the injuries sustained by Ms. ███████ ███████ //(name redacted by the Foundation)//. Worker E-123 has been appropriately disciplined and will be demoted to Hangar-5 living conditions for the next three years (by your calendar). We have also modified its psychological augmentations to prevent it from causing further unnecessary injury. In the future, we will be taking caution to not send rehabilitation program workers back to their universes of origin. We understand that E-123's sudden return may have been surprising to you. It was clear to those of us observing your reality that E-123's consistent aggression and unique attack pattern placed a significant strain on your organization, so we took it upon ourselves to curb its violent streak. This necessity became most evident following the incident of your 17/11/1987. We issued a warning to it soon after, that it was to correct its behavior immediately or face consequences. This should explain the lack of significant casualties suffered between your 1988 and 2001. However, E-123 again exceeded our limit of tolerability on your 12/08/2002. A most disappointing outcome; we had wished the entity would not require forced correction. The Rehabilitation Inductee Initiative (RII) has taken E-123 under its employ for the foreseeable future, and with significant effort we have managed to align it towards more heroic directives. Despite this, some anxiety remains embedded within its personality, resulting in unauthorized conduct during solo missions such as the one you bore witness to. We also understand that it is in the nature of your organization to show excessive worry regarding escaped anomalies. Rest assured, RII has worked with many troubled entities, and E-123 is not special in this regard. It shall benefit more people in the future than it has harmed in its past; we will make sure of that. There is no need for concern regarding the condition of E-123: RII has been ratified by our internal ethics board as an exceptional second-chance opportunity for hostile individuals. Any augmentations you may have seen on E-123 are for purely beneficial purposes. There is no need for concern regarding the condition of the persons you found in the garage: Some of our engineers had defected with several internal documents, citing "moral concerns". It was necessary to limit the damage they could have done. We are sure you understand. There is no //need// for concern regarding any paperwork: We have already taken the liberty of procuring the materials we need from you. There is no //need// for concern regarding our former opacity on E-123's recruitment: It was in your best interest to not get involved with events outside of your purview. This is all that needs to be said. There is no reason to contact us or E-123 again. //You may discontinue your containment efforts permanently.// We thank you in advance for your cooperation. With Respect, //Patricia Bromden// //Advanced Discipline and Interrogation Supervisor, Mental Reconfiguration Expert// //EMG Conglomerate// [[/div]] On the back of the envelope was an emblem, the same one from SCP-9992's torso. Site-109 ordered a thorough re-examination of the 02/12/1987, 12/08/2002, and 18/06/2005 incidents. They found multiple inconsistencies; for example, from the 1987 incidents, flash grenades should not have worked on SCP-9992, given that it did not have eyes. Moreover, while not well understood at the time, it is now known that the physical disruptions from the 2005 incident were in fact also consistent with the formation of Class-A wormholes. By decree of the O4 Council, the "EMG Conglomerate" has been designated a Level 5 (VARMT) hostile Group of Interest. Should the contents of the letter be believed, the RII initiative is capable of abducting any person from across the world, at any time. Compared to the potential scale of the implied threat, the benefits of letting SCP-9992 continue to be contained by the RII have been deemed insignificant. Operatives from this organization are to be treated as potential existential hazards and must be approached with great caution. Both the Hallstatt snow field and the clearing north of Town A have been placed under indefinite quarantine. Members of the Gmuden organization in custody are being questioned for information about the alleged defectors. Reclassification of SCP-9992's object class remains under debate.     SCP-9993

    An article set for the SCP-9993 contest

    13k words

    by Diogene_s

    ⚠️ Content warning: This article contains depictions of racism and sexism. Proceed at your own risk.

⚠️ content warning

They said the ever onwards flow of time is constant. They were wrong. Or perhaps they weren't.

Item#: SCP-9993
Level2
Containment Class:
pending

none

Estimated area of SCP-9993's impact.

Special Containment Procedures: All sites in western and southern Europe are to be in full lockdown in preparation for SCP-9993. As warfare with SCP-9993 remains a possibility, Task Forces and military assets are being preemptively mobilized at the behest of the Directors of Sites 34, 137, Aleph, Area-08, the Temporal Anomalies Department, and the Department of Temporal Anomalies. Overwatch command awaits further developments to assertain if deployment of HECOR1 will be necessary. Diplomatic contact with the pertinent national authorities have been put in motion to organize the full evacuation of all European cities in a 400 km radius from the suspected center of SCP-9993.

Description: SCP-9993 is a temporal disturbance traveling forwards in time at a rate 6 times faster than the normative temporal flow. SCP-9993 seems to be located spatially on northern Spain and will coincide with baseline temporality in 03/04/2014. Currently, SCP-9993 manifests as SCP-9993-1, a constant burst of tachyon, shtrums,2 and chronon particles manifesting in the future location of SCP-9993 that then disipates on the space all around it.

Discovery: SCP-9993 was discovered 01/04/2014, at 6:12 AM, when the Atreus Array system detected unusual variations in the Hume field and the tachyon emissions on the lower atmosphere in northern Spain. The Department of Temporal Anomalies momentarily classified it as ETE-99933 and notified the closest sites. Intertemporal probes sent to intercept the anomaly failed to report back.

During the following 24 hours, the potence of the Hume disturbance and tachyon emissions of SCP-9993-1 grew exponentially, prompting escalation to potential UK-Class "Temporal Breakdown" or DK-Class "Reality invasion" scenario worldwide. Current Special Containment Procedures were put in place and Research and Containment Team Δtⓘ Research and Containment Team Δt Research and Containment Team Δt is a transtemporal Foundation agency which was founded in 1998 to combat and correct a rising number of retrocausal, temporal, and counter historical anomalies which were appearing with alarming and increasing regularity.- agents from the Temporal Anomalies Department were summoned.

Announcement by O5-11 regarding SCP-9993.

As a general rule, we know time to be a stable continuity. Non-anomalous people travel through time in a single direction and on a set speed throughout their lives. But we, in the Foundation, are aware of phenomena that break the laws of physics on a daily basis. And time is malleable and fragile when faced with these phenomena. SCP-9993, with its abnormal chronological nature threatens the present from the past.

It is very possible that it will pass our current time and head for some future far off point, but we cannot afford to act upon that eventuality as the nature and trajectory of SCP-9993 is still unknown to us. Be it a simple fluke or something much more dire, all of the Foundation must be prepared for its arrival.

█████ ████
O5-11
O5 Council

By 16:23, 02/04/2014, the center of SCP-9993-1 was located, and all containment teams converged on the location. Rally Point A was established by containment teams 8 km away from the hypothetical epicenter of the anomaly. Foundation task forces accompanied by personnel from the Department of Temporal Anomalies and Parahistory Department and PHYSICS Assessment Team 731 were present at the site. During the night the tachyon levels in SCP-9993-1 continued to rise, registering at roughly one mole of Shtrums per atom. RCT-Δt personnel promptly arrived at Rally Point-A.

There isn't much to say. We were all prepared for a DaeviteⓘDaevaThe Daevite Empire was an ancient civilization which has the anomalous effect of retroactive temporal causality due to the effects of SCP-140.- invasion, an anticausal weapon sent from an unrecorded civilization in the future or perhaps some time deity was playing with us. Wouldn't be the first time.

When Delta-T arrived and started setting up their contraptions, we let them do it. After all, they've dealt with stuff like this before. They put a timer in the camp that slowly counted down to the estimated arrival of SCP-9993. They also seemed to know more than us. Which is par for the course in their case. The other doctors in observation duty were worried because there were seemingly not enough time agents to deal with the gravity of the situation.

It was dread inducing, but what could we do about it?

Alice Forth
Director
Department of Temporal Anomalies

During the following morning, all onsite agents armed themselves with tactical esomat suits and stood in formation in Rally Point A. Furthermore, Foundation military vehicles had been brought onsite and retrofitted with mobile Mk-VI XACTS devices4 and Scrantron Reality Anchors.

By 9:23, 03/04/2014, SCP-9993-1 arrived at its peak and SCP-9993 manifested fully.

We were all biting our nails in anticipation. After all, what can 250 soldiers in the middle of the Monegros desert do other than that? The others couldn't keep their hands away from their weapons. Reloading them, touching them up, the likes. The battlemages from some task force I don't remember the name of were covering themselves in chalk and honey. They had a sacrificial lamb that didn't stop bawling and everything.

But we all came back to the wall of light in front of us. According to the chronomancer on my right that was the usual when it came to extratemporal anomalies manifesting in the present. It's something about the speed of light. I didn't catch it fully. Because at that point, the brightness died down. And in front of us there was nothing.

Agent. Edurne Zugarramurdi
Thaumaturgical Asset
Site-137

The first impression of SCP-9993 was that it was an empty plot of land comparable to the surrounding area. The acting leader of the expedition, Dr. Jimena Menéndez, ordered the military forces to stay back and sent a small team in a modified vehicle into the anomaly with the intention of exploring it

Record 2014/04/03 - 100201

Rally Point A

Members:

  • STF Xi-10 (Hanging Out Meeting):
    • Captain Humberto Castillo Fuertes
    • Agent Alice Molinaro
    • Agent Suban Dualeh
  • Research and Containment Team Δt
    • Dr. Ak
    • Ag. Groundhog
  • COMMAND

<All agents are crammed on the cockpit of the exploratory vehicle, wearing esomat suits and looking through the windshield at the desert beyond. Dr. Ak, on account of being a paranthropus, is sitting on a modified chair>

Ag. Dualeh: It looks normal.

Dr. Ak: <Speaking through a bionic speaker system> DOUBT.

Ag. Groundhog: Yeah it does, but trust me, it never is.

Cpt. Castillo: Command, requesting permission to advance into the anomaly.

COMMAND: Permission granted.

<The vehicle starts. It moves from a road that has been bisected by the anomaly, and traverses the first stretch of desert.>

View of SCP-9993.

Ag. Dualeh: So, why didn't they send a drone to do this?

Ag. Groundhog: We sent an unmanned temporal vessel into it but it didn't yield anything.

Ag. Dualeh: So it shot down what we sent into it?

Ag. Groundhog: Perhaps.

<Silence on recording, only punctuated by the groaning of the motor.>

Ag. Molinaro: So, just to be clear. Are you actually time travelers?

Ag. Groundhog: We are.

Ag. Dualeh: If you come from the future, wouldn't you already know what this thing we are venturing into is?

Dr. Ak: TIME. COMPLEX. VARIABLES.

Ag. Groundhog: If we did know, we still wouldn't tell you. Part of the directive to avoid paradoxes.

Dr. Ak: PROTOCOL.

Ag. Molinaro: Thank you, Planet of the Apes.

Dr. Ak: INSULT. OFFENSE.

Cpt. Castillo: Silence. There's movement ahead.

<The vehicle is climbing past a ridge. Beyond it, buildings are visible.>

Ag. Dualeh: Buildings.

Ag. Molinaro: Yeah, we can see them.

Cpt. Castillo: This is Captain Humberto Castillo to command. There are buildings inside the anomaly.

COMMAND: We see them through your cameras.

Cpt. Castillo: Command, are there any records of a town inside of SCP-9993 before?

<Silence on recording.>

COMMAND: No. This is a new development. Move closer.

Dr. Ak: BUILDINGS. TIME. DISPLACEMENT.

Cpt. Castillo: Will they be hostile?

Dr. Ak: UNKNOWN.

Cpt. Castillo: I'm preparing counteroffensive measures, then.

Ag. Dualeh: Wait, why? They look normal from here.

Ag. Molinaro: Maybe. But once we get closer they might want to eat us or something.

Ag. Groundhog: You don't want to know what time decompression does to a body.

Ag. Dualeh: No, I do. Specially if I'm the one heading into them.

Dr. Ak: VEHICLE. SECURE.

<The vehicle moves closer.>

View of SCP-9993.

Ag. Dualeh: It looks like a normal town. For this general location, that is.

Ag. Molinaro: Yeah. Classic old and run down buildings.

Ag. Groundhog: Something should be different.

<The vehicle is now at the threshold of the town but is unable to proceed further due to its width exceeding that of the roads.>

Cpt. Castillo: We have to leave the vehicle and continue afoot. Doctor, you stay here and keep the engine warm. Be prepared to extract if the situation gets too dire. The rest, move out. The Xi-10s go together and Groundhog goes with me. Radio in if there's any trouble. Keep a clear line of communication with command, if needed.

Dr. Ak: AFFIRMATION.

Ag. Molinaro: Aye.

<The teams exit the vehicle through an airlock. Agents Dualeh and Molinaro proceed deeper into the town while Cpt. Castillo and Groundhog travel its perimeter.>

Ag. Molinaro: This truly looks like a normal town.

Ag. Dualeh: It did just get teleported from somewhere in a flash of unexplainable blinding light. That's stuff normal towns aren't supposed to do.

Ag. Molinaro: I guess. What do the instruments say?

Ag. Dualeh: Classic stuff. We just left a truck with an SRA the size of a bear, so hume values will be within bounds. Tachyon emissions are abnormal but that's to be expected… Everything else is peachy.

<They proceed deeper into the town for 30 seconds.>

View of SCP-9993.

Ag. Dualeh: Okay, here's something.

Ag. Molinaro: What?

Ag. Dualeh: Everything is old.

Ag. Molinaro: What?

Ag. Dualeh: Modern towns have signaling and telephone cables. Look around. Do you see any of those here?

Ag. Molinaro: No…

Ag. Dualeh: Exactly.

Ag. Molinaro: Okay, so town without any modern infrastructure. That's normal in inner Spain.

Ag. Dualeh: I know, abandoned towns are a dime a dozen. But you at least get electricity. Alarms here and there. There's nothing here.

<A door in front of them opens. A middle aged woman wearing medieval age attire stumbles out. She looks at the two agents and falls on her ass.>

Ag. Dualeh: Woah!

Ag. Molinaro: <Into the radio.> Captain, Command, this is Agent Molinaro. There's a human in the anomaly.

COMMAND: Bag him and bring him to the Rally Point.

Cpt. Castillo: Be careful and approach with caution. Could be dangerous.

From behind the woman, a small boy stumbles out. He helps the woman up and then looks directly at the two agents. It screams.

Ag. Molinaro: <Into the radio.> Agent Molinaro again. There's two humans in the anomaly.

Ag. Dualeh: No hay dos sin tres.5

Ag. Molinaro: <Into the radio.> There's probably more.

Cpt. Castillo: Hostile?

Ag. Dualeh: No. Scared.

Cpt. Castillo: Approach with care and ascertain intentions, then.

<Ag. Molinaro approaches a middle-aged woman who is transfixed at the sight of the two agents.>

Ag. Molinaro: Hello! I'm with an organization that helps people in unusual situations. Are you doing alright?

Unidentified Woman: What?

Ag. Dualeh: We asked if you're doing alright.

<The woman seems increasingly frightened.>

Unidentified Woman: What are you? What is that? <She points down the street at the van.>

Ag. Molinaro: That's a van. And this is Agent 23647 and I'm agent 19526.6

<The woman screams incoherently, drops to her knees and starts praying.>

Ag. Dualeh: Okay, now what do we do?

<Ag. Dualeh approaches the next person, a boy who is sitting against the wall of the house, looking intermitently at the woman and the agents.>

Ag. Dualeh: Hey, you good?

<The boy does not move.>

Ag. Molinaro: <Speaking into the radio.> Civilians are disoriented and largely unresponsive. What is the next course of action?

Cpt. Castillo: Found three other civilians in the fields. They are unconscious. Command, I don't think we are currently in danger and I'm officially requesting backup.

COMMAND: Received, rest of the teams are on their way.

Following this initial foray into SCP-9993, six other teams were sent into the town and surrounding areas, finding 121 individuals in various states of consciousness. They were all gathered into provisional Rally Point A to be questioned as the entire town was scanned for any further anomalous activity. Once the status of relative normalcy was confirmed, the population was permitted to return to SCP-9993 and enter a state of containment.

To the attention of the O5 Council:

I have carried on with the first hand examination of SCP-9993, as instructed, and thoroughly determined that it poses no active menace. The township itself is inert and its inhabitants lack awareness of what's going on. Moreover, they display no overtly hostile intent. Regardless, I have discreetly removed from the premises any elements that I have deigned to be of interest to the Council for further research.

Far be it from me to pretend to know more than the Council, but I nevertheless recommend the thorough containment and surveillance of the remainder of the town and its dwellers.

Factotum Versailles
OVERWATCH COMMAND

As of 05/04/2014, SCP-9993-1 was found to have subsided significantly, yet not completely. Surveillance and research teams were left on site and a new SCP document was drafted.

SCP-9993.

Special Containment Procedures: All actions for containment of SCP-9993 are to be carried out by Outpost-137 under the purview of Site-137. The provisional supervisor of Outpost-137 is Dr. Diego Orbach, with assistance from a liaison from RCT-Δt, currently Dr. Ak. Outpost-137 is currently guarded by PTF Delta-21 ("Time out").

An electric fence is to surround SCP-9993. All roads leading to SCP-9993 have been cut and air travel around SCP-9993 is to be closely monitored. Standard Cover Story 26 ("Toxic spill") is in use.

SCP-9993-A are to remain contained fully within SCP-9993. They are subject to a curfew (from 20H to 05H) yet their day to day lives are to carry on as unimpeded as possible. Interaction between Foundation personnel and SCP-9993-A instances is to be kept to a strict minimum. The main objective of these interactions is to aid in the containment of SCP-9993 and SCP-9993-A themselves. These protocols can be waved away in the specific circumstances of a potentially dangerous Extranormal Temporal Event.

Guidelines for interaction with the inhabitants of SCP-9993 (henceforth, SCP-9993-A) are as follows:

  • Every individual interacting with SCP-9993-A must wear specialised hazmat suits for the protection of both SCP-9993-A and the individual.
  • Any and all materials coming from outside of SCP-9993 that are expected to come in contact with SCP-9993-A are to be properly sanitized.
  • Cultural exchange between SCP-9993-A and the rest of the world is to be handled by the designated SCP-9993 cultural liaison (currently Dr. Dani Oliva).
    • SCP-9993-A are subject to education and reeducation in the designated area of Outpost-137 as to properly fit with baseline reality, and update them in the history and scientific advancements that have ensued since 1632.7
    • Foods and drinks for SCP-9993-A consumption are to be properly rated as appropriate by onsite medical personnel.

These measures are expected to remain in place until such a time as all SCP-9993-A instances have been properly immunized to baseline time microbes and other such organisms. To this end, all inhabitants of SCP-9993 are to undergo vaccination and education in proper higiene.

Other services such as security and healthcare are to be provided by Foundation personnel.

Structures within SCP-9993 are to be maintained in pristine condition, though additional infrastructure for the purposes of transport, sanitation and surveillance can be added at Outpost-137's discretion. Additional buildings can be constructed in SCP-9993 whenever necessary.

In case of a noticeable augment of SCP-9993-1 and the occurance of an Extranormal Temporal Event, the Temporal Anomalies Department is to be notified immediately. To this end, Tachyon and Kant counters are to be present in every 4 square meters in the entirety of SCP-9993's surface.

Description: SCP-9993 is an area of 10 km2 containing the town of "San Antonio del Monte," located 50 km east of Zaragoza, Spain. SCP-9993 was completely absent from consensus reality from the year 1632 until 03/04/2014.

SCP-9993 has 146 inhabitants (henceforth referred to as SCP-9993-A), and a total of 36 buildings of various sizes and intended use. Inhabitants of SCP-9993 have been found to be baseline humans by all currently issued tests.

SCP-9993 suffers irregular augments of SCP-9993-1, meaning an increase in Tachyon and Chronon emissions and a decrease in localised Hume values. Such events are classified as an ETE-9993 with its own numerical designation. [Further Information is Classified Level 5: Top Secret]

Following section is redacted per order of the O5 Council
- close

This report is to be sent to the O5 Council to expose the conclusions of the Temporal Anomalies Department's impressions on SCP-9993.

The nature of SCP-9993 was already known to us before its arrival to your baseline temporality, yet the nature of the Foundation meant that the actions you undertook were supposed to happen regardless of our prior knowledge. Yet, even if SCP-9993 has proven to be inoffensive and its inhabitants are simply defenseless people from the 1600s, the area is still anomalously active, as proven by the tachyon bursts still happening on it, which were unexplained until the events of this morning. I attach footage recorded by a surveillance camera in SCP-9993.

Record 2014/04/20 - 10145

Captured by surveillance cameras in the outskirts of SCP-9993.

<SCP-9993-A89 (male, 31 years old, responds to the name Antonio "El Corto") is inspecting his field, examining the plants.>

<There's a flash of light six meters away from SCP-9993-A89 and he falls over. A machine appears in the middle of the light. It has manufacture consistent with victorian era paratechnology. A trapdoor on the side of the machine opens and an entity wearing a diving suit emerges from it.>

Unidentified figure: Greetings!

SCP-9993-A89: <In Spanish> What?

Unidentified figure: I come from the past to visit the irradiated wastelands of the far future in behalf of Prometheus Laboratories! Tell me native, what year is it?

SCP-9993-A89: <In Spanish> I don't understand you!

Unidentified figure: I thought italians would have gone extinct already. I might be at the wrong time.

SCP-9993-A89: <In Spanish> I'm sorry but…

Unidentified figure: Fear not, native, I shall leave now. I am clearly not in the future but in the past. I wish thee farewell!

<The entity reenters the machine, which disappears in another flash of light.>

The man with the diving suit has been identified as Dr. George H. Waters, a Prometheus Labs engineer from 1914, whose last project was a self titled "Time Machine". Until today, we didn't know if he had succeeded in his endeavours, as we thought he had perished in an explosion in his lab while testing his invention. The truth of the matter is that he survived and escaped into the future, but SCP-9993, probably due to its natural chronological instability attracted him to it. This event has already been classified by my department as "ETE-9993-1", because we expect many more of these events to be happening soon.

This is a great opportunity for both the Foundation and the efforts of my department to keep the timeline safe, as SCP-9993 seems to be a great attractor of temporal anomalies, which we could use to capture them.

Thaddeus Xyank
Director
Research and Containment Team Δt

Addendum 9993-1: Interactions with SCP-9993-A.

Predictably, cultural and scientific knowledge among SCP-9993-A is limited to that found in seventeenth century rural Spain. Containment efforts hinge on SCP-9993-A instances knowing enough of the modern world to streamline those same containment efforts. The nature of SCP-9993 itself as an isolated anachronicity will make the education in current topics difficult.

The SCP Foundation lives and breathes in a society that is inherently a product of the western age of enlightenment ideals, with our Veil having subsequently expanded to cover the entirety of the globe. We have encountered many cultures which are fundamentally different than our own (leaving beside the inherent anthropological idiosyncracies of the differences between Supra and Infra-Veil societies). Many times, these cultures are dead and thus supposedly static (Vemhoff, 1946, 28) (Lindqvist et al., 2004, 41), sometimes, they are alive and have evolved alongside our own (Andrews, 2011, 35).

SCP-9993 poses a challenge as it is our own culture, yet temporally isolated in the past. Walking through the streets of SCP-9993 immediately after it was discovered was like walking through a living museum. Which raises, of course, the nontrivial issue of the changes that have elapsed in four centuries of time. Spain in the 1600s was rigid. It had a caste system, the king and nobility at the top, supported by a church that favoured fear and zeal, and a high majority of peasants at the bottom. Now, it also was the biggest empire of the world, controling and ruthlessly exploiting the Americas and Asia, and entrenched in wars in Europe. But the people at the bottom rung of the ladder were extremely poor. Yet they were proud of their apparent might. And we cannot forget about the sexism, racism and religious intolerance common at the time.

It's too early to tell, but as it stands it seems like this anomaly is a snapshot of the time, both physically and societally.

Now, we know of temporally isolated anomalies and the challenge they present. Psychologically, being or feeling outside of your own time causes an infinite amount of problems (Reynders, 1999, 65), and in SCP-9993, these will be upscaled to a whole town. This means that we have to do out best to help the inhabitants of San Antonio del Monte out of current predicament. I am unsure of how all of this will be dealt with in the long run. But I look forward to seeing the situation evolve. While solutions to the issue currently elude us, progress is being made, and I look forward to seeing the situation evolve.

Dr. Dani Oliva
Review of the Discovery of SCP-9993
Internal Foundation Publishing
24/06/2014

A center of learning has been created as the first permanent building in Outpost-137 as a means to aid in communication between Foundation personnel and SCP-9993-A. The following are excerpts of the first recorded interactions between them. All of them were originally recorded in Spanish.

Record 2014/06/27 - 10187

Interview with SCP-9993-A81

Male, 38 years old, responds to the name of Don Mariano de la Vega.

Dr. Orbach: I know these news are a lot to take in, but we are trying to help you.

SCP-9993-A81 I don't believe this. This is outrageous!

Dr. Orbach: Yeah, I know, you spend all your life thinking the world works in one specific way and it turns out that it doesn't. It is upsetting.

SCP-9993-A81 How dare you do this to us! Imprison a town of good catholic folk like us!

Dr. Orbach: I'm sorry?

SCP-9993-A81 I don't know who you work for, be it the Great Turk, or the anglicans of the perfidious Albion or even those accursed and affeminate Franks, but this insult shan't go unpunished! I'll have you know that my uncle was of the Order of Borja y Aragón! I have noble, untainted blood in my heart and my cousin is a captain in the armies of the King! They will see to it that retribution is served and you are driven away from our lands!

Dr. Orbach: Oh, alright then. I guess I'll let you return to your house and calm down.

Record 2014/04/29 - 100192

Interview with SCP-9993-A6

Female, 30 years old, responds to the name of Orosia Aguirre.

Dr. Oliva: Hello.

<Silence on recording.>

Dr. Oliva: Are you alright?

SCP-9993-A6: Are you going to eat me?

Dr. Oliva: …No?

<Silence on recording.>

Afterword

SCP-9993-A62 was placed under close surveillance, and every house he entered after the previous interview was closely monitored for suspicious activity. Following visits from SCP-9993-A62, three other children tried to escape SCP-9993, but were stopped and returned to their houses.

Observing the shifts in the culture of SCP-9993 is extremely revealing. There is, of course, the aspect of learning the tiny tidbits of day to day life in the 1600s. We already knew the broad strokes — I read Don Quixote and Lazarillo de Tormes in high school. But there's small details that aren't shown there. Day to day rituals, the way to eat food, the way people move.

Yet the consequences of their temporal transplantation are visible in their society. We are teaching them our ways, and our advancements, and they react to it. They now know the broad strokes of what a car is, and what the wonders of modern medicine can achieve, yet many of them are skeptical. And rightfully so. For them, combustion engines are akin to witchery. Thus, they either get defensive, like the ones following the priest of the town, one SCP-9993-A62, or they go the other way and start believing current humanity to be miraculous angels capable of great feats. We have registered the start of such worship starting as a grassroots movement in some minoritary spaces. Yet a not insignificant group has just been trying to survive and adapt in the pressures of their current situation.

I've advised that we try to ease tensions and slow down the exchange of information as to not overwhelm the collective of SCP-9993-A. And also because there's some things that we have to ponder how to properly explain. Because whether they regard them with skepticism or wonder, so far they've only been exposed to what we could call "the good things" of the last 400 years. But there are also horrors that i can't fathom how to expose to them. They understand guns, but how could they understand the current scale of warfare? Could they conceptualize the nuclear bomb? How do you explain climate change to someone who still goes to church to light candles to the appropriate saints who would give them the correct amount of rain? And how do you manage to change an entire town's worth of conceptions like that? Is it even worth it?

At the time of writing, these questions still lie unanswered.

Dr. Dani Oliva
Sociological progress on SCP-9993
Foundation Internal Publishing

Addendum 9993-4: The search for SCP-9993-A75.

While the internal investigations over the disappearance of SCP-9993-A75 were happening inside SCP-9993, police and emergency service communication channels around the area were being monitored.

On 18/07/2014, an outbreak of an unidentified disease was detected in the Lozano Blesa Hospital of Zaragoza. This fact was brought to the Foundation's attention due to elevated activity by the GOC's World Parahealth Organization onsite. An MTF team was sent to investigate and found SCP-9993-A75 inside the hospital, as well as many infected individuals. It had been determined that SCP-9993-A75 was the vector of the pathogen and was about to be moved offsite by the WPhO. Nevertheless, Foundation personnel were able to secure him through diplomatic means and extract him to Site-137.

It was subsequently found that SCP-9993-A75 had been discovered by a family while it was traversing a road close to SCP-9993. It was brought to the hospital due to his words being interpreted as delirious rambling. Once in the hospital, the instance's health deteriorated and the surrounding persons subsequently suffered symptoms of the unidentified illness. Later findings revealed that it was a strain of common cold that had naturally disappeared but SCP-9993-A75 still carried. SCP-9993-A75 was similarly infected by the common flu.

It is always an honor to be able to integrate oneself with the native inhabitants of an anomalous location. The recent experiences have served as a way to learn more about the day to day life of the 1600s. Primarily, the hardship. Orosia Aguirre (SCP-9993-A6), is a single mother of four (SCP-9993-A73, A74, A75 and A76), as her husband went to fight the 30 years' war. Due to the nature of SCP-9993, we can't know if he ever returned.

Yet past the hardship there was care. There was a sense of community. Orosia didn't know what to give us, as the food SCP-9993-A has been receiving has mainly been nutritive paste designed to make them resilient to current times. So she scrambled to prepare a rather simple, but effective garlic soup. And just to get that, she needed the support of her neighbors, who lent garlic and stale bread.

Of course, the conversation revolved around the adventures of her child. It was also obvious that the new nature of her daughter had become some sort of taboo. Another subject was the kind nature of her neighbors, who had helped massively during her son's disappearance. That kindness had now partially disappeared and she was concerned.

As it stands, the town is divided. Roughly one third of SCP-9993-A has warmed up to the modern world, mostly by expressing interest in what's beyond the electrified fences. They have seemingly made up their minds about not being in 1632 anymore. Another third is hellbent on their idea of still being in 1632, or perhaps beliefs weirder still. Their main point seems to be that everything we say is a fabrication and we spout harmful ideologies. The last third lies somewhere in the middle. And it's difficult to test the boundaries of these three groups.

Orosia warned us that something was going to happen, something big.

Clearly we were sent here to stop it. We come from a past where all is right and true and holy! My friends on the outside saw this truth, and decided to help us achieve it!

Ag. Molinaro: That tracks, but…

SCP-9993-A62: We will defeat you, because we are righteous. You are nothing more than whores who have used the outpour from their slits to brainwash and supplant your men. You are weak. And we are strong!

Dr. Oliva: These interviews have been very unproductive. Do you think we've learned enough?

Dr. Ak: AFFIRMATION.

Dr. Oliva: Thank you.

An investigation realized by the RCT-Δt revealed that SCP-9993-A81 and SCP-9993-A75 had long been compromised by external agents and attempting to chronologically correct this would cause too much damage to the timeline. Thus, ETE-9993-Ω cannot be prevented, only mitigated through continuous warfare.

SCP-9993-A81 and SCP-9993-A62 were moved to Site-06. SCP-9993-A democratically elected a new priest, designated to be SCP-9993-A73.

Addendum 9993-6: Year of containment update.

To the attention of the O5 Council:

As a year of containment has elapsed, it is my belief that SCP-9993 has reached a point of nigh autonomy. The inhabitants have adapted in a satisfactory manner and it is no longer required to wear biohazard protection to interact with them.

RCT-ΔT's attempt at creating a honeypot for atemporal paraterrorists presented such success that the anomaly was almost terminated in the process. My advice, thus, is to reduce the TAD activity in situ and relegate them to a force to be called in times of emergency, for as long SCP-9993-1 remains active and still generating or attracting Extranormal Temporal Events.

All in all, I see a high likelihood of a reclassification to Nexus soon, if the Council so permits it.

Factotum Versailles
OVERWATCH COMMAND

Addendum 9993-1: Interactions with SCP-9993-A, end.

Proceed at your own risk. [[include :scp-wiki:info:end]] [[include :scp-wiki:component:info-cw]] ===== [[include component:preview text= They said the ever onwards flow of time is constant. They were wrong. Or perhaps they weren't. ]] ===== [[include :scp-wiki:component:anomaly-class-bar-source |item-number= SCP-9993 |clearance= 2 |container-class= pending |secondary-class= none |disruption-class= none |risk-class= none ]] ----- [[include :scp-wiki:component:image-block name=lossy-page1-800px-ETH-BIB-Erosionslandschaft_mit_Bew%C3%A4sserungsanlagen_%28Los_Monegros%29_aus_3500_m_H%C3%B6he-Mittelmeerflug_1928-LBS_MH02-05-0075.tif.jpg|caption=Estimated area of SCP-9993's impact. |width=1000px]] **Special Containment Procedures:** All sites in western and southern Europe are to be in full lockdown in preparation for SCP-9993. As warfare with SCP-9993 remains a possibility, Task Forces and military assets are being preemptively mobilized at the behest of the Directors of Sites 34, 137, Aleph, Area-08, the Temporal Anomalies Department, and the Department of Temporal Anomalies. Overwatch command awaits further developments to assertain if deployment of HECOR [[footnote]][[[scp-9600 |High-Energy Concentration Orbital Railgun]]], an orbital Foundation eigenweapon used to prevent emergent K-Class Scenarios.[[/footnote]] will be necessary. Diplomatic contact with the pertinent national authorities have been put in motion to organize the full evacuation of all European cities in a 400 km radius from the suspected center of SCP-9993. **Description:** SCP-9993 is a temporal disturbance traveling forwards in time at a rate 6 times faster than the normative temporal flow. SCP-9993 seems to be located spatially on northern Spain and will coincide with baseline temporality in 03/04/2014. Currently, SCP-9993 manifests as SCP-9993-1, a constant burst of tachyon, shtrums,[[footnote]]Subatomic particles result of paracausal activity.[[/footnote]] and chronon particles manifesting in the future location of SCP-9993 that then disipates on the space all around it. **Discovery:** SCP-9993 was discovered 01/04/2014, at 6:12 AM, when the Atreus Array system detected unusual variations in the Hume field and the tachyon emissions on the lower atmosphere in northern Spain. The Department of Temporal Anomalies momentarily classified it as ETE-9993[[footnote]]Extranormal Temporal Event, meaning an automatic Γ-level breach of normalcy alert is raised on all surrounding Foundation Facilities.[[/footnote]] and notified the closest sites. Intertemporal probes sent to intercept the anomaly failed to report back. During the following 24 hours, the potence of the Hume disturbance and tachyon emissions of SCP-9993-1 grew exponentially, prompting escalation to potential UK-Class "Temporal Breakdown" or DK-Class "Reality invasion" scenario worldwide. Current Special Containment Procedures were put in place and [[span class="hoverlink"]][[[welcome-to-delta-t|Research and Containment Team Δt]]]^^ⓘ^^[[span class="hoverlink-card"]][[span class="hoverlink-title"]] Research and Containment Team Δt [[/span]][[span class="hoverlink-text"]]Research and Containment Team Δt is a transtemporal Foundation agency which was founded in 1998 to combat and correct a rising number of retrocausal, temporal, and counter historical anomalies which were appearing with alarming and increasing regularity.[[/span]][[span class="hoverlink-image" style="--src: url(https://scp-wiki.wdfiles.com/local--files/welcome-to-delta-t/Delta-T.png)"]]-[[/span]][[/span]][[/span]] agents from the Temporal Anomalies Department were summoned. [[div class="overwatch_memo"]] [[=]] ++++ Announcement by O5-11 regarding SCP-9993. [[/=]] As a general rule, we know time to be a stable continuity. Non-anomalous people travel through time in a single direction and on a set speed throughout their lives. But we, in the Foundation, are aware of phenomena that break the laws of physics on a daily basis. And time is malleable and fragile when faced with these phenomena. SCP-9993, with its abnormal chronological nature threatens the present from the past. It is very possible that it will pass our current time and head for some future far off point, but we cannot afford to act upon that eventuality as the nature and trajectory of SCP-9993 is still unknown to us. Be it a simple fluke or something much more dire, all of the Foundation must be prepared for its arrival. [[>]] █████ ████ O5-11 O5 Council [[/>]] [[/div]] By 16:23, 02/04/2014, the center of SCP-9993-1 was located, and all containment teams converged on the location. Rally Point A was established by containment teams 8 km away from the hypothetical epicenter of the anomaly. Foundation task forces accompanied by personnel from the Department of Temporal Anomalies and Parahistory Department and PHYSICS Assessment Team 731 were present at the site. During the night the tachyon levels in SCP-9993-1 continued to rise, registering at roughly one mole of Shtrums per atom. RCT-Δt personnel promptly arrived at Rally Point-A. [[div class="blockquote"]] There isn't much to say. We were all prepared for a [[span class="hoverlink"]][[[scp-140|Daevite]]]^^ⓘ^^[[span class="hoverlink-card"]][[span class="hoverlink-title"]]Daeva[[/span]][[span class="hoverlink-text"]]The Daevite Empire was an ancient civilization which has the anomalous effect of retroactive temporal causality due to the effects of SCP-140.[[/span]][[span class="hoverlink-image" style="--src: url(https://scp-wiki.wdfiles.com/local--files/scp-140/daevas.jpg)"]]-[[/span]][[/span]][[/span]] invasion, an anticausal weapon sent from an unrecorded civilization in the future or perhaps some time deity was playing with us. Wouldn't be the first time. When Delta-T arrived and started setting up their contraptions, we let them do it. After all, they've dealt with stuff like this before. They put a timer in the camp that slowly counted down to the estimated arrival of SCP-9993. They also seemed to know more than us. Which is par for the course in their case. The other doctors in observation duty were worried because there were seemingly not enough time agents to deal with the gravity of the situation. It was dread inducing, but what could we do about it? [[>]] Alice Forth Director Department of Temporal Anomalies [[/>]] [[/div]] During the following morning, all onsite agents armed themselves with tactical esomat suits and stood in formation in Rally Point A. Furthermore, Foundation military vehicles had been brought onsite and retrofitted with mobile Mk-VI XACTS devices[[footnote]]Xyank Anastasakos Constant Temporal Sink, a piece of paratechnology in use by the Temporal Anomalies Department to stabilize temporal fluctuations within a given area.[[/footnote]] and Scrantron Reality Anchors. By 9:23, 03/04/2014, SCP-9993-1 arrived at its peak and SCP-9993 manifested fully. [[div class="blockquote"]] We were all biting our nails in anticipation. After all, what can 250 soldiers in the middle of the Monegros desert do other than that? The others couldn't keep their hands away from their weapons. Reloading them, touching them up, the likes. The battlemages from some task force I don't remember the name of were covering themselves in chalk and honey. They had a sacrificial lamb that didn't stop bawling and everything. But we all came back to the wall of light in front of us. According to the chronomancer on my right that was the usual when it came to extratemporal anomalies manifesting in the present. It's something about the speed of light. I didn't catch it fully. Because at that point, the brightness died down. And in front of us there was nothing. [[>]] Agent. Edurne Zugarramurdi Thaumaturgical Asset Site-137 [[/>]] [[/div]] The first impression of SCP-9993 was that it was an empty plot of land comparable to the surrounding area. The acting leader of the expedition, Dr. Jimena Menéndez, ordered the military forces to stay back and sent a small team in a modified vehicle into the anomaly with the intention of exploring it [[div class="blockquote"]] [[=]] +++ **Record 2014/04/03 - 100201** ++++ Rally Point A [[/=]] __**Members:**__ * STF Xi-10 (Hanging Out Meeting):  * Captain Humberto Castillo Fuertes  * Agent Alice Molinaro  * Agent Suban Dualeh * Research and Containment Team Δt  * Dr. Ak  * Ag. That's stuff normal towns aren't supposed to do. **Ag. Molinaro:** I guess. What do the instruments say? **Ag. Dualeh:** Classic stuff. Molinaro:** No... **Ag. Dualeh:** Exactly. **Ag. Molinaro:** Okay, so town without any modern infrastructure. That's normal in inner Spain. **Ag. Dualeh:** I know, abandoned towns are a dime a dozen. But you at least get electricity. Alarms here and there. There's nothing here. //// **Ag. Dualeh:** Woah! **Ag. Molinaro:** //// Captain, Command, this is Agent Molinaro. Castillo:** Found three other civilians in the fields. They are unconscious. Command, I don't think we are currently in danger and I'm officially requesting backup. **COMMAND:** Received, rest of the teams are on their way. [[/div]] Following this initial foray into SCP-9993, six other teams were sent into the town and surrounding areas, finding 121 individuals in various states of consciousness. They were all gathered into provisional Rally Point A to be questioned as the entire town was scanned for any further anomalous activity. Once the status of relative normalcy was confirmed, the population was permitted to return to SCP-9993 and enter a state of containment. [[div class="papernote"]] To the attention of the O5 Council: I have carried on with the first hand examination of SCP-9993, as instructed, and thoroughly determined that it poses no active menace. The township itself is inert and its inhabitants lack awareness of what's going on. Moreover, they display no overtly hostile intent. Regardless, I have discreetly removed from the premises any elements that I have deigned to be of interest to the Council for further research. Far be it from me to pretend to know more than the Council, but I nevertheless recommend the thorough containment and surveillance of the remainder of the town and its dwellers. [[>]] Factotum Versailles OVERWATCH COMMAND [[/>]] [[/div]] As of 05/04/2014, SCP-9993-1 was found to have subsided significantly, yet not completely. Surveillance and research teams were left on site and a new SCP document was drafted. ----- [[include :scp-wiki:component:anomaly-class-bar-source |item-number= SCP-9993 |clearance= 3 |container-class= keter |disruption-class= keneq |risk-class= caution ]] ----- [[include :scp-wiki:component:image-block name=Sari%C3%B1ena-Cartuja_de_Monegros_14.JPG|caption= SCP-9993. |width=1000px]] **Special Containment Procedures:** All actions for containment of SCP-9993 are to be carried out by Outpost-137 under the purview of Site-137. The provisional supervisor of Outpost-137 is Dr. Diego Orbach, with assistance from a liaison from RCT-Δt, currently Dr. Ak. Outpost-137 is currently guarded by PTF Delta-21 ("Time out"). An electric fence is to surround SCP-9993. All roads leading to SCP-9993 have been cut  and air travel around SCP-9993 is to be closely monitored. Standard Cover Story 26 ("Toxic spill") is in use. SCP-9993-A are to remain contained fully within SCP-9993. They are subject to a curfew (from 20H to 05H) yet their day to day lives are to carry on as unimpeded as possible. Interaction between Foundation personnel and SCP-9993-A instances is to be kept to a strict minimum. The main objective of these interactions is to aid in the containment of SCP-9993 and SCP-9993-A themselves. These protocols can be waved away in the specific circumstances of a potentially dangerous Extranormal Temporal Event. Guidelines for interaction with the inhabitants of SCP-9993 (henceforth, SCP-9993-A) are as follows: * Every individual interacting with SCP-9993-A must wear specialised hazmat suits for the protection of both SCP-9993-A and the individual. * Any and all materials coming from outside of SCP-9993 that are expected to come in contact with SCP-9993-A are to be properly sanitized. * Cultural exchange between SCP-9993-A and the rest of the world is to be handled by the designated SCP-9993 cultural liaison (currently Dr. Dani Oliva).  *  SCP-9993-A are subject to education and reeducation in the designated area of Outpost-137 as to properly fit with baseline reality, and update them in the history and scientific advancements that have ensued since 1632.[[footnote]]Dossiers on education and reeducation are found in Supplemental documentation.[[/footnote]]  * Foods and drinks for SCP-9993-A consumption are to be properly rated as appropriate by onsite medical personnel.   These measures are expected to remain in place until such a time as all SCP-9993-A instances have been properly immunized to baseline time microbes and other such organisms. To this end, all inhabitants of SCP-9993 are to undergo vaccination and education in proper higiene. Other services such as security and healthcare are to be provided by Foundation personnel. Structures within SCP-9993 are to be maintained in pristine condition, though additional infrastructure for the purposes of transport, sanitation and surveillance can be added at Outpost-137's discretion. Additional buildings can be constructed in SCP-9993 whenever necessary. In case of a noticeable augment of SCP-9993-1 and the occurance of an Extranormal Temporal Event, the Temporal Anomalies Department is to be notified immediately. To this end, Tachyon and Kant counters are to be present in every 4 square meters in the entirety of SCP-9993's surface. **Description:** SCP-9993 is an area of 10 km^^2^^ containing the town of "San Antonio del Monte," located 50 km east of Zaragoza, Spain. SCP-9993 was completely absent from consensus reality from the year 1632 until 03/04/2014. SCP-9993 has 146 inhabitants (henceforth referred to as SCP-9993-A), and a total of 36 buildings of various sizes and intended use. Inhabitants of SCP-9993 have been found to be baseline humans by all currently issued tests. SCP-9993 suffers irregular augments of SCP-9993-1, meaning an increase in Tachyon and Chronon emissions and a decrease in localised Hume values. Such events are classified as an ETE-9993 with its own numerical designation. **[Further Information is Classified Level 5: Top Secret]** [[collapsible show="Following section is redacted per order of the O5 Council" hide="- close"]] [[div class="temporal_memo"]] This report is to be sent to the O5 Council to expose the conclusions of the Temporal Anomalies Department's impressions on SCP-9993. The nature of SCP-9993 was already known to us before its arrival to your baseline temporality, yet the nature of the Foundation meant that the actions you undertook were supposed to happen regardless of our prior knowledge. Yet, even if SCP-9993 has proven to be inoffensive and its inhabitants are simply defenseless people from the 1600s, the area is still anomalously active, as proven by the tachyon bursts still happening on it, which were unexplained until the events of this morning. I attach footage recorded by a surveillance camera in SCP-9993. [[div class="blockquote"]] +++ **Record 2014/04/20 - 10145** ++++ Captured by surveillance cameras in the outskirts of SCP-9993. ----- [[<]] //// //// **Unidentified figure:** Greetings! **SCP-9993-A89:** //// What? **Unidentified figure:** I come from the past to visit the irradiated wastelands of the far future in behalf of Prometheus Laboratories! Tell me native, what year is it? **SCP-9993-A89:** //// I don't understand you! **Unidentified figure:** I thought italians would have gone extinct already. I might be at the wrong time. **SCP-9993-A89:** //// I'm sorry but... **Unidentified figure:** Fear not, native, I shall leave now. I am clearly not in the future but in the past. I wish thee farewell! //// [[/<]] [[/div]] The man with the diving suit has been identified as Dr. George H. Waters, a Prometheus Labs engineer from 1914, whose last project was a self titled "Time Machine". Until today, we didn't know if he had succeeded in his endeavours, as we thought he had perished in an explosion in his lab while testing his invention. The truth of the matter is that he survived and escaped into the future, but SCP-9993, probably due to its natural chronological instability attracted him to it. This event has already been classified by my department as "ETE-9993-1", because we expect many more of these events to be happening soon. This is a great opportunity for both the Foundation and the efforts of my department to keep the timeline safe, as SCP-9993 seems to be a great attractor of temporal anomalies, which we could use to capture them. [[>]] Thaddeus Xyank Director Research and Containment Team Δt [[/>]] [[/div]] [[/collapsible]] ------ **Addendum 9993-1:** Interactions with SCP-9993-A. Predictably, cultural and scientific knowledge among SCP-9993-A is limited to that found in seventeenth century rural Spain. Containment efforts hinge on SCP-9993-A instances knowing enough of the modern world to streamline those same containment efforts. The nature of SCP-9993 itself as an isolated anachronicity will make the education in current topics difficult. [[div class="document"]] The SCP Foundation lives and breathes in a society that is inherently a product of the western age of enlightenment ideals, with our Veil having subsequently expanded to cover the entirety of the globe. We have encountered many cultures which are fundamentally different than our own (leaving beside the inherent anthropological idiosyncracies of the differences between Supra and Infra-Veil societies). Many times, these cultures are dead and thus supposedly static (Vemhoff, 1946, 28) (Lindqvist //et al.//, 2004, 41), sometimes, they are alive and have evolved alongside our own (Andrews, 2011, 35). SCP-9993 poses a challenge as it is our own culture, yet temporally isolated in the past. Walking through the streets of SCP-9993 immediately after it was discovered was like walking through a living museum. Which raises, of course, the nontrivial issue of the changes that have elapsed in four centuries of time. Spain in the 1600s was rigid. It had a caste system, the king and nobility at the top, supported by a church that favoured fear and zeal, and a high majority of peasants at the bottom. Now, it also was the biggest empire of the world, controling and ruthlessly exploiting the Americas and Asia, and entrenched in wars in Europe. But the people at the bottom rung of the ladder were extremely poor. Yet they were proud of their apparent might. And we cannot forget about the sexism, racism and religious intolerance common at the time. It's too early to tell, but as it stands it seems like this anomaly is a snapshot of the time, both physically and societally. Now, we know of temporally isolated anomalies and the challenge they present. Psychologically, being or feeling outside of your own time causes an infinite amount of problems (Reynders, 1999, 65), and in SCP-9993, these will be upscaled to a whole town. This means that we have to do out best to help the inhabitants of San Antonio del Monte out of current predicament. I am unsure of how all of this will be dealt with in the long run. But I look forward to seeing the situation evolve. While solutions to the issue currently elude us, progress is being made, and I look forward to seeing the situation evolve.
